strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Providence Day School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 51.1% over the last five entering classes — 499 acceptances from 977 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Providence Day School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 51.1% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 499 admisyon sou 977 aplikasyon.

strings.text: NC State University is the hard one: 32.4% in Fall 2025 — 23 of 71 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: NC State University se sa ki difisil la: 32.4% nan otòn 2025 — 23 sou 71 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: Read each row as a joint figure: the rate at which that university admitted this school’s applicants — not the university’s overall admit rate, and not a measure of the school’s own selectivity. Applied/Accepted are the Fall 2025 entering class; the 5-yr column pools Fall 2021–2025 as sum(accepted)/sum(applied), so a heavy year counts more than a light one. Counts travel with every rate because several cells are single-digit.
strings.t: Li chak ranje kòm yon chif konjwen: to kote inivèsite sa a te admèt kandida lekòl sa a — se pa to admisyon jeneral inivèsite a, ni yon mezi selektivite lekòl la menm. Aplikasyon/Aksepte se pwomosyon ki antre nan otòn 2025 la; kolòn 5 an an konbine otòn 2021–2025 kòm sòm(aksepte)/sòm(aplikasyon), konsa yon ane ki chaje konte plis pase yon ane lejè. Chif yo mache ak chak to paske plizyè selil gen yon sèl chif.

strings.text: Rank order follows the US News **National Universities** table for NC publics. That qualifier matters: Appalachian State is ranked in **Regional Universities South**, a different list, so “top 6 in NC” is not self-defining. Re-score when the next edition lands.
strings.t: Lòd klasman an swiv tablo **National Universities** US News la pou inivèsite piblik NC yo. Presizyon sa a enpòtan: Appalachian State klase nan **Regional Universities South**, yon lis diferan, konsa « pi bon 6 nan NC » pa defini tèt li. Re-evalye lè pwochen edisyon an soti.

strings.text: The “461 students sitting AP exams” and “95% of students scoring 3+” figures come from an indexed snippet of the profile PDF rather than direct extraction — the 1,213 exam count from the same sentence IS confirmed by the subject table. The headline “30 AP courses” also sits against a profile exam table listing 31 distinct subjects.
strings.t: Chif “461 elèv k ap pase egzamen AP” ak “95% nan elèv yo ki fè 3+” yo soti nan yon ekstrè endekse nan PDF pwofil la olye ke nan yon ekstraksyon dirèk — kantite 1,213 egzamen an nan menm fraz la SE konfime pa tab matyè a. Tit “30 kou AP” la chita tou kont yon tab egzamen nan pwofil la ki liste 31 matyè diferan.

strings.text: The school publishes no comparison of its grading severity against local public schools, and no third party audits it. The quintile table and the mandatory-exam policy are the implicit answer; a direct inflation comparison is unpublished.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye okenn konparezon sou severite nòt li yo kont lekòl piblik lokal yo, epi pa gen okenn twazyèm pati ki fè odit sou li. Tab senkyèm nan ak politik egzamen obligatwa a se repons enplisit la; yon konparezon dirèk sou enflasyon nòt pa pibliye.

strings.text: The school’s own pages disagree on the size of the office: the College Guidance page describes five counselors each taking one fifth of a class, while the College Admission Representatives page says four. The roster supports five, and the “four” phrasing appears to predate the fifth hire — but Darren Morgan is absent from the profile’s contact block. Both figures are shown.
strings.t: Pwòp paj lekòl la pa dakò sou gwosè biwo a: paj College Guidance la dekri senk konseye ki chak pran yon senkyèm nan yon klas, pandan paj College Admission Representatives la di kat. Lis la sipòte senk, epi fraz “kat” la sanble li anvan anbochaj senkyèm nan — men Darren Morgan absan nan blòk kontak pwofil la. Nou montre tou de chif yo.

strings.text: The ~36:1 senior ratio and ~146:1 all-grades ratio are computed from the profile’s enrollment figures (730 Upper School, 178 seniors ÷ 5), not published by the school. Counselor credentials and prior admissions roles are aggregator-sourced.
strings.t: Rapò ~36:1 pou elèv dènye ane a ak rapò ~146:1 pou tout nivo yo kalkile apati chif enskripsyon pwofil la (730 Upper School, 178 elèv dènye ane ÷ 5), lekòl la pa pibliye yo. Kalifikasyon konseye yo ak ansyen wòl nan admisyon soti nan agregatè.

strings.text: The office does not publish a guarantee that every application is formally reviewed before submission, a codified Early Decision / Early Action strategy, a stated test-optional position, or FAFSA/CSS Profile timelines beyond the general “Paying for College” programming.
strings.t: Biwo a pa pibliye yon garanti ke yo revize chak aplikasyon fòmèlman anvan soumisyon, yon estrateji Early Decision / Early Action kodifye, yon pozisyon deklare sou tès opsyonèl, oswa kalandriye FAFSA/CSS Profile pi lwen pase pwogramasyon jeneral “Paying for College” la.

strings.text: Discrepancy: the admissions page cites $23M in merit scholarships for the Class of 2025 while the official Academic Profile states “over $20M” in scholarships for the same class. The wording differs too — the larger figure describes the narrower category, which suggests different compilation dates or methods rather than a clean nesting. Both are the school’s own numbers.
strings.t: Kontradiksyon: paj admisyon an site $23M nan bous merit pou Klas 2025 la pandan Academic Profile ofisyèl la deklare “plis pase $20M” nan bous pou menm klas la. Mo yo diferan tou — chif ki pi gwo a dekri kategori ki pi etwat la, sa ki sijere dat oswa metòd konpilasyon diferan olye ke yon anbwate ki pwòp. Tou de se pwòp chif lekòl la.

strings.text: this is an acceptance list, not a matriculation list — a four-year rolling aggregate in which a student admitted to twelve schools appears twelve times. Per-university enrollment counts are not published. Two further inconsistencies matter: the live page covers 2023–2026 while the profile PDF covers 2022–2025, and the two documents define bold differently (“more than one” member versus “one or more”), so bolding cannot be read consistently across them.
strings.t: sa a se yon lis moun yo aksepte, se pa yon lis moun ki enskri — yon total kontinyèl kat ane kote yon elèv yo admèt nan douz lekòl parèt douz fwa. Kantite enskripsyon pa inivèsite pa pibliye. De lòt kontradiksyon enpòtan: paj ki an dirèk la kouvri 2023–2026 pandan PDF pwofil la kouvri 2022–2025, epi de dokiman yo defini gra diferan (“plis pase yon” manm kont “youn oswa plis”), kidonk ou pa ka li gra a konsistan atravè yo.

strings.text: The Class of 2026 figure of 77 colleges is an ENROLLING count, while the Class of 2025 figure of 249 is an ACCEPTING count. They are not comparable and must not be read as a decline.
strings.t: Chif Klas 2026 la ki se 77 inivèsite se yon kantite ENSKRIPSYON, pandan chif Klas 2025 la ki se 249 se yon kantite AKSEPTE. Yo pa konparab epi ou pa dwe li yo kòm yon bès.

strings.text: Two levers work at once: the student builds a verifiable spike through nation-first diploma programmes and a required internship, and the Academic Profile makes the school’s disclosure do the vouching.
strings.t: De leviye travay an menm tan: elèv la bati yon espesyalite ou ka verifye atravè pwogram diplòm ki premye nan peyi a ak yon estaj obligatwa, epi Academic Profile la fè divilgasyon lekòl la sèvi kòm garanti.

strings.text: One is what your child brings; the other is the standing the building lends to the file.
strings.t: Youn se sa pitit ou pote; lòt la se estati batiman an prete dosye a.

strings.text: Lever 1 — Build the spike
strings.t: Leviye 1 — Bati espesyalite a

strings.text: **Global Studies Diploma** — “the first of its kind in the country”. Begins in 9th grade, requires a world language through all four years, globally-focused coursework, cross-cultural experience, an individual portfolio, and a lengthy research paper in the capstone Global Leadership course. **344 graduates since 2007**, 23 in the Class of 2026 alone.
strings.t: **Global Studies Diploma** — “premye nan kalite l nan peyi a”. Li kòmanse nan 9yèm ane, li egzije yon lang etranje pandan tout kat ane, kou ki konsantre sou mond lan, eksperyans ant kilti, yon pòtfèy endividyèl, ak yon long papye rechèch nan kou kapston Global Leadership la. **344 gradye depi 2007**, 23 nan sèl Klas 2026 la.

strings.text: **Diploma in Entrepreneurial Studies** — new for 2026, sitting inside IDEAS@PD (Innovation, Design, Entrepreneurship, Analytics, Sustainability) with industry-certification opportunities and business partnerships.
strings.t: **Diploma in Entrepreneurial Studies** — nouvo pou 2026, ki chita anndan IDEAS@PD (Innovation, Design, Entrepreneurship, Analytics, Sustainability) ak opòtinite pou sètifikasyon endistri ak patenarya biznis.

strings.text: **Required 30-hour Senior Project internship** — a graduation requirement, so every graduate leaves with a documented experiential credential. Notably the school has *no* community-service requirement, deliberately.
strings.t: **Estaj Senior Project 30 èdtan obligatwa** — yon kondisyon pou gradye, kidonk chak gradye pati ak yon kalifikasyon eksperyansyèl ki dokimante. Sa ki remakab, lekòl la *pa gen* okenn kondisyon sèvis kominotè, espre.

strings.text: **Recruiting & arts tracks** — “Facts About Athletic Recruiting” and “Studying the Arts in College” sessions run in alternating years. The Class of 2026 sent 31 student-athletes to college sport, 13 at Division I.
strings.t: **Pis rekritman ak atizay** — sesyon “Facts About Athletic Recruiting” ak “Studying the Arts in College” fèt an altènans chak ane. Klas 2026 la te voye 31 atlèt-elèv nan espò inivèsitè, 13 nan Division I.

strings.text: The Entrepreneurial Studies Diploma is announced but its course requirements, capstone and internship structure are not published — inquiries are directed to an email address. Compare Global Studies, which publishes both requirements and a 344-graduate throughput.
strings.t: Yo anonse Diplòm Entrepreneurial Studies la men kondisyon kou li yo, kapston an ak estrikti estaj li pa pibliye — yo voye kesyon yo nan yon adrès imèl. Konpare ak Global Studies, ki pibliye ni kondisyon yo ni yon rannman 344 gradye.

strings.text: Lever 2 — The school’s leverage
strings.t: Leviye 2 — Leviye lekòl la

strings.text: **The Academic Profile as an instrument** — an unusually disclosive document, and that is the leverage. It volunteers a full per-subject AP distribution across 31 subjects, a quintile table with mean SAT and ACT per fifth, explicit AP-load norms, and the weighting formula with unweighted grades on the transcript. It converts a no-rank policy from a liability into context.
strings.t: **Academic Profile la kòm yon zouti** — yon dokiman ki divilge anpil yon fason ki pa abityèl, epi se sa ki leviye a. Li bay volontèman yon distribisyon AP konplè pa matyè atravè 31 matyè, yon tab senkyèm ak SAT ak ACT mwayèn pa senkyèm, nòm chay AP eksplisit, ak fòmil pwa a ak nòt san pwa sou relve nòt la. Li konvèti yon politik san ran soti nan yon feblès rive nan yon kontèks.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — the school states it complies with the **NACAC Guide to Ethical Practice** and “reports all student behavioral probations, suspensions and expulsions through time of graduation” to any college that asks, backed by a student-run Honor Council. Disclosure earns reader trust, and that credibility accrues to every applicant.
strings.t: **Siyal sou entegrite** — lekòl la deklare li konfòm ak **NACAC Guide to Ethical Practice** epi li “rapòte tout pwobasyon konpòtman elèv, sispansyon ak ekspilsyon jiska moman gradyasyon” bay nenpòt inivèsite ki mande, sipòte pa yon Honor Council elèv yo dirije. Divilgasyon an genyen konfyans moun k ap li a, epi kredibilite sa a benefisye chak aplikan.

strings.text: **Repeat pipelines, numbered rather than implied** — the Class of 2025 scholar was Providence Day’s **18th Morehead-Cain**, a decades-deep pipeline to North Carolina’s most selective merit award. Bolded institutions across the list function as the de facto pipeline map, and four of the five federal service academies appear.
strings.t: **Rezo ki repete, ak chif olye ke sijere** — elèv Klas 2025 la se te **18yèm Morehead-Cain** Providence Day, yon rezo ki gen dè deseni pwofondè nan prim merit ki pi selektif North Carolina. Enstitisyon an gra atravè lis la fonksyone kòm kat rezo a defakto, epi kat nan senk akademi sèvis federal yo parèt.

strings.text: **Two-way relationships and memberships** — NAIS, NCAIS, SAIS, ERB, NACAC, SACAC, **ACCIS** and the College Board, accredited by SAIS and SACS, plus Global Online Academy. ~150 reps hosted against 50+ campuses visited is a genuine two-way cadence, and a deep UK/Europe pipeline (Oxford, St Andrews, UCL, LSE, Trinity Dublin, Bocconi, Toronto) matches the Global Studies identity.
strings.t: **Relasyon nan de sans ak manbraj** — NAIS, NCAIS, SAIS, ERB, NACAC, SACAC, **ACCIS** ak College Board, akredite pa SAIS ak SACS, plis Global Online Academy. ~150 reprezantan yo resevwa kont 50+ kanpis yo vizite se yon vrè ritm nan de sans, epi yon rezo UK/Ewòp pwofon (Oxford, St Andrews, UCL, LSE, Trinity Dublin, Bocconi, Toronto) matche ak idantite Global Studies la.

strings.text: No class rank — a published quintile table gives colleges rank-like context without pitting classmates against each other, so several students can present as top candidates.
strings.t: Pa gen ran nan klas — yon tab senkyèm ki pibliye bay inivèsite yo yon kontèks tankou yon ran san mete kanmarad klas kont youn lòt, kidonk plizyè elèv ka prezante kòm bon kandida.

strings.text: It is also the most analytically honest table the school prints: a 392-point SAT gap between the top and bottom fifths shows a large, academically heterogeneous class rather than a uniformly elite one.
strings.t: Se tab ki pi onèt sou plan analitik lekòl la enprime tou: yon diferans 392 pwen SAT ant senkyèm anwo a ak sa anba a montre yon gwo klas ki divès sou plan akademik olye ke youn ki elit inifòmman.

strings.text: All five quintiles are the school’s own published figures — nothing here is interpolated. Read the spread: 4.467 → 2.930 is a 1.54 weighted-GPA gap and 1445 → 1053 a 392-point SAT gap. Because AP adds a full point, a 3.891 weighted median is a mid-B-plus unweighted transcript with some honours load. Note the quintiles describe the Class of 2026 while the test scores above describe the Class of 2025 — different cohorts, so do not blend them.
strings.t: Tout senk senkyèm yo se pwòp chif lekòl la pibliye — pa gen anyen isit la ki entèpole. Li diferans lan: 4.467 → 2.930 se yon diferans GPA ak pwa 1.54 epi 1445 → 1053 yon diferans 392 pwen SAT. Paske AP ajoute yon pwen konplè, yon medyàn 3.891 ak pwa se yon relve nòt san pwa nan mitan B-plis ak kèk chay honours. Note senkyèm yo dekri Klas 2026 la pandan nòt tès ki anwo yo dekri Klas 2025 la — gwoup diferan, kidonk pa melanje yo.

strings.text: Learning Specialists at every division
strings.t: Espesyalis Aprantisaj nan chak divizyon

strings.text: Two are dedicated to the Upper School (Sarah Ramsden, Emily Young), working alongside school counselors Claire Bell and Marissa Kohn. The published role is helping students “become successful learners and self-advocates”.
strings.t: De dedye a Upper School la (Sarah Ramsden, Emily Young), k ap travay ansanm ak konseye lekòl Claire Bell ak Marissa Kohn. Wòl ki pibliye a se ede elèv “vin moun k ap aprann ak siksè epi ki ka defann tèt yo”.

strings.text: Why it matters
strings.t: Poukisa sa enpòtan

strings.text: Self-advocacy is precisely the skill the college transition demands. Specialists act as resource consultants to administrators, counselors, teachers and parents, and facilitate access to school-based and outside services.
strings.t: Defann tèt ou se presizeman konpetans tranzisyon nan inivèsite a mande. Espesyalis yo aji kòm konsiltan resous pou administratè, konseye, pwofesè ak paran, epi yo fasilite aksè a sèvis nan lekòl la ak deyò.

strings.text: Where it stops
strings.t: Kote li kanpe

strings.text: This is a **consultative** model, not a structured learning-differences programme — there is no published LD track, resource room, or accommodations-course structure. On-site occupational therapy exists; speech-language services are not published.
strings.t: Sa a se yon modèl **konsiltatif**, se pa yon pwogram estriktire pou diferans nan aprantisaj — pa gen okenn pis LD ki pibliye, sal resous, oswa estrikti kou ak akomodasyon. Terapi okipasyonèl egziste sou plas; sèvis lapawòl ak lang pa pibliye.

strings.text: How accommodations are documented for College Board / ACT testing, and how many students hold them, is not published — and the Student Services page returned a 404 during this research pass, so the named staff should be re-confirmed.
strings.t: Kijan yo dokimante akomodasyon pou tès College Board / ACT, ak konbyen elèv ki genyen yo, pa pibliye — epi paj Student Services la te bay yon 404 pandan pas rechèch sa a, kidonk ta dwe re-konfime estaf yo nonmen yo.

strings.text: The list matches the distribution
strings.t: Lis la matche ak distribisyon an

strings.text: The ~382-institution list spans Williams, MIT and Harvard down through Catawba, Brevard, Lees-McRae, Pfeiffer and Central Piedmont Community College — and crucially many accessible options are **bolded** as multi-enrollee: App State, East Carolina, UNC–Charlotte, UNC–Greensboro, Western Carolina, High Point, Wingate, Gardner-Webb, Belmont Abbey and Central Piedmont. The fourth and fifth quintiles are genuinely being placed, not just listed.
strings.t: Lis ~382 enstitisyon an kouvri Williams, MIT ak Harvard desann rive nan Catawba, Brevard, Lees-McRae, Pfeiffer ak Central Piedmont Community College — epi sa ki enpòtan, anpil opsyon aksesib **an gra** kòm lekòl ki gen plizyè elèv ki enskri: App State, East Carolina, UNC–Charlotte, UNC–Greensboro, Western Carolina, High Point, Wingate, Gardner-Webb, Belmont Abbey ak Central Piedmont. Yo vrèman ap plase katriyèm ak senkyèm senkyèm yo, se pa sèlman liste yo.

strings.text: Fit over prestige
strings.t: Sa ki apwopriye pi lwen pase prestij

strings.text: A named **Gap Year Fair** runs as standing programming, alongside the alternating athletic-recruiting and arts-in-college sessions.
strings.t: Yon **Gap Year Fair** ki gen non fèt kòm pwogramasyon pèmanan, ansanm ak sesyon rekritman atletik ak atizay nan inivèsite ki fèt an altènans.

strings.text: When direction changes
strings.t: Lè direksyon an chanje

strings.text: Conservatories (Berklee, RISD, Parsons, SAIC, SCAD, School of Visual Arts, UNCSA), four of the five federal service academies, and a deep international roster (Oxford, St Andrews, Edinburgh, UCL, LSE, King’s College London, Trinity Dublin, Leiden, Amsterdam, Bocconi, Toronto).
strings.t: Konsèvatwa (Berklee, RISD, Parsons, SAIC, SCAD, School of Visual Arts, UNCSA), kat nan senk akademi sèvis federal yo, ak yon lis entènasyonal pwofon (Oxford, St Andrews, Edinburgh, UCL, LSE, King’s College London, Trinity Dublin, Leiden, Amsterdam, Bocconi, Toronto).

strings.text: No breakdown of outcomes BY quintile is published — the table gives inputs (GPA, SAT, ACT per fifth) but never says where the middle and bottom fifths actually enroll. That is the single biggest gap in an otherwise unusually disclosive profile.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn dekoupaj rezilta PA senkyèm ki pibliye — tab la bay sa ki antre (GPA, SAT, ACT pa senkyèm) men li pa janm di kote senkyèm mitan yo ak sa anba yo enskri vre. Se pi gwo mank nan yon pwofil ki otreman divilge anpil yon fason ki pa abityèl.

strings.text: A mature, stable, high-touch college programme that delivers elite outcomes at the top and real placement through the middle — and hands colleges a transcript built to be trusted.
strings.t: Yon pwogram inivèsitè ki mi, estab, ak anpil kontak ki bay rezilta elit nan tèt la ak vrè plasman nan mitan an — epi ki bay inivèsite yo yon relve nòt bati pou yo fè l konfyans.

strings.text: The open questions are about the current year and the unpublished operational details — exactly what a campus visit answers.
strings.t: Kesyon ki rete yo se sou ane aktyèl la ak detay operasyonèl ki pa pibliye — egzakteman sa yon vizit sou kanpis la reponn.

strings.text: A transcript engineered to be readable
strings.t: Yon relve nòt fèt pou li ka li

strings.text: no rank, but a quintile table carrying mean GPA, SAT and ACT for each fifth, the exact weighting formula, and explicit AP-load norms. Most no-rank schools publish far less.
strings.t: pa gen ran, men yon tab senkyèm ki pote GPA, SAT ak ACT mwayèn pou chak senkyèm, fòmil pwa egzak la, ak nòm chay AP eksplisit. Pifò lekòl san ran pibliye anpil mwens.

strings.text: AP results strong and fully disclosed
strings.t: Rezilta AP solid epi divilge nèt

strings.text: 1,213 exams at 94% scoring 3+ and 77% at 4–5, with the complete per-subject distribution printed — weak spots included. Because the exam is mandatory, that 94% rests on a non-self-selected denominator.
strings.t: 1,213 egzamen ak 94% ki fè 3+ ak 77% nan 4–5, ak distribisyon konplè pa matyè ki enprime — pwen fèb yo enkli. Paske egzamen an obligatwa, 94% sa a chita sou yon baz kalkil kote elèv yo pa chwazi tèt yo.

strings.text: A deep, veteran, high-touch office
strings.t: Yon biwo pwofon, veteran, ak anpil kontak

strings.text: five counselors for 730 Upper Schoolers (~36 seniors each), an 18-year director, associate directors who came from inside university admissions, ~150 reps hosted and 50+ campuses visited.
strings.t: senk konseye pou 730 elèv Upper School (~36 elèv dènye ane chak), yon direktè ki gen 18 ane, direktè asosye ki soti anndan admisyon inivèsite, ~150 reprezantan yo resevwa ak 50+ kanpis yo vizite.

strings.text: Outcomes real at both ends of the class
strings.t: Rezilta reyèl nan tou de bout klas la

strings.text: 8 of 8 Ivies bolded as multi-enrollee — and accessible in-state options bolded too, right down to Central Piedmont Community College. The list matches the school’s actual quintile spread.
strings.t: 8 nan 8 Ivy an gra kòm lekòl ki gen plizyè elèv ki enskri — epi opsyon aksesib nan eta a an gra tou, desann rive nan Central Piedmont Community College. Lis la matche ak vrè diferans senkyèm lekòl la.

strings.text: the 18th Morehead-Cain Scholar, a QuestBridge Scholar at Stanford, two full-tuition ROTC awards and a West Point appointment — then $21M+ in merit offers to 82% of the Class of 2026.
strings.t: 18yèm Morehead-Cain Scholar la, yon QuestBridge Scholar nan Stanford, de prim ROTC ak frè eskolè konplè ak yon nominasyon nan West Point — apre sa $21M+ nan òf merit bay 82% nan Klas 2026 la.

strings.text: NACAC ethical-practice compliance plus a commitment to report all behavioral probations, suspensions and expulsions to any college that asks, backed by a student-run Honor Council.
strings.t: Konfòmite ak pratik etik NACAC plis yon angajman pou rapòte tout pwobasyon konpòtman, sispansyon ak ekspilsyon bay nenpòt inivèsite ki mande, sipòte pa yon Honor Council elèv yo dirije.

strings.text: Your profile shows the fifth quintile averaging a 1053 SAT and a 2.930 weighted GPA. Where did those ~35 students actually enroll last year?
strings.t: Pwofil ou a montre senkyèm senkyèm nan gen yon mwayèn 1053 SAT ak yon GPA ak pwa 2.930. Kote ~35 elèv sa yo te enskri vre ane pase?

strings.text: Is every application read before submission, and do you have a stated Early Decision / Early Action strategy?
strings.t: Èske yo li chak aplikasyon anvan soumisyon, epi èske w gen yon estrateji Early Decision / Early Action ki deklare?

strings.t: Ki pozisyon w sou tès opsyonèl, epi ki pòsyon nan klas ane pase a ki te soumèt nòt vre?

strings.text: Your pages say “five college counselors” in one place and “four” in another, and one name is missing from the profile’s contact block — who is on the team this year, and what is the current senior caseload?
strings.t: Paj ou yo di “senk konseye inivèsite” nan yon kote ak “kat” nan yon lòt, epi yon non manke nan blòk kontak pwofil la — kiyès ki nan ekip la ane sa a, epi ki chay elèv dènye ane aktyèl la?

strings.text: How are testing accommodations documented for College Board and ACT, how many Upper School students hold them, and is occupational therapy billed directly to families?
strings.t: Kijan yo dokimante akomodasyon pou tès College Board ak ACT, konbyen elèv Upper School ki genyen yo, epi èske yo faktire terapi okipasyonèl dirèkteman bay fanmi yo?

strings.text: The Entrepreneurial Studies Diploma is new for 2026 — what exactly does it require, and how many students have completed it?
strings.t: Diplòm Entrepreneurial Studies la nouvo pou 2026 — kisa egzakteman li egzije, epi konbyen elèv ki konplete l?

strings.text: Your 2025–26 profile still reports Class of 2024 National Merit numbers and a 2022–2025 acceptance list while the website shows 2023–2026. When is the profile refreshed, and which version are reps getting?
strings.t: Pwofil 2025–26 ou an toujou rapòte chif National Merit Klas 2024 ak yon lis aksepte 2022–2025 pandan sit la montre 2023–2026. Kilè yo mete pwofil la ajou, epi ki vèsyon reprezantan yo ap resevwa?

strings.text: Your admissions page says $23 million in merit scholarships for the Class of 2025; the official profile says over $20 million. Which is it, and what is counted in each?
strings.t: Paj admisyon ou an di $23 milyon nan bous merit pou Klas 2025 la; pwofil ofisyèl la di plis pase $20 milyon. Kiyès nan yo, epi kisa yo konte nan chak?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Charlotte Latin School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 45.5% over the last five entering classes — 334 acceptances from 734 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Charlotte Latin School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 45.5% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 334 admisyon sou 734 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 33.3% in Fall 2025 — 23 of 69 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 33.3% nan otòn 2025 — 23 sou 69 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: The Class of 2026 alone produced 12 Semifinalists — more than half the 20 recorded across the three preceding classes combined. Both figures are school-published and the surge is real per the sources, but the school does not explain it. Note too that the current profile reports Semifinalists and Commended only: it no longer reports Finalists, so Finalist counts for 2023, 2025 and 2026 are unpublished.
strings.t: Sèl Klas 2026 la pwodui 12 Semifinalis — plis pase mwatye nan 20 yo anrejistre atravè twa klas anvan yo ansanm. Tou de chif yo se lekòl la ki pibliye yo epi monte a reyèl dapre sous yo, men lekòl la pa esplike l. Note tou ke pwofil aktyèl la rapòte Semifinalis ak Commended sèlman: li pa rapòte Finalis ankò, kidonk kantite Finalis pou 2023, 2025 ak 2026 pa pibliye.

strings.text: The ceiling is **AP Calculus BC** — there is no multivariable calculus and no linear algebra. Honors Data Analytics and Honors Probability & Statistics run alongside rather than beyond it. A genuine ceiling worth noting.
strings.t: Plafon an se **AP Calculus BC** — pa gen kalkil miltivaryab epi pa gen aljèb lineyè. Honors Data Analytics ak Honors Probability & Statistics kouri akote olye ke pi lwen pase l. Yon vrè plafon ki vo lapèn note.

strings.text: **Honors Java Data Structures** sits beyond AP CS A, and **AP Cybersecurity 1: Networking Fundamentals** is a very new College Board offering and a real differentiator.

strings.text: The jump from 48 AP Scholars with Distinction (2018–20) to 193 (2023–25) is very large. Part is real growth, but the magnitude suggests the counting basis may differ between editions — the school does not define it. Do not present the two as directly comparable.
strings.t: Sote soti 48 AP Scholars with Distinction (2018–20) rive 193 (2023–25) trè gwo. Yon pati reyèl kwasans, men grandè a sijere baz konte a ka diferan ant edisyon yo — lekòl la pa defini l. Pa prezante de yo kòm dirèkteman konparab.

strings.text: The published 2025–26 profile contains an unedited internal editorial comment left in the live document — “We’ll need to somehow check to make sure all these students are still here, yes?” — verbatim in the file served from the school’s own resource manager. strings.t: Pwofil 2025–26 ki pibliye a gen yon kòmantè editoryal entèn ki pa edite ki rete nan dokiman ki an dirèk la — “N ap bezwen tcheke yon fason pou asire tout elèv sa yo toujou la, wi?” — mo pou mo nan fichye a lekòl la sèvi apati pwòp jesyonè resous li. strings.text: The merit-dollar total stopped being published after the Class of 2023 — the 2024, 2025 and 2026 write-ups carry no figure, and whether the school stopped collecting or stopped publishing it is unclear. Morehead-Cain attaches to the Class of 2022, outside this list’s window. QuestBridge, Robertson, Jefferson, Belk, Stamps and Coca-Cola were not found for any recent class; Robertson, Jefferson and Belk are attested only in a 2017–18 historical paragraph and should not be read as current pipelines.
strings.t: Total dola merit la sispann pibliye apre Klas 2023 la — rezime 2024, 2025 ak 2026 yo pa pote okenn chif, epi nou pa klè si lekòl la sispann ranmase l oswa sispann pibliye l. Morehead-Cain makonnen ak Klas 2022, ki deyò peryòd lis sa a. Nou pa t jwenn QuestBridge, Robertson, Jefferson, Belk, Stamps ak Coca-Cola pou okenn klas resan; Robertson, Jefferson ak Belk atèste sèlman nan yon paragraf istorik 2017–18 epi yo pa dwe li kòm rezo aktyèl.

strings.text: this is a three-year aggregate acceptance list, not a matriculation list. The asterisk means at least one student enrolled at that college at some point across the Classes of 2023–25 — it is not a count, and it does not mean a student enrolled from every class. 169 of the 300 institutions carry no asterisk at all. The window starts at 2023, matching the floor the other schools here share; the school publishes no Class of 2026 acceptance list yet, so the window does not extend that far forward. Note also that the “100% to four-year colleges” claim carried by all three archived profile editions has been REMOVED from the current one, with no explanation, so it should not be carried forward to the present class.
strings.t: sa a se yon lis aksepte ki total twa ane, se pa yon lis enskripsyon. Zetwal la vle di omwen yon elèv te enskri nan inivèsite sa a nan yon moman atravè Klas 2023–25 yo — se pa yon kantite, epi li pa vle di yon elèv te enskri soti nan chak klas. 169 nan 300 enstitisyon yo pa pote okenn zetwal ditou. Fenèt la kòmanse an 2023, ki menm ak piba lòt lekòl yo isit la pataje; lekòl la poko pibliye okenn lis aksepte Klas 2026, kidonk fenèt la pa pwolonje pi devan konsa. Note tou ke reklamasyon “100% nan inivèsite kat ane” tout twa edisyon pwofil achive yo te pote a RETIRE nan edisyon aktyèl la, san okenn eksplikasyon, kidonk li pa dwe pote pou klas aktyèl la.

strings.text: Latin’s differentiators are narrow, deep and genuinely elite in two places — a top-20 national debate programme and an MIT-lineage Fab Lab — and the school leaves the assembly of a spike almost entirely to the student.
strings.t: Sa ki fè Latin diferan etwat, pwofon epi vrèman elit nan de kote — yon pwogram deba nan top-20 nasyonal ak yon Fab Lab ki soti nan liyaj MIT — epi lekòl la kite konstriksyon yon espesyalite prèske nèt nan men elèv la.

strings.text: There is no required capstone or senior project that manufactures one, which makes the two flagship programmes carry more weight than they would elsewhere.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kapston oswa pwojè dènye ane obligatwa ki fabrike youn, sa ki fè de pwogram pòtdrapo yo pote plis pwa pase yo ta genyen lòt kote.

strings.text: **Speech & Debate — the strongest documented spike.** An NSDA **Debate School of Excellence Award**, one of the top 20 programmes in the country; NSDA **charter status**; **200 Club** membership in 2025. Director Bilal Butt has earned a second Diamond award with 30,000+ NSDA points over ten years. At 2025 Nationals, 7 debaters competed and 6 earned recognition against 6,700+ students — including a **5th place in Public Forum**.
strings.t: **Speech & Debate — espesyalite ki pi byen dokimante a.** Yon NSDA **Debate School of Excellence Award**, youn nan top 20 pwogram nan peyi a; **estati chat** NSDA; manbraj **200 Club** an 2025. Direktè Bilal Butt genyen yon dezyèm prim Diamond ak plis pase 30,000 pwen NSDA sou dis ane. Nan Nationals 2025, 7 debatè te konpetisyone epi 6 te genyen rekonesans kont plis pase 6,700 elèv — ki enkli yon **5yèm plas nan Public Forum**.

strings.text: **It is curricular, not merely a club.** The courses carry a competition mandate: the intro course requires participation in two tournaments a year, and the advanced course requires six.
strings.t: **Li kourikoulè, se pa senpleman yon klib.** Kou yo pote yon mandat konpetisyon: kou entwodiksyon an egzije patisipasyon nan de tounwa pa ane, epi kou avanse a egzije sis.

strings.text: **Innovation & Design / Fab Lab** — an official Fab Lab school in the lineage of **MIT’s Center for Bits and Atoms**, and an active Fab Academy node since 2016. Engineering has been taught here since 1989; the lab runs 3D printing, CNC milling, circuit production, laser and precision milling. Upper School courses are taught “like a professional software engineering firm”, with students presenting to external panels of industry experts.
strings.t: **Innovation & Design / Fab Lab** — yon lekòl Fab Lab ofisyèl nan liyaj **Center for Bits and Atoms MIT la**, epi yon nœud Fab Academy aktif depi 2016. Yo anseye enjenyri isit la depi 1989; laboratwa a fè enprime 3D, fresaj CNC, pwodiksyon sikwi, koupe ak lazè ak fresaj presi. Kou Upper School yo ansenye “tankou yon konpayi enjenyri lojisyèl pwofesyonèl”, ak elèv k ap prezante devan panèl ekstèn ekspè endistri.

strings.text: **Malone Scholars School** — North Carolina’s only one, endowed by the Malone Family Foundation, which selects 50 independent schools nationally partly for their “excellent accommodations for gifted and talented students”.
strings.t: **Malone Scholars School** — sèl la nan North Carolina, ak dotasyon nan men Malone Family Foundation, ki chwazi 50 lekòl endepandan nan tout peyi a an pati pou “akomodasyon eksèlan yo pou elèv dwe ak talan”.

strings.text: **Internships do exist**, contrary to a common assumption: a **Biomedical Internship Program** placing seniors with Atrium Health is course-embedded in Advanced Topics in Engineering, alongside a Student Internship Program elective.
strings.t: **Estaj egziste vre**, kontrèman ak yon sipozisyon komen: yon **Biomedical Internship Program** ki plase elèv dènye ane ak Atrium Health entegre nan kou Advanced Topics in Engineering, ansanm ak yon elektif Student Internship Program.

strings.text: There is still no required internship, capstone, senior project, independent study or school-wide research requirement — graduation requirements are purely credit-based, and there is no global-studies certificate or diploma. Athletic recruiting and arts-in-college support are informational programmes only: no named recruiting coordinator, highlight-film service, conservatory-prep track or portfolio review is published.
strings.t: Toujou pa gen estaj obligatwa, kapston, pwojè dènye ane, etid endepandan oswa kondisyon rechèch pou tout lekòl la — kondisyon gradyasyon yo se piman kredi, epi pa gen sètifika oswa diplòm nan etid mondyal. Sipò pou rekritman atletik ak atizay nan inivèsite se pwogram enfòmasyon sèlman: pa gen kòdonatè rekritman ki gen non, sèvis fim pwen enpòtan, pis preparasyon pou konsèvatwa oswa revizyon pòtfèy ki pibliye.

strings.text: **The School Profile works against itself.** It is the one document every admissions office reads, and Latin’s current edition omits the grading scale, the weighting statement, the class-rank policy, the CEEB code, the four-year matriculation percentage and all testing data — while carrying an unremoved internal editorial note in the live PDF.
strings.t: **School Profile la travay kont tèt li.** Se sèl dokiman chak biwo admisyon li, epi edisyon aktyèl Latin la kite deyò echèl nòt la, deklarasyon sou pwa a, politik ran nan klas la, kòd CEEB la, pousantaj enskripsyon kat ane a ak tout done tès yo — pandan li pote yon nòt editoryal entèn yo pa retire nan PDF ki an dirèk la.

strings.text: **The integrity block was deleted wholesale.** All three archived editions carried, verbatim: “Reflecting our emphasis on ‘HONOR ABOVE ALL,’ our policy is to report any **probations, suspensions, and expulsions through time of graduation** to any colleges that request this information. CLS complies with the **NACAC Statement of Principles of Good Practice**.” None of that survives into the current profile.
strings.t: **Blòk sou entegrite a te efase nèt.** Tout twa edisyon achive yo te pote, mo pou mo: “Ki reflete aksan nou sou ‘ONÈ ANWO TOUT BAGAY,’ politik nou se rapòte nenpòt **pwobasyon, sispansyon, ak ekspilsyon jiska moman gradyasyon** bay nenpòt inivèsite ki mande enfòmasyon sa a. CLS konfòm ak **NACAC Statement of Principles of Good Practice** la.” Anyen nan sa pa siviv nan pwofil aktyèl la.

strings.text: **Named-scholarship history was deleted too.** The 2017–18 edition told readers the school’s students had won Morehead-Cain, Robertson, B.N. Duke, Jefferson, Belk, Bryan, Chancellor’s, Danforth and Johnson scholarships, and gave application and matriculation breadth. Not one of those sentences survives.
strings.t: **Istwa bous ki gen non yo te efase tou.** Edisyon 2017–18 la te di moun k ap li ke elèv lekòl la te genyen bous Morehead-Cain, Robertson, B.N. Duke, Jefferson, Belk, Bryan, Chancellor’s, Danforth ak Johnson, epi li te bay etandi aplikasyon ak enskripsyon. Pa gen yon sèl nan fraz sa yo ki siviv.

strings.text: **What remains is genuine and external** — the NSDA recognition, the Fab Academy node, and the Malone Family Foundation selection are all third-party validations that do not depend on the profile.
strings.t: **Sa ki rete a otantik epi ekstèn** — rekonesans NSDA a, nœud Fab Academy a, ak seleksyon Malone Family Foundation la tout se validasyon twazyèm pati ki pa depann de pwofil la.

strings.text: The net effect is a school whose real institutional strengths are verifiable elsewhere but are no longer argued for in the document colleges actually read.
strings.t: Rezilta nèt la se yon lekòl ki gen vrè fòs enstitisyonèl ou ka verifye lòt kote men ki pa defann yo ankò nan dokiman inivèsite yo li vre a.

strings.text: An unsourced reference to a 2018 national debate champion surfaced during research but could not be corroborated against speechanddebate.org, so it is deliberately excluded here rather than repeated.
strings.t: Yon referans san sous sou yon chanpyon nasyonal deba 2018 te parèt pandan rechèch la men nou pa t kapab koroboure l kont speechanddebate.org, kidonk nou eskli l espre isit la olye ke repete l.

strings.text: Latin publishes almost no class-level analytics — no SAT, no ACT, no AP score distribution, no GPA distribution, and no rank, quintile or decile table.
strings.t: Latin pibliye prèske okenn analiz nan nivo klas la — pa gen SAT, pa gen ACT, pa gen distribisyon nòt AP, pa gen distribisyon GPA, ak pa gen tab ran, senkyèm oswa dizyèm.

strings.text: The absence is the finding, and it cuts both ways: it protects students in the middle of the class from unflattering comparison, and it removes every quantitative lever a strong student might otherwise use to stand out.
strings.t: Absans lan se konklizyon an, epi li koupe nan de sans: li pwoteje elèv nan mitan klas la kont konparezon ki pa bon pou yo, epi li retire chak leviye kantitatif yon elèv solid ta ka sèvi pou l parèt.

strings.text: Learning Resources, founded 1985
strings.t: Learning Resources, fonde 1985

strings.text: A real programme with a long history — a K–12 Director plus LR teachers in each division, admission based on a psychoeducational evaluation demonstrating learning differences that impact achievement.
strings.t: Yon vrè pwogram ak yon long istwa — yon Direktè K–12 plis pwofesè LR nan chak divizyon, ak admisyon ki baze sou yon evalyasyon sikoedikatif ki demontre diferans nan aprantisaj ki afekte reyisit.

strings.text: The Upper School model is coaching, not remediation
strings.t: Modèl Upper School la se antrènman, se pa remediyasyon

strings.text: Verbatim: in the Upper School the programme “becomes more of a **consultative and coaching model**”, working on executive functioning — organisation, time management, study strategies. Lower School LR is explicitly remedial; the Upper School is not. Decisive for a family whose 9–12 student needs direct intervention.
strings.t: Mo pou mo: nan Upper School pwogram nan “vin plis yon **modèl konsiltatif ak antrènman**”, k ap travay sou fonksyon egzekitif — òganizasyon, jesyon tan, estrateji etid. LR Lower School eksplisitman remedyal; Upper School la pa ye. Desizif pou yon fanmi ki gen yon elèv 9–12 ki bezwen entèvansyon dirèk.

strings.text: Accommodations and cost
strings.t: Akomodasyon ak depans

strings.text: Middle and Upper School students who qualify have a **504 Educational Plan**, with testing current within three years; typical accommodations include extended time and testing in a separate setting. Critically, **charges for sessions are not included in tuition and are billed per session each month**.
strings.t: Elèv Middle ak Upper School ki kalifye gen yon **504 Educational Plan**, ak tès ki dwe pa gen plis pase twa ane; akomodasyon tipik enkli tan pwolonje ak tès nan yon anviwònman apa. Sa ki enpòtan, **frè pou sesyon yo pa enkli nan frè eskolè a epi yo faktire yo pa sesyon chak mwa**.

strings.text: Do not confuse ATSS with Learning Resources
strings.t: Pa konfonn ATSS ak Learning Resources

strings.text: The Office of Academic Transition and Student Success is a **transition and belonging office** for students new to independent schools, particularly from underrepresented backgrounds. Its page never mentions learning differences, 504 plans or accommodations. A student with dyslexia who is neither new to Latin nor from an underrepresented background falls outside its stated population entirely.
strings.t: Office of Academic Transition and Student Success la se yon **biwo tranzisyon ak apatenans** pou elèv ki nouvo nan lekòl endepandan, sitou sa yo ki soti nan gwoup ki pa byen reprezante. Paj li a pa janm mansyone diferans nan aprantisaj, plan 504 oswa akomodasyon. Yon elèv ki gen disleksi ki ni nouvo nan Latin ni ki soti nan yon gwoup ki pa byen reprezante tonbe nèt deyò popilasyon li deklare a.

strings.text: The published-invisibility problem, verified directly: every descriptive Learning Resources page on the live site now 404s, and the “Learning Resources” tile on the Student Support and Wellness page is an href="#" anchor with no body copy. The 1985 founding, the coaching model, the 504 process and the per-session billing survive only in archived captures — so a prospective family researching learning support today finds a tile that links nowhere. Upper School LR staffing levels and the number of students served are unpublished, and whether Margaret Sigmon is still Director could not be confirmed.
strings.t: Pwoblèm envizibilite nan piblikasyon an, verifye dirèkteman: chak paj deskriptif Learning Resources sou sit ki an dirèk la kounye a bay 404, epi mozayik “Learning Resources” sou paj Student Support and Wellness la se yon ankraj href="#" san okenn tèks. Fondasyon 1985 la, modèl antrènman an, pwosesis 504 la ak faktirasyon pa sesyon an siviv sèlman nan kaptè achive — kidonk yon fanmi ki enterese k ap fè rechèch sou sipò aprantisaj jodi a jwenn yon mozayik ki pa mennen okenn kote. Nivo estaf LR Upper School la ak kantite elèv yo sèvi pa pibliye, epi nou pa t kapab konfime si Margaret Sigmon toujou Direktè.

strings.text: Breadth is the only available proxy
strings.t: Etandi se sèl apwoksimasyon ki disponib

strings.text: Because no GPA or test distribution exists, the 300-institution list is the sole evidence — and it is genuinely broad, spanning Harvard, MIT and Stanford through Belhaven, Brevard, Catawba, Carson-Newman, Lenoir-Rhyne, Methodist, Saint Leo, Trevecca Nazarene, Wingate and Johnson & Wales, many carrying matriculation asterisks.
strings.t: Paske pa gen distribisyon GPA oswa tès ki egziste, lis 300 enstitisyon an se sèl prèv la — epi li vrèman laj, ki kouvri Harvard, MIT ak Stanford rive nan Belhaven, Brevard, Catawba, Carson-Newman, Lenoir-Rhyne, Methodist, Saint Leo, Trevecca Nazarene, Wingate ak Johnson & Wales, ak anpil ki pote zetwal enskripsyon.

strings.text: The regional band is real
strings.t: Bann rejyonal la reyèl

strings.text: Every UNC-system campus on the list carries a matriculation asterisk, so Latin visibly places students across the whole band rather than only at the top.
strings.t: Chak kanpis nan sistèm UNC sou lis la pote yon zetwal enskripsyon, kidonk Latin vizibman plase elèv atravè tout bann nan olye ke sèlman nan tèt la.

strings.text: Non-traditional destinations
strings.t: Destinasyon ki pa tradisyonèl

strings.text: Service academies including a 2025 Air Force Academy appointment, conservatory and arts institutions, and international universities all appear on the list.
strings.t: Akademi sèvis ki enkli yon nominasyon nan Air Force Academy an 2025, enstitisyon konsèvatwa ak atistik, ak inivèsite entènasyonal tout parèt sou lis la.

strings.text: No SAT, ACT, AP-distribution, GPA-distribution or rank table is published. Latin asks colleges to trust its transcript while supplying no distributional context to calibrate it — its own candid maths-placement note is one of the very few interpretive aids a reader is given.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn tab SAT, ACT, distribisyon AP, distribisyon GPA oswa ran ki pibliye. Latin mande inivèsite yo pou yo fè relve nòt li konfyans pandan li pa bay okenn kontèks distribisyon pou kalibre l — pwòp nòt fran li sou plasman matematik la se youn nan trè kèk èd entèpretasyon yon moun k ap li jwenn.

strings.text: The testing data disappeared in two stages, not one: SAT and ACT results were already absent from the 2019–20 and 2020–21 editions, so the loss happened between 2017–18 and 2019–20. This is a long-standing posture, NOT a recent test-optional-era change, and should not be described as a new development.
strings.t: Done tès la te disparèt an de etap, se pa youn: rezilta SAT ak ACT te deja absan nan edisyon 2019–20 ak 2020–21 yo, kidonk pèt la te fèt ant 2017–18 ak 2019–20. Sa a se yon pozisyon ki la depi lontan, se PA yon chanjman resan nan epòk tès opsyonèl la, epi li pa dwe dekri kòm yon devlopman nouvo.

strings.text: Genuinely elite in two narrow places — debate and design engineering — with a stable, unusually well-staffed counseling office, wrapped in the least transparent profile in this set.
strings.t: Vrèman elit nan de kote etwat — deba ak enjenyri konsepsyon — ak yon biwo konsèy estab ak byen estafe yon fason ki pa abityèl, vlope nan pwofil ki mwens transparan nan gwoup sa a.

strings.text: Almost every open question here is answerable in one conversation, because the information exists; the school simply no longer publishes it.
strings.t: Prèske chak kesyon ki rete isit la ka reponn nan yon sèl konvèsasyon, paske enfòmasyon an egziste; lekòl la senpleman pa pibliye l ankò.

strings.text: Two externally validated flagship programmes
strings.t: De pwogram pòtdrapo ki valide depi deyò

strings.text: an NSDA top-20 debate programme with charter and 200 Club status and a 5th-place national finish, and an MIT-lineage Fab Lab running an active Fab Academy node since 2016. Neither validation depends on the school’s own marketing.
strings.t: yon pwogram deba NSDA nan top-20 ak estati chat ak 200 Club ak yon 5yèm plas nasyonal, ak yon Fab Lab nan liyaj MIT k ap fè yon nœud Fab Academy aktif depi 2016. Ni youn ni lòt validasyon pa depann de pwòp maketing lekòl la.

strings.text: An unusually well-staffed counseling office
strings.t: Yon biwo konsèy ki byen estafe yon fason ki pa abityèl

strings.text: nine people for 145 seniors, including **three dedicated essay specialists** — a role most peer offices simply do not have — with counselors assigned in freshman year.
strings.t: nèf moun pou 145 elèv dènye ane, ki enkli **twa espesyalis dedye pou redaksyon** — yon wòl pifò biwo parèy senpleman pa genyen — ak konseye yo asiyen nan premye ane.

strings.text: A written commitment peers avoid
strings.t: Yon angajman alekri lekòl parèy evite

strings.text: the office states it proofreads each essay and application before submission. Most schools describe workshops and meetings but stop short of promising a review.
strings.t: biwo a deklare li korije chak redaksyon ak aplikasyon anvan soumisyon. Pifò lekòl dekri atelye ak reyinyon men yo kanpe anvan yo pwomèt yon revizyon.

strings.text: Low turnover at the top
strings.t: Ti woulman nan tèt la

strings.text: three of the four counselors, including the director, are documented in the same office as far back as the 2017–18 profile.
strings.t: twa nan kat konseye yo, ki enkli direktè a, dokimante nan menm biwo a depi lwen ke pwofil 2017–18 la.

strings.text: Placement breadth across the whole class
strings.t: Etandi plasman atravè tout klas la

strings.text: 300 institutions across three classes with 62 of the 68 Power Four universities represented, and matriculation asterisks spread from the Ivies down through the regional band.
strings.t: 300 enstitisyon atravè twa klas ak 62 nan 68 inivèsite Power Four yo reprezante, ak zetwal enskripsyon ki gaye soti nan Ivy yo desann atravè bann rejyonal la.

strings.text: The exam requirement is real
strings.t: Kondisyon egzamen an reyèl

strings.text: students in AP classes must sit the exam, and four APs are deliberately open-enrollment rather than faculty-gated — so access is broader than the placement gate alone suggests.
strings.t: elèv nan klas AP dwe pase egzamen an, epi kat AP espre gen enskripsyon lib olye ke pwofesè kontwole yo — kidonk aksè a pi laj pase sa pòtay plasman an pou kont li sijere.

strings.text: Your profile publishes no SAT, ACT or AP score data. What were the last class’s middle-50% SAT and ACT ranges, how many students tested, and what share of AP exams scored 3 or higher?
strings.t: Pwofil ou a pa pibliye okenn done SAT, ACT oswa nòt AP. Ki ranje mitan-50% SAT ak ACT dènye klas la, konbyen elèv ki te pase tès, epi ki pòsyon nan egzamen AP yo ki te fè 3 oswa pi wo?

strings.text: The current profile no longer states your grading scale, your weighting, or whether you report class rank. Do AP and Honors still carry one additional quality point, and do you rank?
strings.t: Pwofil aktyèl la pa di echèl nòt ou a ankò, pwa ou a, oswa si w rapòte ran nan klas. Èske AP ak Honors toujou pote yon pwen kalite anplis, epi èske w bay ran?

strings.text: Is there a GPA distribution — quintiles or deciles — that you share with colleges even though it is not in the published profile?
strings.t: Èske gen yon distribisyon GPA — senkyèm oswa dizyèm — ke w pataje ak inivèsite yo menm si li pa nan pwofil ki pibliye a?

strings.text: Who is the current Director of Learning Resources, how many LR staff work with Upper School students, and what does a session cost, since it is billed outside tuition?
strings.t: Kiyès ki Direktè Learning Resources aktyèl la, konbyen estaf LR k ap travay ak elèv Upper School, epi konbyen yon sesyon koute, paske yo faktire l deyò frè eskolè a?

strings.text: Every Learning Resources page on your website 404s and the tile links nowhere. Where should a family with a diagnosed learning difference actually go for information?
strings.t: Chak paj Learning Resources sou sit ou a bay 404 epi mozayik la pa mennen okenn kote. Kote yon fanmi ki gen yon diferans nan aprantisaj ki dyagnostike ta dwe ale vre pou enfòmasyon?

strings.text: Your published profile contains an unremoved internal editorial note. Who reviews that document before it goes to colleges, and when is it next refreshed?
strings.t: Pwofil ou pibliye a gen yon nòt editoryal entèn yo pa retire. Kiyès ki revize dokiman sa a anvan li ale nan inivèsite yo, epi kilè yo pral mete l ajou?

strings.text: Columbia, Princeton and Penn do not appear anywhere on the 2023–25 acceptance list. Is that accurate, and how do you read it?
strings.t: Columbia, Princeton ak Penn pa parèt okenn kote sou lis aksepte 2023–25 la. Èske sa egzak, epi kijan ou li l?

strings.text: You stopped publishing merit-scholarship totals after the Class of 2023. What did the last three classes receive?
strings.t: Ou te sispann pibliye total bous merit yo apre Klas 2023 la. Kisa twa dènye klas yo te resevwa?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Charlotte Christian School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 54.8% over the last five entering classes — 382 acceptances from 697 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Charlotte Christian School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 54.8% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 382 admisyon sou 697 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 26.3% in Fall 2025 — 10 of 38 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 26.3% nan otòn 2025 — 10 sou 38 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 382 of 697 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 382 sou 697 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 10 of 38, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 10 sou 38, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: drew the most applications in Fall 2025 (38)
strings.t: te resevwa plis aplikasyon nan otòn 2025 (38)

strings.text: Students in AP classes are required to sit the exam, and 89% of 2024’s exams scored 3 or higher — a rate earned on a mandated rather than self-selected pool.
strings.t: Elèv nan klas AP oblije pase egzamen an, epi 89% nan egzamen 2024 yo te fè 3 oswa pi wo — yon to yo genyen sou yon gwoup ki obligatwa olye ke ki chwazi tèt li.

strings.text: Charlotte Christian publishes the fullest AP dashboard in this set: exams, students, pass counts and a full AP Scholar breakdown, two years deep. Four credits of Biblical Studies are the transcript’s defining signature.
strings.t: Charlotte Christian pibliye tablo AP ki pi konplè nan gwoup sa a: egzamen, elèv, kantite ki pase ak yon dekoupaj AP Scholar konplè, de ane pwofondè. Kat kredi Biblical Studies se siyati ki defini relve nòt la.

strings.text: AP exams taken in 2024 (151 students)
strings.t: egzamen AP yo pase an 2024 (151 elèv)

strings.text: of exams scored 3+ — up from 78% in 2021
strings.t: nan egzamen yo te fè 3+ — monte soti 78% an 2021

strings.text: AP Scholar awards in 2024 · 203 across 2023–25
strings.t: prim AP Scholar an 2024 · 203 atravè 2023–25

strings.text: a published five-quintile GPA table stands in
strings.t: yon tab GPA senk senkyèm ki pibliye ranplase l

strings.text: **14** Finalists · **48** Commended Scholars
strings.t: **14** Finalis · **48** Commended Scholars

strings.text: **16** Finalists · **45** Commended Scholars
strings.t: **16** Finalis · **45** Commended Scholars

strings.text: **1** Commended Scholar (Jack Krause) — press separately names a Semifinalist the school does not list
strings.t: **1** Commended Scholar (Jack Krause) — près la nonmen apa yon Semifinalis lekòl la pa liste

strings.text: **4** College Board National Recognition awards — 1 African American, 3 Hispanic (Class of 2024: 5)
strings.t: **4** prim College Board National Recognition — 1 Afriken-Ameriken, 3 Hispanic (Klas 2024: 5)

strings.text: Both National Merit figures are rolling 15-year windows, which is why the Finalist count can fall from 16 to 14 while Commended rises from 45 to 48 — strong older years drop out of the window. That is arithmetically possible rather than an error, but the school does not explain it, and no per-class-year ledger is published in any edition.
strings.t: Tou de chif National Merit yo se peryòd kontinyèl 15 ane, epi se poutèt sa kantite Finalis la ka tonbe soti 16 rive 14 pandan Commended monte soti 45 rive 48 — bon ane pi ansyen yo sòti nan peryòd la. Sa posib sou plan aritmetik olye ke yon erè, men lekòl la pa esplike l, epi pa gen okenn lis pa ane klas ki pibliye nan okenn edisyon.

strings.text: **Calculus III** is genuine post-AP depth — multivariable and vector-valued functions, curvature, double and triple integrals, vector analysis and differential equations. It requires a 93% in AP Calculus AB or completion of BC.
strings.t: **Calculus III** se vrè pwofondè pòs-AP — fonksyon miltivaryab ak vektoryèl, koubi, entegral doub ak tripl, analiz vektoryèl ak ekwasyon diferansyèl. Li egzije yon 93% nan AP Calculus AB oswa konplesyon BC.

strings.text: Physics
strings.t: Fizik

strings.text: Calculus III is paired on the profile with **AP Physics C: Electricity & Magnetism**, alongside AP Physics C: Mechanics.
strings.t: Calculus III makonnen sou pwofil la ak **AP Physics C: Electricity & Magnetism**, ansanm ak AP Physics C: Mechanics.

strings.text: **Thin.** A single AP Computer Science appears in the 2021–22 profile, and the current curriculum page lists no dedicated Upper School computer-science courses at all — coding work sits in Middle School electives, alongside a VEX robotics team.
strings.t: **Mens.** Yon sèl AP Computer Science parèt nan pwofil 2021–22 la, epi paj kourikoulòm aktyèl la pa liste okenn kou syans enfòmatik Upper School dedye ditou — travay kodaj la chita nan elektif Middle School, ansanm ak yon ekip robotik VEX.

strings.text: AP French, AP Spanish Language, **AP Spanish Literature** and AP Latin, over Honors ladders running to level IV. No post-AP language seminar is published.
strings.t: AP French, AP Spanish Language, **AP Spanish Literature** ak AP Latin, sou nechèl Honors ki kouri rive nan nivo IV. Pa gen okenn seminè lang pòs-AP ki pibliye.

strings.text: **Winterim** supplies internships and travel. The school states plainly that it does **not maintain a formal dual-enrolment programme**.
strings.t: **Winterim** bay estaj ak vwayaj. Lekòl la deklare klèman li **pa kenbe yon pwogram enskripsyon doub fòmèl**.

strings.text: Weighted — and deliberately halved
strings.t: Ak pwa — epi espre koupe an de

strings.text: **+0.5 for Honors, +1.0 for AP** on a 4.0 base. Note the school **halved its weighting** with the Class of 2019, down from +1.0 and +2.0, so any pre-2019 GPA is not comparable to a current one.
strings.t: **+0.5 pou Honors, +1.0 pou AP** sou yon baz 4.0. Note lekòl la te **koupe pwa li a an de** ak Klas 2019 la, soti nan +1.0 ak +2.0, kidonk nenpòt GPA anvan 2019 pa konparab ak yon GPA aktyèl.

strings.text: No rank → a five-quintile table
strings.t: Pa gen ran → yon tab senk senkyèm

strings.text: “Charlotte Christian School does not rank its students”, stated flatly in both profiles — but a full five-quintile GPA table through the sixth semester is published every year, letting colleges locate a band without a rank.
strings.t: “Charlotte Christian School pa bay elèv li yo ran”, deklare klèman nan tou de pwofil yo — men yo pibliye yon tab GPA senk senkyèm konplè jiska sizyèm semès la chak ane, sa ki pèmèt inivèsite yo jwenn yon bann san yon ran.

strings.text: A Christian-specific load signature
strings.t: Yon siyati chay ki espesifik a lafwa kretyen

strings.text: Graduation requires **27 credits including 4 of Biblical Studies**, plus a January Term credit and a half-credit Junior Seminar. Those four credits consume elective space peer schools spend elsewhere, and they are the transcript’s most distinctive feature.
strings.t: Gradyasyon egzije **27 kredi ki enkli 4 nan Biblical Studies**, plis yon kredi January Term ak yon Junior Seminar demi kredi. Kat kredi sa yo pran espas elektif lekòl parèy yo depanse lòt kote, epi yo se karakteristik ki pi distenktif nan relve nòt la.

strings.text: The school markets “45+ AP and honors courses” while roughly 23 AP courses can actually be enumerated from its published materials. Both figures come from the school; the enumerable count is the verifiable one.
strings.t: Lekòl la fè piblisite pou “45+ kou AP ak honors” pandan apeprè 23 kou AP ka vrèman konte apati materyèl li pibliye. Tou de chif yo soti nan men lekòl la; kantite ou ka konte a se sa ou ka verifye a.

strings.text: Press coverage of the 71st National Merit competition names a Class of 2025 Semifinalist who appears neither in the school’s own National Merit block nor in its senior enrollment roster, which lists only a Commended Scholar. The two sources are inconsistent about who the honorees were.
strings.t: Kouvèti près la sou 71yèm konkou National Merit la nonmen yon Semifinalis Klas 2025 ki pa parèt ni nan pwòp blòk National Merit lekòl la ni nan lis enskripsyon elèv dènye ane li a, ki liste sèlman yon Commended Scholar. De sous yo pa dakò sou kiyès moun yo te onore yo.

strings.text: Only the 3+ threshold is reported — the share of exams scoring 4 or 5 is not published in any year, so no 4–5 rate should be inferred. “Most rigorous” course-load norms are likewise undefined: there is no published rubric and no statement of what fraction of students take the most demanding programme.
strings.t: Se sèlman sèy 3+ la ki rapòte — pòsyon egzamen ki fè 4 oswa 5 la pa pibliye nan okenn ane, kidonk ou pa dwe dedwi okenn to 4–5. Nòm chay kou “pi rijid la” pa defini menm jan an: pa gen okenn rubrik ki pibliye ak okenn deklarasyon sou ki fraksyon elèv ki pran pwogram ki pi egzijan an.

strings.text: Two college counselors split the alphabet and carry all four grades each — roughly 47 seniors apiece — under a director who has held the seat at least four years.
strings.t: De konseye inivèsite divize alfabè a epi chak pote tout kat nivo yo — apeprè 47 elèv dènye ane chak — anba yon direktè ki nan pòs la omwen kat ane.

strings.text: The distinctive structure is Junior Seminar: a required, graded half-credit course with a mock admission committee and two mandatory college visits, rather than an optional evening programme.
strings.t: Estrikti ki distenktif la se Junior Seminar: yon kou obligatwa ak nòt demi kredi ak yon komite admisyon similye ak de vizit inivèsite obligatwa, olye ke yon pwogram aswè opsyonèl.

strings.text: seniors per counselor (derived — no ratio is published)
strings.t: elèv dènye ane pa konseye (derive — pa gen rapò ki pibliye)

strings.text: college counselors — Foxx takes K–Z, Miller A–J
strings.t: konseye inivèsite — Foxx pran K–Z, Miller A–J

strings.text: 0.5 credit
strings.t: 0.5 kredi

strings.text: Junior Seminar is a graded graduation requirement
strings.t: Junior Seminar se yon kondisyon gradyasyon ak nòt

strings.text: Scoir
strings.t: Scoir

strings.text: platform — not Naviance
strings.t: platfòm — se pa Naviance

strings.text: Director of College Counseling in both the 2021–22 and 2024–25 profiles — at least four years in the role. Students K–Z.
strings.t: Direktè College Counseling nan pwofil 2021–22 ak 2024–25 tou de — omwen kat ane nan wòl la. Elèv K–Z.

strings.text: College Counselor

strings.text: Both ratios are derived — 435 Upper Schoolers ÷ 2 gives ~218:1 across all four grades, and 94 seniors ÷ 2 gives ~47:1. The school publishes neither. Because the split is alphabetical, each counselor genuinely carries all four grades, so the 218:1 figure is the honest load measure and 47:1 describes senior-year intensity. The two personal counselors are not college counselors and do not belong in the denominator.
strings.t: Tou de rapò yo derive — 435 elèv Upper School ÷ 2 bay ~218:1 atravè tout kat nivo yo, epi 94 elèv dènye ane ÷ 2 bay ~47:1. Lekòl la pa pibliye ni youn ni lòt. Paske separasyon an alfabetik, chak konseye vrèman pote tout kat nivo yo, kidonk chif 218:1 la se mezi chay onèt la epi 47:1 dekri entansite dènye ane a. De konseye pèsonèl yo se pa konseye inivèsite epi yo pa fè pati baz kalkil la.

strings.text: One Upper School counselor appears as “Olivia McCarrick” on the 2024–25 profile and “Olivia Brilhante” on the counseling brochure and Student Counseling page. Most likely the same person following a name change, but the school publishes both and it is not confirmed. The Upper School Principal is likewise listed as two different people across sources.
strings.t: Yon konseye Upper School parèt kòm “Olivia McCarrick” sou pwofil 2024–25 la ak “Olivia Brilhante” sou bwochi konsèy la ak paj Student Counseling la. Gen anpil chans se menm moun nan apre yon chanjman non, men lekòl la pibliye tou de epi sa pa konfime. Direktè Upper School la menm jan an liste kòm de moun diferan atravè sous yo.

strings.text: No counselor tenure, prior employer or professional background is published for anyone on the team, and no bios appear on the college counseling page. Neither rep-visit counts nor counselor campus-visit counts are published.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn ansyènte konseye, ansyen patwon oswa background pwofesyonèl ki pibliye pou okenn moun nan ekip la, epi pa gen byografi ki parèt sou paj konsèy inivèsite a. Ni kantite vizit reprezantan ni kantite vizit kanpis konseye yo pa pibliye.
