strings.text: The Class of 2025 total is printed in the school’s own Celebrating Seniors booklet as “$6,400,00” — a digit is missing, and the school’s website renders the same figure as “more than $6.4 million”, which is used here. Publishing roughly ninety individually named awards is unusually granular. Morehead-Cain, QuestBridge and ROTC outcomes are not published, and no federal service academy appears on either list.
strings.t: Total Klas 2025 la enprime nan pwòp bwochi Celebrating Seniors lekòl la kòm “$6,400,00” — yon chif manke, epi sit lekòl la afiche menm chif la kòm “plis pase $6.4 milyon”, ki se sa nou sèvi isit la. Pibliye apeprè katrevendis prim ki nonmen endividyèlman se granilè yon fason ki pa abityèl. Morehead-Cain, QuestBridge ak rezilta ROTC pa pibliye, epi pa gen okenn akademi sèvis federal ki parèt sou ni youn ni lòt lis.

strings.text: this is an acceptance list across three graduating classes, not a matriculation list. The asterisk marks enrollment for the Class of 2025 only — and Duke, Cornell, Georgetown, Notre Dame, Emory, USC, UVA, Michigan, William & Mary, Colby and Boston College all carry no asterisk, meaning no Class of 2025 graduate enrolled at any of them. The most selective actual enrollments were Dartmouth (a football signee), Davidson (a golf signee), NYU (the valedictorian) and UNC–Chapel Hill (five students). The window starts at 2023, matching the floor the other schools here share; the Class of 2026 has not yet been published as a graduating class, so no 2026 acceptance list exists to extend it forward.
strings.t: sa a se yon lis aksepte atravè twa klas ki gradye, se pa yon lis enskripsyon. Zetwal la make enskripsyon pou Klas 2025 la sèlman — epi Duke, Cornell, Georgetown, Notre Dame, Emory, USC, UVA, Michigan, William & Mary, Colby ak Boston College tout pa pote okenn zetwal, sa ki vle di okenn gradye Klas 2025 pa t enskri nan okenn nan yo. Enskripsyon reyèl ki pi selektif yo se te Dartmouth (yon moun ki siyen nan foutbòl), Davidson (yon moun ki siyen nan gòlf), NYU (elèv ki pi bon an) ak UNC–Chapel Hill (senk elèv). Fenèt la kòmanse an 2023, ki menm ak piba lòt lekòl yo isit la pataje; Klas 2026 la poko pibliye kòm yon klas ki gradye, kidonk pa gen okenn lis aksepte 2026 ki egziste pou pwolonje l pi devan.

strings.text: The school claims “99% attend a four-year college”, but its own named Class of 2025 roster shows about five of 94 graduates at a community college, a real-estate school, in childcare or taking a postgraduate year — closer to 95%. Both are the school’s own figures.
strings.t: Lekòl la reklame “99% ale nan yon inivèsite kat ane”, men pwòp lis Klas 2025 li a ki gen non montre apeprè senk nan 94 gradye nan yon inivèsite kominotè, yon lekòl imobilye, nan gadri oswa k ap pran yon ane apre diplòm — pi pre 95%. Tou de se pwòp chif lekòl la.

strings.text: The Academic Conservatory is the real differentiator — a transcript-noted arts credential — and Winterim puts every student somewhere off campus each January.
strings.t: Academic Conservatory a se vrè diferans la — yon kalifikasyon atistik ki note sou relve nòt — epi Winterim mete chak elèv yon kote deyò kanpis la chak janvye.

strings.text: The second lever is a Christian-college network most peer schools do not have: NACCAP membership and a named Christian-college tier that 14% of graduates actually use.
strings.t: Dezyèm leviye a se yon rezo inivèsite kretyen pifò lekòl parèy pa genyen: manbraj NACCAP ak yon nivo inivèsite kretyen ki gen non ke 14% nan gradye yo sèvi vre.

strings.text: **Academic Conservatory** — the school’s strongest published credential, and critically it is **noted on the transcript**, so it reaches the admissions reader rather than living only in a résumé. Described across sources as covering six or eight areas.
strings.t: **Academic Conservatory** — kalifikasyon ki pi solid lekòl la pibliye, epi sa ki enpòtan li **note sou relve nòt la**, kidonk li rive nan men moun k ap li nan admisyon olye ke viv sèlman nan yon rezime. Dekri atravè sous kòm yon bagay ki kouvri sis oswa uit domèn.

strings.text: **Winterim / January Term** — a required credit every year (0.25 per year toward graduation), supplying internships, travel and vocational shadowing. Note the vocational shadowing component is small: only about seven placements are published.
strings.t: **Winterim / January Term** — yon kredi obligatwa chak ane (0.25 pa ane vè gradyasyon), ki bay estaj, vwayaj ak swiv metye. Note konpozan swiv metye a piti: se sèlman anviwon sèt plasman ki pibliye.

strings.text: **Junior Seminar** — a required, graded half-credit course containing a mock admission committee and two mandatory college visits. Structurally stronger than the optional evening programming most schools offer.
strings.t: **Junior Seminar** — yon kou obligatwa ak nòt demi kredi ki gen yon komite admisyon similye ak de vizit inivèsite obligatwa. Estriktirèlman pi solid pase pwogramasyon aswè opsyonèl pifò lekòl ofri.

strings.text: **Athletic recruiting at scale** — 21 signees in the Class of 2025, roughly 22% of a 94-student class, with athletic scholarships at Florida State, Queens, Wake Forest, Kentucky and New Hampshire.
strings.t: **Rekritman atletik nan gwo echèl** — 21 moun ki siyen nan Klas 2025 la, apeprè 22% nan yon klas 94 elèv, ak bous atletik nan Florida State, Queens, Wake Forest, Kentucky ak New Hampshire.

strings.text: **Seal of Biliteracy** — implemented in 2019 and awarded on a proficiency exam across two languages, though the share earning it fell from 11% of the Class of 2021 to 4% of the Class of 2024.
strings.t: **Seal of Biliteracy** — aplike an 2019 epi yo bay li sou yon egzamen konpetans nan de lang, byenke pòsyon ki genyen l lan te tonbe soti 11% nan Klas 2021 rive 4% nan Klas 2024.

strings.text: **A Christian-college network with its own membership** — Charlotte Christian belongs to **NACCAP**, the Christian-college counseling association, alongside NACAC and SACAC. Its brochure gives Christian colleges a named tier, and 14% of graduates enroll at one, with live pipelines to Wheaton, Liberty, Samford, Cedarville, Grove City, Baylor and Abilene Christian.
strings.t: **Yon rezo inivèsite kretyen ak pwòp manbraj pa l** — Charlotte Christian fè pati **NACCAP**, asosyasyon konsèy inivèsite kretyen an, ansanm ak NACAC ak SACAC. Bwochi li a bay inivèsite kretyen yon nivo ki gen non, epi 14% nan gradye yo enskri nan youn, ak rezo aktif nan Wheaton, Liberty, Samford, Cedarville, Grove City, Baylor ak Abilene Christian.

strings.text: **A named HBCU tier** — Hampton, Howard, Morehouse, NC A&T and Spelman are listed as a distinct group, with confirmed Class of 2025 enrollments at NC A&T and Johnson C. Smith.
strings.t: **Yon nivo HBCU ki gen non** — Hampton, Howard, Morehouse, NC A&T ak Spelman liste kòm yon gwoup apa, ak enskripsyon Klas 2025 konfime nan NC A&T ak Johnson C. Smith.

strings.text: **The School Profile as an instrument** — it publishes a full AP dashboard with AP Scholar breakdowns, a five-quintile GPA table, the grading scale, the weighting formula and the weighting change at the Class of 2019, plus CEEB 340667.
strings.t: **School Profile la kòm yon zouti** — li pibliye yon tablo AP konplè ak dekoupaj AP Scholar, yon tab GPA senk senkyèm, echèl nòt la, fòmil pwa a ak chanjman pwa a nan Klas 2019 la, plis CEEB 340667.

strings.text: **Granular scholarship reporting** — roughly ninety individually named awards published for a single class is far more specific than a headline dollar figure, and lets a family see which institutions actually fund this school’s students.
strings.t: **Rapò granilè sou bous** — apeprè katrevendis prim ki nonmen endividyèlman ki pibliye pou yon sèl klas se pi espesifik lwen pase yon chif dola nan tit, epi li kite yon fanmi wè ki enstitisyon ki finanse elèv lekòl sa a vre.

strings.text: The school does not publish a disciplinary-disclosure policy — whether and how suspensions or honor violations reach the secondary school report is absent despite NACAC membership.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye yon politik divilgasyon disiplinè — si ak kijan sispansyon oswa vyolasyon onè rive nan rapò lekòl segondè a absan malgre manbraj NACAC.

strings.text: The Academic Conservatory is described as covering six areas in the School Profile and eight on the website. Both are the school’s own figures.
strings.t: Academic Conservatory a dekri kòm yon bagay ki kouvri sis domèn nan School Profile la ak uit sou sit la. Tou de se pwòp chif lekòl la.

strings.text: A full five-quintile GPA table, published every year — and a visible three-year grade inflation in it, with every boundary rising while the bottom floor fell.
strings.t: Yon tab GPA senk senkyèm konplè, pibliye chak ane — ak yon enflasyon nòt vizib sou twa ane ladan l, ak chak limit ki monte pandan planche anba a te tonbe.

strings.text: The median student sits in the third quintile at roughly 3.69–4.06 weighted; because Honors adds 0.5 and AP a full point, a 4.277 top-quintile floor implies a heavy advanced load rather than a perfect record.
strings.t: Elèv medyàn nan chita nan twazyèm senkyèm nan nan apeprè 3.69–4.06 ak pwa; paske Honors ajoute 0.5 ak AP yon pwen konplè, yon planche 4.277 nan senkyèm anwo a sijere yon gwo chay avanse olye ke yon dosye pafè.

strings.text: — Class of 2025 · 79 testers of 94 graduates (~84%)
strings.t: — Klas 2025 · 79 moun ki pase tès nan 94 gradye (~84%)

strings.text: The school publishes the composite middle-50% band and a tester count only. Those endpoints ARE the 25th and 75th percentiles; the mean, the median and any Reading or Maths section split are unpublished, so none is interpolated here.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye bann konpozit mitan-50% la ak yon kantite moun ki pase tès sèlman. Bout sa yo SE 25yèm ak 75yèm pousantaj yo; mwayèn nan, medyàn nan ak nenpòt separasyon seksyon Lekti oswa Matematik pa pibliye, kidonk nou pa entèpole okenn isit la.

strings.text: — Class of 2025 · 33 testers of 94 graduates (~35%)
strings.t: — Klas 2025 · 33 moun ki pase tès nan 94 gradye (~35%)

strings.text: 79 SAT plus 33 ACT testers against 94 graduates implies substantial overlap, and since test-optional strategy is an explicit counseling topic, some graduates likely sat neither. The school publishes no combined “share who tested” figure.
strings.t: 79 moun ki pase SAT plis 33 ki pase ACT kont 94 gradye sijere anpil sipèpozisyon, epi paske estrateji sou tès opsyonèl se yon sijè konsèy eksplisit, gen anpil chans kèk gradye pa t pase ni youn ni lòt. Lekòl la pa pibliye okenn chif konbine sou “pòsyon ki te pase tès”.

strings.text: — the no-rank mechanism · Class of 2025 weighted GPA through the sixth semester
strings.t: — mekanis san ran an · GPA ak pwa Klas 2025 jiska sizyèm semès la

strings.text: a heavy AP and Honors load
strings.t: yon gwo chay AP ak Honors

strings.text: strong advanced coursework
strings.t: kou avanse solid

strings.text: the median student sits here
strings.t: elèv medyàn nan chita isit la

strings.text: real, named destinations exist
strings.t: vrè destinasyon ki gen non egziste

strings.text: the floor of the published table
strings.t: planche tab ki pibliye a

strings.text: All five quintiles are the school’s own published figures. Comparing them with the Class of 2022 table shows material movement in three years: every quintile boundary rose — the first-quintile floor from 4.133 to 4.277 and the third from 3.56 to 3.686 — while the fifth-quintile floor FELL from 2.179 to 1.941. The distribution rose at the top and stretched at the bottom. No unweighted distribution is published.
strings.t: Tout senk senkyèm yo se pwòp chif lekòl la pibliye. Konpare yo ak tab Klas 2022 la montre yon mouvman enpòtan nan twa ane: chak limit senkyèm te monte — planche premye senkyèm nan soti 4.133 rive 4.277 ak twazyèm nan soti 3.56 rive 3.686 — pandan planche senkyèm senkyèm nan te TONBE soti 2.179 rive 1.941. Distribisyon an te monte nan tèt la epi li te lonje nan pye a. Pa gen okenn distribisyon san pwa ki pibliye.

strings.text: What is published is counseling, not learning support
strings.t: Sa ki pibliye a se konsèy, se pa sipò aprantisaj

strings.text: Two Upper School counselors provide study-skills instruction, course-selection guidance, academic progress monitoring, test-anxiety management, and referrals to outside resources. That is a general counseling function rather than a learning-differences programme.
strings.t: De konseye Upper School bay enstriksyon sou konpetans etid, konsèy pou chwazi kou, siveyans pwogrè akademik, jesyon estrès nan tès, ak referans nan resous deyò. Sa se yon fonksyon konsèy jeneral olye ke yon pwogram pou diferans nan aprantisaj.

strings.text: Credentials are a genuine strength
strings.t: Kalifikasyon yo se yon vrè fòs

strings.text: All counselors hold master’s degrees in counseling or a related field, and several hold clinical licences — LCMHC or LCSW.
strings.t: Tout konseye yo genyen metriz nan konsèy oswa yon domèn ki gen rapò, epi plizyè genyen lisans klinik — LCMHC oswa LCSW.

strings.text: The named academic-support structures
strings.t: Estrikti sipò akademik ki gen non yo

strings.text: **WIN (“What I Need”) labs** and advisory lessons are the named Upper School academic-support structure, and the **Media & Writing Center** is free and writing-specific. What WIN Lab delivers academically is not described.
strings.t: **WIN (“What I Need”) labs** ak leson advisory se estrikti sipò akademik Upper School ki gen non an, epi **Media & Writing Center** la gratis epi li espesifik pou ekri. Sa WIN Lab bay sou plan akademik pa dekri.

strings.text: This is the weakest-documented area in the entire research set. No named learning specialist, no named learning-differences programme, no psycho-educational testing, no 504 or accommodation-plan process, no extended-time policy and no College Board accommodations coordination could be found. Given the school gates Honors and AP placement on an A in the prerequisite course AND mandates AP exams, that combination makes this a priority question rather than a footnote.
strings.t: Sa a se domèn ki mwens byen dokimante nan tout seri rechèch la. Nou pa t kapab jwenn okenn espesyalis aprantisaj ki gen non, okenn pwogram pou diferans nan aprantisaj ki gen non, okenn tès sikoedikatif, okenn pwosesis 504 oswa plan akomodasyon, okenn politik tan pwolonje ak okenn kòdinasyon akomodasyon College Board. Lè w konsidere lekòl la mete plasman Honors ak AP dèyè yon A nan kou kondisyon anvan an EPI li egzije egzamen AP, konbinezon sa a fè sa yon kesyon priyorite olye ke yon nòt anba paj.

strings.text: The middle may be the best-served cohort
strings.t: Mitan an ka gwoup ki pi byen sèvi a

strings.text: The list spans Dartmouth and Duke down to Central Piedmont Community College, Universal Technical Institute, Brevard, Montreat, Belmont Abbey, Limestone, Winthrop, Wingate and Methodist. A fourth- or fifth-quintile student at 3.12 or below has real, named destinations, and the checklist instructs students to include “every possible type of college that might be of interest”.
strings.t: Lis la kouvri Dartmouth ak Duke desann rive nan Central Piedmont Community College, Universal Technical Institute, Brevard, Montreat, Belmont Abbey, Limestone, Winthrop, Wingate ak Methodist. Yon elèv nan katriyèm oswa senkyèm senkyèm nan a 3.12 oswa pi ba gen vrè destinasyon ki gen non, epi lis kontwòl la di elèv yo pou yo enkli “chak kalite inivèsite ki ta ka enterese w”.

strings.text: The Christian-college route is real, not decorative
strings.t: Wout inivèsite kretyen an reyèl, se pa dekoratif

strings.text: 14% of recent graduates enroll at a Christian college, with multiple confirmed Class of 2025 enrollments at Wheaton, Liberty, Samford, Charleston Southern, Cedarville, Grove City, Baylor and Abilene Christian.
strings.t: 14% nan gradye resan yo enskri nan yon inivèsite kretyen, ak plizyè enskripsyon Klas 2025 konfime nan Wheaton, Liberty, Samford, Charleston Southern, Cedarville, Grove City, Baylor ak Abilene Christian.

strings.text: Vocational and non-traditional
strings.t: Metye ak sa ki pa tradisyonèl

strings.text: Universal Technical Institute and Central Piedmont Community College both appear as acceptances, and Central Piedmont as an actual enrollment. No federal service academy appears on either published list.
strings.t: Universal Technical Institute ak Central Piedmont Community College tou de parèt kòm aksepte, epi Central Piedmont kòm yon vrè enskripsyon. Pa gen okenn akademi sèvis federal ki parèt sou ni youn ni lòt lis ki pibliye.

strings.text: The 2021–22 profile published no test scores at all, stating it had “insufficient testing results to report middle 50% test score ranges” for the Class of 2022 — so no multi-year test trend exists, and the 2024–25 edition is the only one carrying SAT and ACT bands.
strings.t: Pwofil 2021–22 la pa t pibliye okenn nòt tès ditou, li te deklare li te gen “rezilta tès ki pa ase pou rapòte ranje nòt tès mitan 50%” pou Klas 2022 la — kidonk pa gen okenn tandans tès plizyè ane ki egziste, epi edisyon 2024–25 la se sèl la ki pote bann SAT ak ACT.

strings.text: No gap-year policy or counselling is published, and neither is any unweighted GPA distribution.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn politik oswa konsèy sou ane apre diplòm ki pibliye, epi pa gen okenn distribisyon GPA san pwa non plis.

strings.text: A structurally rigorous, transparent transcript — mandatory AP exams, a full published quintile table, a granular AP dashboard — attached to the thinnest learning-support disclosure in this set.
strings.t: Yon relve nòt estriktirèlman rijid epi transparan — egzamen AP obligatwa, yon tab senkyèm konplè ki pibliye, yon tablo AP granilè — makonnen ak divilgasyon sipò aprantisaj ki pi mens nan gwoup sa a.

strings.text: The academic reporting is unusually honest. The gaps are concentrated in exactly one place, which makes the tour questions easy to aim.
strings.t: Rapò akademik la onèt yon fason ki pa abityèl. Mank yo konsantre nan yon sèl kote, sa ki fè kesyon pou vizit yo fasil pou vize.

strings.text: AP exams are mandatory, so the pass rate means something
strings.t: Egzamen AP obligatwa, kidonk to reyisit la vle di yon bagay

strings.text: “Students in AP classes are required to take the AP exam” — so 89% scoring 3+ in 2024, up from 78% in 2021, rests on a non-self-selected pool rather than only confident testers.
strings.t: “Elèv nan klas AP oblije pran egzamen AP la” — kidonk 89% ki fè 3+ an 2024, monte soti 78% an 2021, chita sou yon gwoup kote elèv yo pa chwazi tèt yo olye ke sèlman moun ki gen konfyans nan tès.

strings.text: The AP dashboard is the fullest in this set
strings.t: Tablo AP la se sa ki pi konplè nan gwoup sa a

strings.text: exams, students, pass counts and a complete AP Scholar breakdown, published two years deep — 59 AP Scholar awards in 2024 and 203 across the Classes of 2023–25.
strings.t: egzamen, elèv, kantite ki pase ak yon dekoupaj AP Scholar konplè, pibliye de ane pwofondè — 59 prim AP Scholar an 2024 ak 203 atravè Klas 2023–25 yo.

strings.text: A real quintile table, published annually
strings.t: Yon vrè tab senkyèm, pibliye chak ane

strings.text: five quintiles through the sixth semester, so colleges can locate a student’s band without a rank — and comparing editions makes three-year grade movement visible rather than hidden.
strings.t: senk senkyèm jiska sizyèm semès la, kidonk inivèsite yo ka jwenn bann yon elèv san yon ran — epi konpare edisyon yo fè mouvman nòt sou twa ane vizib olye ke kache.

strings.text: Junior Seminar is a requirement, not an invitation
strings.t: Junior Seminar se yon kondisyon, se pa yon envitasyon

strings.text: a graded half-credit course carrying a mock admission committee and two mandatory college visits — more structured than the optional evening programming peers offer.
strings.t: yon kou ak nòt demi kredi ki pote yon komite admisyon similye ak de vizit inivèsite obligatwa — pi estriktire pase pwogramasyon aswè opsyonèl lekòl parèy ofri.

strings.text: The Conservatory reaches the reader
strings.t: Conservatory a rive nan men moun k ap li a

strings.text: it is noted on the transcript, so the credential lands in the admissions file rather than only on a résumé.
strings.t: yo note l sou relve nòt la, kidonk kalifikasyon an rive nan dosye admisyon an olye ke sèlman sou yon rezime.

strings.text: A distinctive network the others do not have
strings.t: Yon rezo distenktif lòt yo pa genyen

strings.text: NACCAP membership plus named Christian-college and HBCU tiers, with 14% of graduates actually enrolling at a Christian college and confirmed pipelines to Wheaton, Liberty, Samford and Baylor.
strings.t: manbraj NACCAP plis nivo inivèsite kretyen ak HBCU ki gen non, ak 14% nan gradye yo ki vrèman enskri nan yon inivèsite kretyen ak rezo konfime nan Wheaton, Liberty, Samford ak Baylor.

strings.text: You publish no named learning specialist, no learning-differences programme and no accommodations policy. Who supports a student with a diagnosed learning difference, and who coordinates College Board accommodations?
strings.t: Ou pa pibliye okenn espesyalis aprantisaj ki gen non, okenn pwogram pou diferans nan aprantisaj ak okenn politik akomodasyon. Kiyès ki sipòte yon elèv ki gen yon diferans nan aprantisaj ki dyagnostike, epi kiyès ki kòdone akomodasyon College Board?

strings.text: Honors and AP placement requires an A in the prerequisite course and AP exams are mandatory. How does that combination work for a student with accommodations?
strings.t: Plasman nan Honors ak AP egzije yon A nan kou kondisyon anvan an epi egzamen AP obligatwa. Kijan konbinezon sa a mache pou yon elèv ki gen akomodasyon?

strings.text: What share of AP exams scored 4 or 5? Only the 3+ threshold is published.
strings.t: Ki pòsyon nan egzamen AP yo ki te fè 4 oswa 5? Se sèlman sèy 3+ la ki pibliye.

strings.text: Your marketing says “45+ AP and honors courses” but roughly 23 AP courses can be enumerated. What is the actual count?
strings.t: Maketing ou di “45+ kou AP ak honors” men apeprè 23 kou AP ka konte. Ki vrè kantite a?

strings.text: Your profile reports 14 National Merit finalists on a rolling 15-year window, down from 16 three years earlier. What were the per-class counts for the last five years?
strings.t: Pwofil ou a rapòte 14 finalis National Merit sou yon peryòd kontinyèl 15 ane, ki desann soti 16 twa ane anvan. Ki kantite pa klas pou senk dènye ane yo?

strings.text: The school lists one Commended Scholar for the Class of 2025 while press coverage names a Semifinalist you do not list. Which is right?
strings.t: Lekòl la liste yon Commended Scholar pou Klas 2025 la pandan kouvèti près la nonmen yon Semifinalis ou pa liste. Kiyès nan yo ki kòrèk?

strings.text: You state 99% attend a four-year college, but the named senior roster shows about five of 94 elsewhere. How is that 99% calculated?
strings.t: Ou deklare 99% ale nan yon inivèsite kat ane, men lis elèv dènye ane ki gen non an montre apeprè senk nan 94 lòt kote. Kijan 99% sa a kalkile?

strings.text: What are the Class of 2026 figures — acceptances, scholarships, and test bands? None are published yet.
strings.t: Ki chif Klas 2026 yo — aksepte, bous, ak bann tès? Okenn pa pibliye ankò.

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Charlotte Catholic High School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 56.0% over the last five entering classes — 1,175 acceptances from 2,100 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Charlotte Catholic High School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 56.0% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 1,175 admisyon sou 2,100 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 23.3% in Fall 2025 — 24 of 103 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 23.3% nan otòn 2025 — 24 sou 103 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 1,175 of 2,100 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 1,175 sou 2,100 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 24 of 103, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 24 sou 103, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: drew the most applications in Fall 2025 (141)
strings.t: te resevwa plis aplikasyon nan otòn 2025 (141)

strings.text: A weighted-only transcript, no class rank, and an AP program where the exam is not optional.
strings.t: Yon relve nòt ki pondere sèlman, pa gen ran nan klas, ak yon pwogram AP kote egzamen an pa opsyonèl.

strings.text: CCHS adds one quality point for AP and Honors and shows only the weighted GPA — so the number a college reads is already the school-adjusted one.
strings.t: CCHS ajoute yon pwen kalite pou AP ak Honors epi li montre sèlman GPA pondere a — kidonk chif yon inivèsite li a se deja sa lekòl la ajiste a.

strings.text: AP exams taken, 2024-25 (345 students, grades 11–12)
strings.t: egzamen AP yo pase, 2024-25 (345 elèv, grad 11–12)

strings.t: nan nòt AP yo te 3 oswa pi wo

strings.text: of AP scores were 4 or 5

strings.t: 2 Finalis National Merit · 11 Commended Students

strings.text: Army ROTC scholarship at Cornell University
strings.t: Bous Army ROTC nan Cornell University

strings.text: The profile publishes Finalists and Commended counts but no Semifinalist line, and no multi-year series — so this ledger is a single class, not a trend.
strings.t: Pwofil la pibliye kantite Finalis ak Commended men okenn liy Semifinalis, epi okenn seri sou plizyè ane — kidonk rejis sa a se yon sèl klas, se pa yon tandans.

strings.text: Where the course path runs past the standard sequence
strings.t: Kote chemen kou a pase pi lwen pase sekans estanda a

strings.text: Honors Calculus, AP Calculus AB, AP Calculus BC and AP Statistics sit above Honors Pre-Calculus — four post-Pre-Calc options.
strings.t: Honors Calculus, AP Calculus AB, AP Calculus BC ak AP Statistics chita anwo Honors Pre-Calculus — kat opsyon apre Pre-Calc.

strings.text: AP Biology, AP Chemistry, AP Environmental Science, AP Physics 1 and AP Physics C: Mechanics, plus Honors Anatomy and Physiology, Honors Nutritional Science, Biotechnology, Forensic Science and Sports Medicine.
strings.t: AP Biology, AP Chemistry, AP Environmental Science, AP Physics 1 ak AP Physics C: Mechanics, plis Honors Anatomy and Physiology, Honors Nutritional Science, Biotechnology, Forensic Science ak Sports Medicine.

strings.text: Computer science and engineering
strings.t: Syans enfòmatik ak jeni

strings.text: AP Computer Science A and AP Cybersecurity Kickstart, above a four-course engineering strand ending in Honors Engineering Capstone.
strings.t: AP Computer Science A ak AP Cybersecurity Kickstart, anwo yon branch jeni kat kou ki fini nan Honors Engineering Capstone.

strings.text: Social studies
strings.t: Syans sosyal

strings.text: AP US History, AP European History, AP Psychology, AP US Government and AP Microeconomics — five AP options in one department.
strings.t: AP US History, AP European History, AP Psychology, AP US Government ak AP Microeconomics — senk opsyon AP nan yon sèl depatman.

strings.text: World languages
strings.t: Lang etranje

strings.text: French, German, Latin and Spanish each run to an AP course; Spanish continues to AP Spanish VI, a sixth-level course.
strings.t: Franse, Alman, Laten ak Panyòl chak mennen jiska yon kou AP; Panyòl kontinye jiska AP Spanish VI, yon kou sizyèm nivo.

strings.text: Classical pathway
strings.t: Pis klasik

strings.text: The St. Augustine Scholars Program, new with a 9th-grade cohort in 2025-26, adds a four-year classical track — philosophy, logic, Latin, primary texts and Socratic seminars.
strings.t: St. Augustine Scholars Program lan, ki nouvo ak yon gwoup nevyèm ane an 2025-26, ajoute yon pis klasik kat ane — filozofi, lojik, Laten, tèks orijinal ak seminè Sokratik.

strings.text: How the grade is engineered to be read
strings.t: Kijan nòt la fèt pou moun ka li l

strings.text: Weighted only
strings.t: Pondere sèlman

strings.text: One additional quality point for AP and Honors classes. Only the weighted GPA appears on the transcript — there is no unweighted figure to compare against.
strings.t: Yon pwen kalite anplis pou klas AP ak Honors. Se sèlman GPA pondere a ki parèt sou relve nòt la — pa gen okenn chif ki pa pondere pou konpare avè l.

strings.text: No class rank
strings.t: Pa gen ran nan klas

strings.text: The profile states plainly that "Charlotte Catholic does not rank students." A 10-decile GPA chart is published instead, so a college can place a student without a rank.
strings.t: Pwofil la di klèman ke “Charlotte Catholic does not rank students.” Yo pibliye yon tablo GPA ak 10 desil nan plas li, kidonk yon inivèsite ka plase yon elèv san yon ran.

strings.text: Load norms stated
strings.t: Nòm chay yo deklare

strings.text: "Most demanding" is defined by the school as 2 AP courses in junior year plus 4 in senior year — the reader is told the ceiling rather than left to guess it.
strings.t: Lekòl la defini “most demanding” kòm 2 kou AP nan twazyèm ane plis 4 nan katriyèm ane — yo di moun k ap li a plafon an olye ke kite l devine l.

strings.text: AP entry is competitive
strings.t: Antre nan AP mande seleksyon

strings.text: Students apply for each AP course; placement weighs prior coursework and grades, PSAT results and teacher feedback. AP is not open enrollment here.
strings.t: Elèv yo aplike pou chak kou AP; plasman an konsidere kou ak nòt anvan yo, rezilta PSAT ak kòmantè pwofesè. AP pa louvri a tout moun isit la.

strings.text: Honors is rationed early
strings.t: Yo rasyone Honors depi bonè

strings.text: A maximum of 1 honors class in 9th grade and 5 in 10th, with at most 3 advanced classes in 9th — so an underclass transcript is capped by policy, not by ambition.
strings.t: Yon maksimòm de 1 klas honors nan 9yèm ane ak 5 nan 10yèm, ak pa plis pase 3 klas avanse nan 9yèm — kidonk politik la limite relve nòt premye ane yo, se pa anbisyon.

strings.text: Transfer credit excluded
strings.t: Kredi transfè eskli

strings.text: Transcripts reflect only classes completed at Charlotte Catholic; transfer transcripts are not added to the CCHS record.
strings.t: Relve nòt yo reflete sèlman klas ki fèt nan Charlotte Catholic; yo pa ajoute relve nòt transfè nan dosye CCHS la.

strings.text: No AP Scholar tier counts are published. The profile gives exam-level performance (94% scoring 3+ across 1,064 exams) instead, which is the richer disclosure — but it means the Scholar/Scholar with Distinction ledger other schools show cannot be built here.
strings.t: Yo pa pibliye okenn dekont nivo AP Scholar. Pwofil la bay pèfòmans nan nivo egzamen an (94% ki jwenn 3+ atravè 1,064 egzamen) nan plas sa, sa ki se divilgasyon ki pi rich la — men sa vle di ke nou pa ka bati rejis Scholar/Scholar with Distinction lòt lekòl yo montre a isit la.

strings.text: The AP figures are 2024-25 while the testing and decile figures are Class of 2026. Both are as published; they are one year apart and are not combined into a single claim.
strings.t: Chif AP yo se 2024-25 pandan chif tès ak desil yo se Klas 2026 la. Tou de se jan yo pibliye yo; yo gen yon ane diferans epi nou pa konbine yo nan yon sèl deklarasyon.

strings.text: The four-year timeline the counseling office publishes
strings.t: Kalandriye kat ane biwo oryantasyon an pibliye a

strings.text: Foundation
strings.t: Fondasyon

strings.text: Placement is set by prior coursework, standardized testing and teacher feedback rather than by student request.
strings.t: Se kou anvan yo, tès estandadize ak kòmantè pwofesè ki detèmine plasman an, se pa demann elèv la.

strings.text: Honors access is capped at one course; advanced courses at three.
strings.t: Aksè nan Honors limite a yon sèl kou; kou avanse yo a twa.

strings.text: Philosophy (0.5 credit) is taken in freshman year starting with the Class of 2028.
strings.t: Yo pran Philosophy (0.5 kredi) nan premye ane a apati Klas 2028 la.

strings.text: Service begins immediately — 10 hours due, at least 5 of them parish service, by March 1.
strings.t: Sèvis kòmanse touswit — 10 èdtan pou remèt, omwen 5 nan yo se sèvis nan parwas, anvan 1ye mas.

strings.text: Focus: establish the weighted GPA that the decile chart will later place.
strings.t: Konsantrasyon: etabli GPA pondere a ke tablo desil la ap plase pi devan.

strings.text: Widening
strings.t: Elajisman

strings.text: Honors access widens sharply — up to five honors courses.
strings.t: Aksè nan Honors elaji anpil — jiska senk kou honors.

strings.text: PSAT results begin to feed AP placement decisions.
strings.t: Rezilta PSAT kòmanse antre nan desizyon plasman AP yo.

strings.text: Service rises to 20 hours a year, the level it holds through graduation.
strings.t: Sèvis monte a 20 èdtan pa ane, nivo li kenbe jiska gradyasyon.

strings.text: Journalism and Yearbook open as electives, the school’s two publication courses.
strings.t: Journalism ak Yearbook louvri kòm elektif, de kou piblikasyon lekòl la.

strings.text: AP courses become available for the first time; students apply per course.
strings.t: Kou AP yo vin disponib pou premye fwa; elèv yo aplike pou chak kou.

strings.text: Two AP courses in junior year is the school-stated "most demanding" benchmark.
strings.t: De kou AP nan twazyèm ane se referans “most demanding” lekòl la deklare a.

strings.text: AP exams are mandatory in each AP course taken.
strings.t: Egzamen AP yo obligatwa nan chak kou AP yon elèv pran.

strings.text: College admissions representatives visit campus — NC State lists CCHS as a named recruiting venue.
strings.t: Reprezantan admisyon inivèsite yo vizite kanpis la — NC State liste CCHS kòm yon kote rekritman ki gen non.

strings.text: Application
strings.t: Aplikasyon

strings.text: Four AP courses in senior year completes the "most demanding" load.
strings.t: Kat kou AP nan katriyèm ane konplete chay “most demanding” la.

strings.text: The counseling office publishes the Common Application essay prompts and supports drafting against them.
strings.t: Biwo oryantasyon an pibliye sijè disètasyon Common Application yo epi li sipòte redaksyon an kont yo.

strings.text: Transcripts carry the weighted GPA and no rank; the decile chart travels with the profile.
strings.t: Relve nòt yo pote GPA pondere a epi pa gen ran; tablo desil la vwayaje ak pwofil la.

strings.text: Final service hours are due March 1, completing the 70-hour graduation requirement.
strings.t: Dènye èdtan sèvis yo dwe remèt 1ye mas, sa ki konplete kondisyon 70 èdtan pou gradyasyon an.

strings.text: Junior and senior college-process detail is published as embedded Prezi presentations rather than as HTML, so the office almost certainly runs more structure than this list captures. Only what is verifiable in fetchable published material is listed.
strings.t: Detay pwosesis inivèsite pou twazyèm ak katriyèm ane pibliye kòm prezantasyon Prezi entegre olye ke kòm HTML, kidonk biwo a prèske sèten gen plis estrikti pase sa lis sa a kaptire. Nou liste sèlman sa nou ka verifye nan materyèl pibliye nou ka jwenn.

strings.text: Class of 2025 graduates matriculated to 169 different colleges and universities over three years.
strings.t: Elèv ki gradye nan Klas 2025 la te enskri nan 169 diferan kolèj ak inivèsite pandan twa ane.

strings.text: 38% of the Class of 2025 stayed in North Carolina; 81% enrolled at public universities.
strings.t: 38% nan Klas 2025 la te rete nan North Carolina; 81% te enskri nan inivèsite piblik.

strings.text: Three US Naval Academy appointments in 2025, plus an Army ROTC scholarship at Cornell.

strings.t: Chay ~54:1 pou elèv dènye ane a KALKILE apati 324 elèv dènye ane pwofil la ak sis konseye li nonmen yo. Lekòl la pa pibliye yon rapò, epi nou konte direktè a kòm yon konseye isit la.

strings.text: The live counselors page shows the 2026-27 roster, which drops Sandy Needham and adds Kate McHugh. This card uses the 2025-2026 profile roster throughout, so that the six counselors and the 324 seniors come from the same year.
strings.t: Paj konseye ki an dirèk la montre lis 2026-27 la, ki retire Sandy Needham epi ajoute Kate McHugh. Kat sa a sèvi ak lis pwofil 2025-2026 la toupatou, pou sis konseye yo ak 324 elèv dènye ane yo soti nan menm ane a.

strings.text: The junior and senior college-planning pages embed Prezi presentations, whose content is not reachable as text. The four-year timeline above is therefore built from published policy, not from the office’s own process deck.
strings.t: Paj planifikasyon inivèsite pou twazyèm ak katriyèm ane yo entegre prezantasyon Prezi, ke nou pa ka jwenn kontni yo kòm tèks. Se poutèt sa nou bati kalandriye kat ane ki anwo a apati politik ki pibliye, se pa apati pwòp dosye pwosesis biwo a.

strings.text: Where 169 colleges took CCHS graduates over three years — and $17,242,184 in scholarships for one class.
strings.t: Kote 169 inivèsite te pran moun ki gradye nan CCHS pandan twa ane — ak $17,242,184 nan bous pou yon sèl klas.

strings.text: Every bucket here counts MATRICULATIONS, not acceptances. A student is admitted to many colleges and enrolls at one, so these counts are structurally lower than an acceptance-based list and must not be read as a harder or weaker admissions result than a school that publishes acceptances.
strings.t: Chak gwoup isit la konte ENSKRIPSYON, se pa aksèptasyon. Yo aksepte yon elèv nan anpil inivèsite epi li enskri nan yon sèl, kidonk dekont sa yo pi ba nan estrikti yo pase yon lis ki baze sou aksèptasyon epi ou pa dwe li yo kòm yon rezilta admisyon ki pi difisil oswa ki pi fèb pase yon lekòl ki pibliye aksèptasyon.

strings.t: Chak enskripsyon, 2023–2025

strings.t: 169 enstitisyon · pwofil la pa pibliye okenn kantite enskripsyon pa enstitisyon

strings.text: The scholarship total is the class-wide figure the school publishes; it is not broken out by institution, by merit-versus-need, or per student.
strings.t: Total bous la se chif pou tout klas la lekòl la pibliye; yo pa detaye l pa enstitisyon, pa merit kont bezwen, ni pa elèv.

strings.text: The profile’s own heading is "COLLEGE MATRICULATION CLASSES OF 2023-2025" — this is where graduates enrolled. Several schools on this roster publish acceptance lists instead, which are much longer by construction. Comparing the two directly understates CCHS.
strings.t: Pwòp tit pwofil la se “COLLEGE MATRICULATION CLASSES OF 2023-2025” — se la moun ki gradye yo te enskri. Plizyè lekòl sou lis sa a pibliye lis aksèptasyon nan plas sa, ki pi long nan estrikti yo. Konpare tou de dirèkteman fè CCHS parèt pi ba pase sa l ye.

strings.text: No per-institution enrollment counts are published, so no college on this list can be marked as enrolling more than one graduate.
strings.t: Yo pa pibliye okenn kantite enskripsyon pa enstitisyon, kidonk nou pa ka make okenn inivèsite sou lis sa a kòm ki enskri plis pase yon moun ki gradye.

strings.text: Bucket membership is scored against the app’s master U.S. News 2026 table rather than by the school, which publishes the institution names only.
strings.t: Nou evalye apatenans nan gwoup yo kont tab prensipal U.S. News 2026 app la olye ke pa lekòl la, ki pibliye non enstitisyon yo sèlman.

strings.text: What actually moves a CCHS application.
strings.t: Sa ki reyèlman fè yon aplikasyon CCHS avanse.

strings.text: One lever the student builds, one the school supplies by being a 74-championship NCHSAA program inside a diocesan system.
strings.t: Yon levye elèv la bati, yon lòt lekòl la bay lè li se yon pwogram NCHSAA ak 74 chanpyona anndan yon sistèm dyosèz.

strings.text: what a student controls
strings.t: sa yon elèv kontwole

strings.text: Take the AP load the school names as most demanding — 2 in junior year, 4 in senior year — and clear the competitive application for each course.
strings.t: Pran chay AP lekòl la rele ki pi egzijan an — 2 nan twazyèm ane, 4 nan katriyèm ane — epi pase aplikasyon ak seleksyon an pou chak kou.

strings.text: Sit the AP exam in every AP course; it is mandatory here, so the 94% scoring 3+ is a cohort result a student is measured inside, not opted out of.
strings.t: Pase egzamen AP la nan chak kou AP; li obligatwa isit la, kidonk 94% ki jwenn 3+ la se yon rezilta gwoup kote yo mezire yon elèv anndan l, se pa yon bagay li ka chwazi pa fè.

strings.text: Go past 70 service hours. The requirement is universal, so the hours themselves do not differentiate — the parish and leadership roles behind them do.
strings.t: Ale pi lwen pase 70 èdtan sèvis. Egzijans lan menm pou tout moun, kidonk èdtan yo pou kont yo pa fè diferans — se wòl nan parwas la ak nan lidèchip ki dèyè yo ki fè l.

strings.text: Use the 76-club directory to build depth rather than breadth: seven honor societies carry published GPA thresholds, from NHS at 3.9 to Mu Alpha Theta at 4.5 in mathematics.
strings.t: Sèvi ak anyè 76 klib la pou bati pwofondè olye ke lajè: sèt sosyete onè pote papòt GPA ki pibliye, soti nan NHS a 3.9 rive nan Mu Alpha Theta a 4.5 nan matematik.

strings.text: For a classical or theology-facing application, the St. Augustine Scholars Program is a four-year differentiator that few applicants anywhere will carry.
strings.t: Pou yon aplikasyon ki oryante nan klasik oswa teoloji, St. Augustine Scholars Program lan se yon eleman kat ane ki fè diferans ke tikras aplikan okenn kote ap genyen.

strings.text: what CCHS supplies
strings.t: sa CCHS bay

strings.text: Athletic recruiting reach is real and unusual: 74 state championships since 2000, 8 Wells Fargo Cups, and 1000+ alumni who went on to play at NCAA, NAIA or junior-college level.
strings.t: Pòte rekritman atletik la reyèl epi li pa abityèl: 74 chanpyona eta depi 2000, 8 Wells Fargo Cups, ak 1000+ ansyen elèv ki te ale jwe nan nivo NCAA, NAIA oswa kolèj de zan.

strings.text: CCHS is one of only four parochial schools competing in the NCHSAA — the public-school association — so its athletes are evaluated against the state’s largest programs rather than a private-school bracket.
strings.t: CCHS se youn nan sèlman kat lekòl parwasyal k ap konpetisyone nan NCHSAA — asosyasyon lekòl piblik la — kidonk yo evalye atlèt li yo kont pi gwo pwogram eta a olye ke nan yon gwoup lekòl prive.

strings.text: The school profile does the interpretive work for an admissions reader: decile chart, stated load norms, explicit no-rank policy and a defined "most demanding" benchmark.
strings.t: Pwofil lekòl la fè travay entèpretasyon an pou yon moun k ap li nan admisyon: tablo desil, nòm chay ki deklare, politik eksplisit pou pa bay ran ak yon referans “most demanding” ki defini.

strings.text: Diocesan scale shows up in outcomes — three Naval Academy appointments in one class, and service-academy matriculations at all three academies.
strings.t: Echèl dyosèz la parèt nan rezilta yo — twa nominasyon nan Naval Academy nan yon sèl klas, ak enskripsyon nan tou twa akademi militè yo.

strings.text: A 650-seat Fine Arts Center dedicated in 2022, a Charlotte Symphony partnership, and a band that performs quadrennially in Dublin give arts applicants a portfolio venue.
strings.t: Yon Fine Arts Center 650 plas ki dedye an 2022, yon patenarya ak Charlotte Symphony, ak yon fanfa ki jwe chak kat ane nan Dublin bay aplikan nan atizay yon kote pou montre travay yo.

strings.text: No published Naviance/SCOIR-style scattergram exists, so a family cannot see admit rates by GPA band for this school.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn dyagram tankou Naviance/SCOIR ki pibliye, kidonk yon fanmi pa ka wè to admisyon pa bann GPA pou lekòl sa a.

strings.text: CCHS publishes no admissions-outcome tool (no scattergrams, no admit rates by band), so "what it takes" cannot be answered quantitatively from the school’s own materials.
strings.t: CCHS pa pibliye okenn zouti sou rezilta admisyon (pa gen dyagram, pa gen to admisyon pa bann), kidonk nou pa ka reponn “kisa sa mande” ak chif apati pwòp materyèl lekòl la.

strings.text: The whole class, not just the top of it.
strings.t: Tout klas la, se pa sèlman tèt li.

strings.text: CCHS publishes mid-50% test ranges and a 10-decile GPA chart — enough to place a student honestly, and it refuses to rank them.
strings.t: CCHS pibliye entèval mitan-50% pou tès yo ak yon tablo GPA ak 10 desil — ase pou plase yon elèv onètman, epi li refize klase yo.

strings.text: The school publishes a mid-50% RANGE, not percentiles and not an average. The endpoints of a mid-50% range are by definition the 25th and 75th percentiles, so those two columns are real; the 10th, 50th, 90th and mean are not published and are shown as em-dashes rather than modelled. No section-level (EBRW / Math) split is published.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye yon ENTÈVAL mitan-50%, se pa pousantil ni yon mwayèn. Pwen fen yon entèval mitan-50% se pa definisyon 25yèm ak 75yèm pousantil yo, kidonk de kolòn sa yo reyèl; 10yèm, 50yèm, 90yèm ak mwayèn nan pa pibliye epi nou montre yo kòm tirè olye ke modle yo. Pa gen okenn divizyon pa seksyon (EBRW / Math) ki pibliye.

strings.text: CCHS publishes no learning-difference policy document, no accommodation counts and no diagnostic-support staffing. The Options and Pathways courses are visible in the curriculum guide; the services behind them are not described publicly.
strings.t: CCHS pa pibliye okenn dokiman politik sou diferans nan aprantisaj, okenn kantite akomodasyon ak okenn anplwaye pou sipò dyagnostik. Kou Options ak Pathways yo vizib nan gid kourikoulòm nan; men yo pa dekri sèvis ki dèyè yo an piblik.

strings.text: The middle band is published
strings.t: Bann mitan an pibliye

strings.text: The 5th and 6th deciles run 3.83–3.95 and 3.71–3.82 — a family can locate a median student, which a school publishing only averages would hide.
strings.t: 5yèm ak 6yèm desil yo ale 3.83–3.95 ak 3.71–3.82 — yon fanmi ka jwenn kote yon elèv medyàn ye, sa yon lekòl ki pibliye sèlman mwayèn ta kache.

strings.text: The bottom decile is not hidden
strings.t: Desil ki anba a pa kache

strings.text: The 10th decile is published as 2.25–3.14 rather than truncated, which is unusually candid for a school profile.
strings.t: Yo pibliye 10yèm desil la kòm 2.25–3.14 olye ke koupe l, sa ki onèt yon fason ki pa abityèl pou yon pwofil lekòl.

strings.text: 95% continue immediately
strings.t: 95% kontinye touswit

strings.text: Of the Class of 2025, 95% went straight to post-secondary education and 2% to two-year institutions.
strings.t: Nan Klas 2025 la, 95% te ale dirèkteman nan edikasyon apre segondè epi 2% nan enstitisyon de zan.

strings.text: Public-university weighted
strings.t: Peze plis sou inivèsite piblik

strings.text: 81% of the Class of 2025 enrolled at public universities and 19% at private ones — an outcome pattern closer to a strong public high school than to an independent day school.
strings.t: 81% nan Klas 2025 la te enskri nan inivèsite piblik epi 19% nan inivèsite prive — yon modèl rezilta ki pi pre yon bon lekòl segondè piblik pase yon lekòl endepandan lajounen.

strings.text: No mean or median SAT/ACT is published, so this school cannot be placed on an averages-based comparison with schools that publish one. The mid-50% range is what exists.
strings.t: Yo pa pibliye okenn mwayèn ni medyàn SAT/ACT, kidonk nou pa ka plase lekòl sa a nan yon konparezon ki baze sou mwayèn ak lekòl ki pibliye youn. Entèval mitan-50% la se sa ki egziste.

strings.text: No learning-difference or accommodations disclosure exists beyond the course names in the curriculum guide.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn divilgasyon sou diferans nan aprantisaj oswa akomodasyon pi lwen pase non kou yo nan gid kourikoulòm nan.

strings.text: A large, transparent, athletically dominant Catholic high school that publishes more than most.
strings.t: Yon gwo lekòl segondè Katolik, transparan, ki domine nan espò epi ki pibliye plis pase pifò.

strings.text: The profile answers the questions a family actually asks — and the tuition structure answers one no other school on this roster raises.
strings.t: Pwofil la reponn kesyon yon fanmi poze vre — epi estrikti frè eskolè a reponn youn okenn lòt lekòl sou lis sa a pa poze.

strings.text: The disclosure is genuinely strong
strings.t: Divilgasyon an vrèman solid

strings.text: A **10-decile GPA chart including the bottom decile**, stated load norms, an explicit no-rank policy and exam-level AP performance. Most schools publish less and frame it more favourably.
strings.t: Yon **tablo GPA ak 10 desil ki enkli desil ki anba a**, nòm chay ki deklare, yon politik eksplisit pou pa bay ran ak pèfòmans AP nan nivo egzamen. Pifò lekòl pibliye mwens epi prezante l yon fason ki pi favorab.

strings.text: The AP rate cannot be flattered
strings.t: Yo pa ka anbeli to AP a

strings.text: **94% of scores at 3+** across **1,064 exams** is a whole-cohort number, because **the exam is mandatory in every AP course** — weaker candidates cannot be quietly kept out of the denominator.
strings.t: **94% nan nòt yo a 3+** atravè **1,064 egzamen** se yon chif pou tout gwoup la, paske **egzamen an obligatwa nan chak kou AP** — yo pa ka trankilman kite kandida ki pi fèb yo deyò denominatè a.

strings.text: Read the college list as matriculations
strings.t: Li lis inivèsite a kòm enskripsyon

strings.text: **169 institutions** is where graduates actually *enrolled*, a smaller measure than an acceptance list by construction. CCHS looks stronger, not weaker, once that is understood.
strings.t: **169 enstitisyon** se kote moun ki gradye yo *enskri* vre, yon mezi ki pi piti pase yon lis aksèptasyon nan estrikti l. CCHS parèt pi fò, se pa pi fèb, yon fwa ou konprann sa.

strings.text: Athletics is the standout
strings.t: Espò se sa ki pi remakab

strings.text: **74 state championships** since 2000 and **8 Wells Fargo Cups**, won inside the **NCHSAA** against public schools rather than in a private-school bracket.
strings.t: **74 chanpyona eta** depi 2000 ak **8 Wells Fargo Cups**, genyen anndan **NCHSAA** kont lekòl piblik olye ke nan yon gwoup lekòl prive.

strings.text: Tuition turns on parish participation
strings.t: Frè eskolè a depann de patisipasyon nan parwas la

strings.text: **$15,041** for a participating Catholic family against **$21,562** at the community rate — a ~30% difference driven by parish involvement rather than financial need, and the single biggest cost variable here.
strings.t: **$15,041** pou yon fanmi Katolik k ap patisipe kont **$21,562** nan to kominote a — yon diferans ~30% ki soti nan patisipasyon nan parwas la olye ke bezwen finansye, epi se pi gwo varyab depans isit la.

strings.text: The gaps are structural, not sloppy
strings.t: Mank yo estriktirèl, se pa neglijans

strings.text: No per-school aid figures (MACS publishes diocese-wide only), **no Form 990** (the diocese is exempt as a religious organization), and no published tuition history.
strings.t: Pa gen chif èd pa lekòl (MACS pibliye pou tout dyosèz la sèlman), **pa gen Form 990** (dyosèz la egzante kòm yon òganizasyon relijye), epi pa gen istorik frè eskolè ki pibliye.

strings.text: Are we a participating Catholic family for tuition purposes — and what exactly does the parish require to qualify?
strings.t: Èske nou se yon fanmi Katolik k ap patisipe pou rezon frè eskolè — epi kisa parwas la mande egzakteman pou kalifye?

strings.text: What did Family Individualized Tuition actually award families like ours last year? The diocese publishes no per-school aid figures.
strings.t: Kisa Family Individualized Tuition te bay fanmi tankou pa nou an ane pase vre? Dyosèz la pa pibliye okenn chif èd pa lekòl.

strings.text: My child wants AP courses — what does the application for each course weigh, and how many applicants are turned away?
strings.t: Pitit mwen an vle kou AP — kisa aplikasyon pou chak kou konsidere, epi konbyen aplikan yo refize?

strings.text: AP exams are mandatory here. What happens to a student who takes an AP course and does poorly on the exam?
strings.t: Egzamen AP yo obligatwa isit la. Kisa k ap rive yon elèv ki pran yon kou AP epi ki fè mal nan egzamen an?

strings.text: How does the counseling office split 324 seniors six ways — is a counselor assigned by alphabet, by grade, or followed through four years?
strings.t: Kijan biwo oryantasyon an divize 324 elèv dènye ane sou sis moun — èske yo bay yon konseye pa alfabè, pa nivo, oswa èske li swiv elèv la pandan kat ane?

strings.text: What does the Options Program actually provide day to day, and who staffs the support behind those courses?
strings.t: Kisa Options Program lan bay vre chak jou, epi kiyès ki bay sipò ki dèyè kou sa yo?

strings.text: The band performs in Dublin every four years — what does a family pay for that, and when is the next one?
strings.t: Fanfa a jwe nan Dublin chak kat ane — konbyen yon fanmi peye pou sa, epi kilè pwochen an?

strings.text: Which sports hold separate fall and spring signing days, and where are those results published?
strings.t: Ki espò ki gen jou siyati otòn ak prentan apa, epi ki kote yo pibliye rezilta sa yo?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Charlotte Country Day School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 46.7% over the last five entering classes — 328 acceptances from 702 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Charlotte Country Day School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 46.7% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 328 admisyon sou 702 aplikasyon.

strings.text: NC State University is the hard one: 22.9% in Fall 2025 — 11 of 48 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: NC State University se sa ki difisil la: 22.9% nan otòn 2025 — 11 sou 48 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: **Organic Chemistry** and **Physical Computational Biochemistry** run as post-AP semester electives, the former explicitly for students who have finished AP or IB Chemistry.

strings.text: No numeric rubric, but a **“Most Rigorous Courses by Discipline”** table naming the ceiling course in each subject, plus AP-load buckets (0–2 / 3–5 / 6+) that let a reader locate a candidate against classmates.
strings.t: Pa gen rubrik nimerik, men yon tab **“Most Rigorous Courses by Discipline”** ki nonmen kou plafon an nan chak matyè, plis gwoup chay AP (0–2 / 3–5 / 6+) ki pèmèt yon moun k ap li plase yon kandida kont kanmarad klas li.

strings.text: The two most recent profiles publish different grading scales: 2025–26 gives full plus/minus bands including an A+ at 98–100, while 2024–25 gives only whole-letter ranges. Whether the scale changed or the earlier edition merely summarised is unclear, and the presence of an A+ band decides whether an unweighted GPA can exceed 4.0.
strings.t: De pwofil ki pi resan yo pibliye echèl nòt diferan: 2025–26 bay bann plis/mwens konplè ki enkli yon A+ nan 98–100, pandan 2024–25 bay sèlman ranje lèt konplè. Nou pa klè si echèl la te chanje oswa si ansyen edisyon an te senpleman rezime l, epi prezans yon bann A+ deside si yon GPA san pwa ka depase 4.0.

strings.text: The five-year IB Diploma pass rate is 88% in the 2025–26 profile and 91% in the 2024–25 profile — both stated as “over the last five years”. Both figures are shown.
strings.t: To reyisit Diplòm IB senk ane a se 88% nan pwofil 2025–26 la ak 91% nan pwofil 2024–25 la — tou de deklare kòm “sou senk dènye ane yo”. Nou montre tou de chif yo.

strings.text: No mandatory-AP-exam policy is published, so the 93% rests on an unstated denominator. The curriculum page says the exam “is the driver for the curriculum”, which implies a strong expectation but is not a stated requirement. AP Scholar counts have not been published since 2021.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn politik egzamen AP obligatwa ki pibliye, kidonk 93% la chita sou yon baz kalkil ki pa deklare. Paj kourikoulòm nan di egzamen an “se sa k ap kondwi kourikoulòm nan”, sa ki sijere yon gwo atant men se pa yon kondisyon ki deklare. Kantite AP Scholar pa pibliye depi 2021.

strings.text: The Class of 2026 submitted **1,107 applications to 203 institutions** — about eight per student. Transcripts and the school report are owned by a dedicated registrar, and testing accommodations are handled by the Educational Resource Program rather than the college office.

strings.text: Two official sources name different directors, and both were correct when written: the 2025–26 School Profile lists Catherine Odum, while the current web pages list Allison Slater Tate. A February 2026 news post resolves it — Tate was appointed effective 1 July 2026, and Odum moved to Senior Associate Director. The profile is now stale on this point.
strings.t: De sous ofisyèl nonmen direktè diferan, epi tou de te kòrèk lè yo te ekri yo: School Profile 2025–26 la liste Catherine Odum, pandan paj entènèt aktyèl yo liste Allison Slater Tate. Yon piblikasyon nouvèl fevriye 2026 rezoud li — yo te nonmen Tate an vigè 1ye jiyè 2026, epi Odum te deplase nan Direktè Asosye Prensipal. Pwofil la kounye a ansyen sou pwen sa a.

strings.text: Both ratios are derived (548 ÷ 5 and 141 ÷ 5); the school publishes no ratio. The real caseload is probably juniors plus seniors, nearer 1:56. No counselor bios, tenures, degrees or prior employers are published — the team page gives names, titles and contact details only.
strings.t: Tou de rapò yo derive (548 ÷ 5 ak 141 ÷ 5); lekòl la pa pibliye okenn rapò. Vrè chay la se pwobableman elèv twazyèm ane plis dènye ane, pi pre 1:56. Pa gen okenn byografi konseye, ansyènte, diplòm oswa ansyen patwon ki pibliye — paj ekip la bay non, tit ak enfòmasyon kontak sèlman.

strings.text: No count of campus visits made by counseling staff is published anywhere, and no named scholarship-search tool or database is described.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kantite vizit sou kanpis estaf konsèy la fè ki pibliye okenn kote, epi yo pa dekri okenn zouti oswa baz done rechèch bous ki gen non.

Note that none of the seven Ivies is bolded for the Class of 2026: no member of that class enrolled at an Ivy, though the Class of 2025 enrolled at Brown, Cornell, Dartmouth, Princeton and Yale. That is a real year-over-year swing rather than a data artefact.
strings.t: Kantite yo kalkile apati menm lis 320 enstitisyon ou ka filtre adwat la, evalye kont tab U.S. News 2026 yo — analiz derive, se pa lekòl la ki rapòte l. Note pa gen okenn nan sèt Ivy yo ki an gra pou Klas 2026 la: okenn manm klas sa a pa t enskri nan yon Ivy, byenke Klas 2025 la te enskri nan Brown, Cornell, Dartmouth, Princeton ak Yale. Sa se yon vrè chanjman ane apre ane olye ke yon defo nan done yo.

strings.text: Treat the “34 Morehead-Cain recipients” figure carefully: the College Counseling landing page shows it beside Class of 2026 statistics, but the Class of 2026 produced exactly one Morehead-Cain Scholar. The 34 is a cumulative, all-time count whose window the school never states. Robertson Scholars and NC State Park Scholars appear only in the 2015–16 profile and should not be presented as current pipelines.
strings.t: Trete chif “34 moun ki resevwa Morehead-Cain” la avèk atansyon: paj College Counseling la montre l bò kote estatistik Klas 2026, men Klas 2026 la pwodui egzakteman yon sèl Morehead-Cain Scholar. 34 la se yon kantite kimilatif, pou tout tan, epi lekòl la pa janm di ki peryòd li kouvri. Robertson Scholars ak NC State Park Scholars parèt sèlman nan pwofil 2015–16 la epi yo pa dwe prezante kòm rezo aktyèl.

strings.text: this is a four-year cumulative acceptance list, not a matriculation list. Roughly 320 institutions appear because about 564 students across four classes each applied to around eight colleges. Only the bolded names — 69 recovered here against the school’s stated 70 — represent institutions actually enrolling a member of the Class of 2026, and 141 students spread across just 70 destinations. The school does not publish a precise percentage enrolling at four-year colleges; the “100%” it cites is an admission rate.
strings.t: sa a se yon lis aksepte kimilatif kat ane, se pa yon lis enskripsyon. Apeprè 320 enstitisyon parèt paske anviwon 564 elèv atravè kat klas chak te aplike nan apeprè uit inivèsite. Se sèlman non ki an gra yo — 69 nou rekipere isit la kont 70 lekòl la deklare — ki reprezante enstitisyon ki vrèman enskri yon manm Klas 2026, epi 141 elèv gaye atravè sèlman 70 destinasyon. Lekòl la pa pibliye yon pousantaj presi ki enskri nan inivèsite kat ane; “100%” li site a se yon to admisyon.

strings.text: The enrolling markers were recovered from the acceptance PDF’s embedded font runs, because bold is lost in plain-text extraction. That returned 69 names against the school’s own count of 70 — treat 70 as authoritative and this list as about 97% complete.
strings.t: Nou rekipere mak enskripsyon yo nan seri font ki entegre nan PDF aksepte a, paske gra pèdi nan ekstraksyon tèks senp. Sa te bay 69 non kont pwòp kantite lekòl la ki se 70 — trete 70 kòm otorite a epi lis sa a kòm anviwon 97% konplè.

strings.text: The IB Diploma is the structural differentiator — a second route to maximum rigour — and the Senior Externship turns 175+ local employers into a network only this school has.
strings.t: Diplòm IB la se diferans estriktirèl la — yon dezyèm wout pou rive nan rigè maksimòm — epi Senior Externship la konvèti 175+ patwon lokal an yon rezo se sèlman lekòl sa a ki genyen.

strings.text: What Country Day does not have is a required capstone or research thesis; its spike-building is programme breadth rather than a single mandated credential.
strings.t: Sa Country Day pa genyen se yon kapston oswa yon tèz rechèch obligatwa; konstriksyon espesyalite li se etandi pwogram olye ke yon sèl kalifikasyon obligatwa.

strings.text: **IB Diploma Programme** — Country Day was the **first school in North Carolina** to offer it. About 20 students a year take the full diploma from junior year, at an 88% five-year pass rate. For a student whose strengths are not AP-shaped, it is a second legible path to maximum rigour, and it carries an Extended Essay by construction.
strings.t: **IB Diploma Programme** — Country Day se te **premye lekòl nan North Carolina** ki te ofri l. Anviwon 20 elèv pa ane pran diplòm konplè a apati twazyèm ane, ak yon to reyisit 88% sou senk ane. Pou yon elèv ki gen fòs ki pa nan fòm AP, se yon dezyèm wout lizib pou rive nan rigè maksimòm, epi li pote yon Extended Essay pa konstriksyon.

strings.text: **Senior Externship** — a January job-shadowing immersion launched in 2017, partnered with **175+ local employers across 20+ industries**. In a recent year **136 seniors** placed with 68 Charlotte-area employers, hosts drawn largely from current and past parents and alumni.
strings.t: **Senior Externship** — yon imèsyon nan swiv travay nan janvye ki te lanse an 2017, ak patenarya ak **175+ patwon lokal atravè 20+ endistri**. Nan yon ane resan **136 elèv dènye ane** te plase ak 68 patwon nan zòn Charlotte, ak moun ki resevwa yo ki soti sitou nan paran aktyèl ak ansyen ak ansyen elèv.

strings.text: **Science Outreach Program** — rising juniors and seniors work with science professors at local institutions on primary research over the summer, then present at the annual Science Symposium.
strings.t: **Science Outreach Program** — elèv k ap antre nan twazyèm ak dènye ane travay ak pwofesè syans nan enstitisyon lokal sou rechèch prensipal pandan ete a, apre sa yo prezante nan Science Symposium anyèl la.

strings.text: **Weddington Farm** — a **330-acre living classroom** with produce, livestock, beekeeping, mushroom farming and a ten-mile trail system, feeding sustainable-agriculture, ecology and entrepreneurship programming. A genuinely uncommon asset for an urban independent school.
strings.t: **Weddington Farm** — yon **sal klas vivan 330 kawo tè** ak pwodwi, bèt, apikilti, kilti djondjon ak yon sistèm santye dis mil, k ap alimante pwogramasyon nan agrikilti dirab, ekoloji ak antreprenarya. Yon byen vrèman ki pa abityèl pou yon lekòl endepandan iben.

strings.text: **Special Olympics Mecklenburg County Spring Games** — the Upper School has taken a two-day break from classes every April **since 1984** to host. A 40-year institutional commitment reads very differently to an admissions office than a service club.
strings.t: **Special Olympics Mecklenburg County Spring Games** — Upper School la pran yon poz de jou nan klas chak avril **depi 1984** pou resevwa yo. Yon angajman enstitisyonèl 40 ane li byen diferan pou yon biwo admisyon pase yon klib sèvis.

strings.text: There is no required internship, capstone or independent research thesis. The Senior Externship is a single day and is never stated to be mandatory, though 136 of ~141 seniors taking part implies it is near-universal in practice.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn estaj, kapston oswa tèz rechèch endepandan obligatwa. Senior Externship la se yon sèl jou epi yo pa janm di li obligatwa, byenke 136 nan ~141 elèv dènye ane k ap patisipe sijere li prèske inivèsèl an pratik.

strings.text: **The School Profile as an instrument** — and the 2025–26 edition is materially stronger than its predecessor. It ties GPA quintiles to median SAT *and* median ACT, names the ceiling course in every discipline, publishes AP-load buckets, states the weighting formula, and discloses AP results by discipline including the weak spots (Fine Arts at 81%/36%). That candour is itself a credibility signal.
strings.t: **School Profile la kòm yon zouti** — epi edisyon 2025–26 la materyèlman pi solid pase sa anvan l lan. Li makonnen senkyèm GPA ak SAT medyàn *ak* ACT medyàn, li nonmen kou plafon an nan chak disiplin, li pibliye gwoup chay AP, li deklare fòmil pwa a, epi li divilge rezilta AP pa disiplin ki enkli pwen fèb yo (Fine Arts nan 81%/36%). Franchiz sa a se yon siy kredibilite li menm.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — an annually pledged Honor Code with a student-run Honor Council, plus ACCIS, NACAC and SACAC membership. Faculty credibility markers matter here too: the Upper School includes **AP exam readers**, National Board graders and Klingenstein Fellows, with 82% holding advanced degrees.
strings.t: **Siyal sou entegrite** — yon Kòd Onè yo pran angajman pou li chak ane ak yon Honor Council elèv yo dirije, plis manbraj ACCIS, NACAC ak SACAC. Mak kredibilite pwofesè enpòtan isit la tou: Upper School la enkli **moun k ap korije egzamen AP**, korektè National Board ak Klingenstein Fellows, ak 82% ki genyen diplòm avanse.

strings.text: **A dominant UNC–Chapel Hill pipeline** — 32 Class of 2026 students enrolled there, 23% of the class, alongside 34 cumulative Morehead-Cain recipients. Add a standing Jefferson Scholar link to UVA and a decade of service-academy appointments.
strings.t: **Yon rezo UNC–Chapel Hill ki domine** — 32 elèv Klas 2026 te enskri la, 23% nan klas la, ansanm ak 34 moun ki resevwa Morehead-Cain kimilatif. Ajoute yon lyen Jefferson Scholar pèmanan ak UVA ak yon deseni nominasyon nan akademi sèvis.

strings.text: **A substantial HBCU pipeline** — North Carolina A&T, Howard, Hampton and Clark Atlanta all enrolling for the Class of 2026, with a February One Scholarship and a Ron Brown Scholar among recent awards.
strings.t: **Yon gwo rezo HBCU** — North Carolina A&T, Howard, Hampton ak Clark Atlanta tout ki enskri pou Klas 2026 la, ak yon February One Scholarship ak yon Ron Brown Scholar pami dènye prim yo.

strings.text: The school does not publish its disciplinary-disclosure policy — whether and how Honor Council findings or suspensions reach the secondary school report. Given published NACAC membership, that omission is a sharp tour question.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye politik divilgasyon disiplinè li — si ak kijan konklizyon Honor Council oswa sispansyon rive nan rapò lekòl segondè a. Lè w konsidere manbraj NACAC ki pibliye a, omisyon sa a se yon kesyon file pou yon vizit.

strings.text: Arts events per year are “50+” in the 2025–26 profile but “70” in the 2024–25 edition — the figure went down. Both are shown.
strings.t: Evènman atistik pa ane se “50+” nan pwofil 2025–26 la men “70” nan edisyon 2024–25 la — chif la desann. Nou montre tou de.

strings.text: The quintile table is the honest answer for the middle of the class — the fourth fifth sits at a 3.513 GPA with a 1220 SAT, the fifth at 2.991 and 1110.
strings.t: Tab senkyèm nan se repons onèt la pou mitan klas la — katriyèm senkyèm nan chita nan yon GPA 3.513 ak yon SAT 1220, senkyèm nan nan 2.991 ak 1110.

strings.text: Country Day publishes what most schools hide, and its acceptance list matches that spread: Princeton and MIT at one end, Cape Fear and Central Piedmont community colleges at the other.
strings.t: Country Day pibliye sa pifò lekòl kache, epi lis aksepte li a matche ak diferans sa a: Princeton ak MIT nan yon bout, inivèsite kominotè Cape Fear ak Central Piedmont nan lòt la.

strings.t: Bout mitan-50% yo SE 25yèm ak 75yèm pousantaj yo, kidonk kolòn sa yo reyèl; 10yèm, 50yèm ak 90yèm yo montre kòm “—” paske lekòl la pa janm pibliye yo, epi li pa janm pibliye ni yon mwayèn ni kantite moun ki pase tès.

strings.t: — Klas 2024 · dènye chif ACT lekòl la pibliye

strings.text: For long-run context, the Class of 2015 composite middle 50% was 26–31 against 24–31 here: the floor fell two points while the ceiling held. Plausibly a test-optional composition effect, but the school offers no explanation.
strings.t: Pou kontèks sou lontan, konpozit mitan 50% Klas 2015 la se te 26–31 kont 24–31 isit la: planche a te tonbe de pwen pandan plafon an te rete. Sa ka yon efè konpozisyon nan epòk tès opsyonèl, men lekòl la pa bay okenn eksplikasyon.

strings.text: — the no-rank mechanism · Class of 2025 median weighted GPA, with median SAT and ACT
strings.t: — mekanis san ran an · GPA ak pwa medyàn Klas 2025, ak SAT ak ACT medyàn

strings.t: 1470 SAT · 33 ACT
