strings.text: All five quintiles are the school’s own published figures — nothing is interpolated — and tying each fifth to a median SAT and ACT was new in the 2025–26 profile. Grades reflect work done at Country Day only, as of the end of junior year. Over ten years the distribution has stretched at both ends: the top-quintile mean rose from 4.198 to 4.540 while the bottom-quintile floor fell from 2.546 to 2.076.
strings.t: Tout senk senkyèm yo se pwòp chif lekòl la pibliye — pa gen anyen ki entèpole — epi makonnen chak senkyèm ak yon SAT ak ACT medyàn se te yon bagay nouvo nan pwofil 2025–26 la. Nòt yo reflete travay ki fèt nan Country Day sèlman, dapre fen twazyèm ane a. Sou dis ane distribisyon an lonje nan tou de bout: mwayèn senkyèm anwo a te monte soti 4.198 rive 4.540 pandan planche senkyèm anba a te tonbe soti 2.546 rive 2.076.

strings.text: The Educational Resource Program
strings.t: Educational Resource Program nan

strings.text: A named JK–12 structure covering tutoring, accommodations, assessments and evaluation referrals, delivered as hourly sessions before, during or after the school day.
strings.t: Yon estrikti JK–12 ki gen non ki kouvri titora, akomodasyon, evalyasyon ak referans pou evalyasyon, ki bay kòm sesyon pa èdtan anvan, pandan oswa apre jounen lekòl la.

strings.text: The Upper School model
strings.t: Modèl Upper School la

strings.text: **Academic coaches** support content areas and executive function, while **learning specialists** work one-on-one so students “recognize and utilize their strengths” and become independent learners and self-advocates.
strings.t: **Antrenè akademik** sipòte domèn kontni ak fonksyon egzekitif, pandan **espesyalis aprantisaj** travay youn a youn pou elèv yo “rekonèt epi sèvi ak fòs yo” epi vin moun k ap aprann endepandan ki ka defann tèt yo.

strings.text: Where it reaches the application
strings.t: Kote li rive nan aplikasyon an

strings.text: Uniquely among the schools here, the ERP explicitly **“assists in requesting accommodations with the College Board, ACT, and IB”** — the hand-off into admissions testing is stated rather than left implicit.
strings.t: Inikman pami lekòl isit yo, ERP la eksplisitman **“ede nan mande akomodasyon nan College Board, ACT, ak IB”** — pasaj la nan tès admisyon an deklare olye ke kite l enplisit.

strings.text: No learning specialist or academic coach is named anywhere, and no staff count or credentials are published — so the caseload behind that model is unknown.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn espesyalis aprantisaj oswa antrenè akademik ki nonmen okenn kote, epi pa gen kantite estaf oswa kalifikasyon ki pibliye — kidonk chay ki dèyè modèl sa a enkoni.

strings.text: The enrolling names are not a top-25 highlight reel — Appalachian State, East Carolina, UNC–Charlotte, High Point, Queens, Liberty, Tampa, Mississippi, Kentucky and Southwest Minnesota State all appear. **55% of the Class of 2026 enrolled at public universities** and 32% stayed in North Carolina.
strings.t: Non ki enskri yo se pa yon lis top-25 — Appalachian State, East Carolina, UNC–Charlotte, High Point, Queens, Liberty, Tampa, Mississippi, Kentucky ak Southwest Minnesota State tout parèt. **55% nan Klas 2026 la te enskri nan inivèsite piblik** epi 32% te rete nan North Carolina.

strings.text: Community colleges published
strings.t: Inivèsite kominotè ki pibliye

strings.text: Cape Fear and Central Piedmont both appear on the acceptance list. Many peer schools quietly omit their community-college acceptances; publishing them is a meaningful transparency signal.
strings.t: Cape Fear ak Central Piedmont tou de parèt sou lis aksepte a. Anpil lekòl parèy kite aksepte nan inivèsite kominotè yo deyò an silans; pibliye yo se yon siy transparans enpòtan.

strings.text: About fourteen dedicated arts and music institutions (Berklee enrolling, plus Manhattan School of Music, RISD, Pratt, SAIC, Parsons in New York and Paris, UNCSA); all three federal service academies with a Naval Academy appointment; and around eleven international universities including Toronto, St Andrews, Edinburgh and Durham.
strings.t: Anviwon katòz enstitisyon atistik ak mizik dedye (Berklee ki enskri, plis Manhattan School of Music, RISD, Pratt, SAIC, Parsons nan New York ak Pari, UNCSA); tout twa akademi sèvis federal yo ak yon nominasyon nan Naval Academy; ak anviwon onz inivèsite entènasyonal ki enkli Toronto, St Andrews, Edinburgh ak Durham.

strings.text: The 2025–26 profile DROPPED the SAT and ACT middle-50% ranges that the 2024–25 edition published, replacing them with per-quintile medians. The number of testers has never been published in any year — a table showing medians without a sample size shows a shape without an N.
strings.t: Pwofil 2025–26 la te RETIRE ranje mitan-50% SAT ak ACT edisyon 2024–25 la te pibliye yo, epi li te ranplase yo ak medyàn pa senkyèm. Kantite moun ki pase tès pa janm pibliye nan okenn ane — yon tab ki montre medyàn san yon gwosè echantiyon montre yon fòm san yon N.

strings.text: The two profiles give the Class of 2025 different senior counts (138 versus 141) and report different statistics for the same class — means and ranges in one edition, medians in the other — so the top-quintile 4.540 mean and 4.472 median are both correct and not comparable.
strings.t: De pwofil yo bay Klas 2025 la kantite elèv dènye ane diferan (138 kont 141) epi yo rapòte estatistik diferan pou menm klas la — mwayèn ak ranje nan yon edisyon, medyàn nan lòt la — kidonk mwayèn 4.540 ak medyàn 4.472 senkyèm anwo yo tou de kòrèk epi yo pa konparab.

strings.text: No gap-year counselling, placement count or deferral policy is published, and neither is any direct-to-work or enlistment outcome.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn konsèy, kantite plasman oswa politik sou ane apre diplòm ki pibliye, epi pa gen okenn rezilta sou ale dirèk nan travay oswa nan lame non plis.

strings.text: A deep, stable office and an unusually candid profile — Country Day hands admissions readers more usable context than almost any peer, then declines to publish its own test scores.
strings.t: Yon biwo pwofon ak estab ak yon pwofil ki fran yon fason ki pa abityèl — Country Day bay moun k ap li nan admisyon plis kontèks itil pase prèske nenpòt lekòl parèy, apre sa li refize pibliye pwòp nòt tès li.

strings.text: The strengths are structural and durable; the gaps are disclosure choices, which is exactly what a tour can put pressure on.
strings.t: Fòs yo estriktirèl epi dirab; mank yo se chwa nan divilgasyon, sa ki se egzakteman sa yon vizit ka peze sou li.

strings.text: The profile gives readers more context than peers
strings.t: Pwofil la bay moun k ap li plis kontèks pase lekòl parèy

strings.text: a quintile table tying GPA bands to median SAT *and* median ACT, from 4.472/1470/33 down to 2.991/1110/24. No rank is ever assigned, yet a reader can place any candidate precisely — and the per-quintile test medians were a new investment in 2025–26.
strings.t: yon tab senkyèm ki makonnen bann GPA ak SAT medyàn *ak* ACT medyàn, soti 4.472/1470/33 desann rive 2.991/1110/24. Yo pa janm bay okenn ran, poutan yon moun k ap li ka plase nenpòt kandida avèk presizyon — epi medyàn tès pa senkyèm yo se te yon nouvo envestisman an 2025–26.

strings.text: AP performance is high, improving and candidly disclosed
strings.t: Pèfòmans AP wo, k ap amelyore epi divilge fransman

strings.text: 530 exams at 93% scoring 3+ and 74% at 4–5, up from 89%/70% a year earlier — published discipline by discipline, including Fine Arts at 81%/36% rather than hiding it.
strings.t: 530 egzamen ak 93% ki fè 3+ ak 74% nan 4–5, monte soti 89%/70% yon ane anvan — pibliye disiplin pa disiplin, ki enkli Fine Arts nan 81%/36% olye ke kache l.

strings.text: The IB Diploma is a real structural differentiator
strings.t: Diplòm IB la se yon vrè diferans estriktirèl

strings.text: first in North Carolina to offer it, ~20 full-diploma candidates a year from junior year, 88% five-year pass rate — a second legible path to maximum rigour for students who are not AP-shaped.
strings.t: premye nan North Carolina ki te ofri l, ~20 kandida diplòm konplè pa ane apati twazyèm ane, to reyisit 88% sou senk ane — yon dezyèm wout lizib pou rive nan rigè maksimòm pou elèv ki pa nan fòm AP.

strings.text: The office is deep and stable through a director change
strings.t: Biwo a pwofon epi estab malgre yon chanjman direktè

strings.text: five counselors, 100+ years of combined experience, 150+ reps a year through a structured Scoir Visits programme — and two counselors with a decade-plus in the office, so the July 2026 leadership change sits on institutional memory rather than a vacuum.
strings.t: senk konseye, 100+ ane eksperyans konbine, 150+ reprezantan pa ane atravè yon pwogram Scoir Visits estriktire — epi de konseye ak plis pase yon deseni nan biwo a, kidonk chanjman lidèchip jiyè 2026 la chita sou memwa enstitisyonèl olye ke yon vid.

strings.text: The timeline starts genuinely early
strings.t: Kalandriye a kòmanse vrèman bonè

strings.text: Freshman Seminar and Scoir in 9th grade, PreACT and the Charlotte Area Case Studies mock committee in 10th, one-on-one meetings from junior second semester, and an essay workshop in August before senior year.
strings.t: Freshman Seminar ak Scoir nan 9yèm ane, PreACT ak komite similye Charlotte Area Case Studies nan 10yèm, reyinyon youn a youn apati dezyèm semès twazyèm ane, ak yon atelye redaksyon nan out anvan dènye ane a.

strings.text: The outcomes are honest across the whole distribution
strings.t: Rezilta yo onèt atravè tout distribisyon an

strings.text: 70 destinations for 141 seniors, 55% public and 45% private, community colleges published alongside Princeton and MIT, 32 students to UNC–Chapel Hill, and a substantial HBCU pipeline with four institutions enrolling.
strings.t: 70 destinasyon pou 141 elèv dènye ane, 55% piblik ak 45% prive, inivèsite kominotè pibliye ansanm ak Princeton ak MIT, 32 elèv nan UNC–Chapel Hill, ak yon gwo rezo HBCU ak kat enstitisyon ki enskri.

strings.text: Your 2024–25 profile published SAT and ACT middle-50% ranges and the 2025–26 edition dropped them. Why — and what were the Class of 2025 and 2026 ranges, and how many students tested?
strings.t: Pwofil 2024–25 ou a te pibliye ranje mitan-50% SAT ak ACT epi edisyon 2025–26 la te retire yo. Poukisa — epi ki ranje Klas 2025 ak 2026 yo, epi konbyen elèv ki te pase tès?

strings.text: The Class of 2025 had 2 National Merit Semifinalists where the classes either side had 7 and 6. What happened that year?
strings.t: Klas 2025 la te gen 2 Semifinalis National Merit kote klas ki toutbò l yo te gen 7 ak 6. Kisa ki te pase ane sa a?

strings.text: No Class of 2026 student enrolled at an Ivy, and Harvard is absent across seven published classes. How do you read that, and what does Ivy matriculation look like year over year?
strings.t: Okenn elèv Klas 2026 pa t enskri nan yon Ivy, epi Harvard absan atravè sèt klas ki pibliye. Kijan ou li sa, epi kijan enskripsyon nan Ivy ye ane apre ane?

strings.text: What exactly does the “34 Morehead-Cain recipients” figure cover — how many years? The Class of 2026 post names exactly one.
strings.t: Kisa egzakteman chif “34 moun ki resevwa Morehead-Cain” la kouvri — konbyen ane? Piblikasyon Klas 2026 la nonmen egzakteman youn.

strings.text: How many learning specialists and academic coaches work with Upper School students, what are their credentials, and what is the caseload?
strings.t: Konbyen espesyalis aprantisaj ak antrenè akademik k ap travay ak elèv Upper School, ki kalifikasyon yo, epi ki chay la?

strings.text: How do you report Honor Council findings and disciplinary actions on the secondary school report?
strings.t: Kijan ou rapòte konklizyon Honor Council ak aksyon disiplinè sou rapò lekòl segondè a?

strings.text: How many colleges do your counselors visit each year, is the Senior Externship required, and what gap-year, post-AP computer science, or capstone-research options exist?
strings.t: Konbyen inivèsite konseye ou yo vizite chak ane, èske Senior Externship la obligatwa, epi ki opsyon ki egziste pou ane apre diplòm, syans enfòmatik pòs-AP, oswa rechèch kapston?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Cannon School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 60.8% over the last five entering classes — 479 acceptances from 788 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Cannon School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 60.8% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 479 admisyon sou 788 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 31.7% in Fall 2025 — 20 of 63 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 31.7% nan otòn 2025 — 20 sou 63 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 479 of 788 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 479 sou 788 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 20 of 63, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 20 sou 63, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: drew the most applications in Fall 2025 (63)
strings.t: te resevwa plis aplikasyon nan otòn 2025 (63)

strings.text: Hometown campus · largest admit rates of the six
strings.t: Kanpis lakay · pi gwo to admisyon nan sis yo

strings.text: Cannon publishes something almost no peer does — an explicit maximum AP/AT load by grade, capping a four-year transcript at eleven advanced courses and barring freshmen entirely.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye yon bagay prèske okenn lekòl parèy pa fè — yon chay maksimòm AP/AT eksplisit pa nivo, ki limite yon relve nòt kat ane a onz kou avanse epi ki entèdi elèv premye ane nèt.

strings.text: That ceiling is the key to reading a Cannon transcript: “most rigorous” here has a hard, published limit, and the 92% scoring 3+ comes from students who chose to sit an optional exam.
strings.t: Plafon sa a se kle pou li yon relve nòt Cannon: “pi rijid la” isit la gen yon limit di ki pibliye, epi 92% ki fè 3+ la soti nan elèv ki te chwazi pase yon egzamen opsyonèl.

strings.text: advanced courses — 13 AP plus 8 school-designed Advanced Topics
strings.t: kou avanse — 13 AP plis 8 Advanced Topics lekòl la konsevwa

strings.text: of AP exams scored 3+ (425 exams, 197 students, Class of 2025)
strings.t: nan egzamen AP yo te fè 3+ (425 egzamen, 197 elèv, Klas 2025)

strings.text: published max AP/AT courses in grades 9 / 10 / 11 / 12
strings.t: maksimòm kou AP/AT ki pibliye nan nivo 9 / 10 / 11 / 12

strings.text: “Cannon School does not rank students”
strings.t: “Cannon School pa bay elèv ran”

strings.text: The ceiling is **AP Calculus BC / AP Statistics** — there is no published post-BC course, no multivariable calculus and no linear algebra. An “AT: Calculus with Applications” listed in 2024–25 has disappeared from the 2025–26 table.
strings.t: Plafon an se **AP Calculus BC / AP Statistics** — pa gen okenn kou pòs-BC ki pibliye, pa gen kalkil miltivaryab ak pa gen aljèb lineyè. Yon “AT: Calculus with Applications” ki te liste an 2024–25 disparèt nan tab 2025–26 la.

strings.text: **AP Computer Science only**, with no post-AP course and no data structures — thin relative to the rest of the advanced catalogue.
strings.t: **AP Computer Science sèlman**, san okenn kou pòs-AP ak san estrikti done — mens parapò ak rès katalòg avanse a.

strings.text: Advanced Topics
strings.t: Advanced Topics

strings.text: Eight **school-designed AT courses** sit alongside the APs and carry the same 1.0 quality point, several with no corresponding College Board exam at all — for example AT: Design Thinking for Entrepreneurship.
strings.t: Uit **kou AT lekòl la konsevwa** chita akote AP yo epi yo pote menm 1.0 pwen kalite a, plizyè san okenn egzamen College Board korespondan ditou — pa egzanp AT: Design Thinking for Entrepreneurship.

strings.text: No Global Online Academy membership and no dual-enrolment partnership is published — this was checked specifically.
strings.t: Pa gen manbraj Global Online Academy ak pa gen patenarya enskripsyon doub ki pibliye — nou tcheke sa espesyalman.

strings.text: Weighted narrowly, and deliberately
strings.t: Ak pwa etwat, epi espre

strings.text: AT and AP courses carry **1.0 quality point; Honors and Honors Accelerated are not weighted at all**. Both weighted and unweighted GPAs are calculated from Cannon coursework only.
strings.t: Kou AT ak AP pote **1.0 pwen kalite; Honors ak Honors Accelerated pa gen pwa ditou**. Yo kalkile GPA ak pwa ak san pwa apati kou Cannon sèlman.

strings.text: No rank, and a modest ceiling
strings.t: Pa gen ran, ak yon plafon modès

strings.text: No rank, no decile or quintile table — but the narrow weighting plus the eleven-course cap means the weighted top decile tops out around **4.28**. Cannon does not produce inflated 4.9 GPAs, which needs context for readers used to heavier schemes.
strings.t: Pa gen ran, pa gen tab dizyèm oswa senkyèm — men pwa etwat la plis limit onz kou a vle di dizyèm anwo ak pwa a rive nan tèt otou **4.28**. Cannon pa pwodui GPA anfle 4.9, sa ki bezwen kontèks pou moun ki abitye ak sistèm pi lou.

strings.text: A per-discipline rigour key
strings.t: Yon kle rigè pa disiplin

strings.text: Bold entries in the profile’s course table mark the “most demanding coursework in that discipline per appropriate grade level”, so a reader can see the ceiling subject by subject rather than guessing.
strings.t: Antre an gra nan tab kou pwofil la make “kou ki pi egzijan nan disiplin sa a pou nivo ki apwopriye a”, kidonk yon moun k ap li ka wè plafon an matyè pa matyè olye ke devine.

strings.text: AP exams are OPTIONAL — “students in AT/AP classes have the option of sitting for the appropriate AP exam”. The 92.39% scoring 3+ therefore rests on a self-selected pool and is not directly comparable with schools that mandate the exam. The 197-student denominator is also undefined: it most likely means all Upper School exam takers rather than members of the 111-person graduating class.
strings.t: Egzamen AP yo OPSYONÈL — “elèv nan klas AT/AP gen opsyon pou pase egzamen AP ki apwopriye a”. 92.39% ki fè 3+ la kidonk chita sou yon gwoup ki chwazi tèt li epi li pa dirèkteman konparab ak lekòl ki egzije egzamen an. Baz kalkil 197 elèv la pa defini tou: gen anpil chans li vle di tout elèv Upper School ki pase egzamen olye ke manm klas 111 moun ki gradye a.

strings.text: No National Merit ledger of any kind is published — no Semifinalist, Finalist or Commended counts in any year, on either profile or in news posts. Repeated searches surfaced only a 2011 item naming a single Scholar. AP Scholar counts and the share scoring 4–5 are likewise unpublished; Cannon reports only the 3+ threshold.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn lis National Merit ditou ki pibliye — pa gen kantite Semifinalis, Finalis oswa Commended nan okenn ane, ni sou pwofil la ni nan piblikasyon nouvèl. Rechèch repete te bay sèlman yon atik 2011 ki nonmen yon sèl Scholar. Kantite AP Scholar ak pòsyon ki fè 4–5 la pa pibliye menm jan an; Cannon rapòte sèlman sèy 3+ la.

strings.text: The full grading scale appeared in the 2024–25 profile and was dropped from the 2025–26 edition — a disclosure regression, since a reader of the current profile cannot map a letter grade to a quality point.
strings.t: Echèl nòt konplè a te parèt nan pwofil 2024–25 la epi yo te retire l nan edisyon 2025–26 la — yon rekil nan divilgasyon, paske yon moun k ap li pwofil aktyèl la pa ka makonnen yon nòt lèt ak yon pwen kalite.

strings.text: Cannon promises something structural that most schools do not: a student keeps the same college counselor for all four years, rather than being handed off in junior year.
strings.t: Cannon pwomèt yon bagay estriktirèl pifò lekòl pa fè: yon elèv kenbe menm konseye inivèsite a pandan tout kat ane yo, olye ke yo pase l bay yon lòt nan twazyèm ane.

strings.text: Five staff, zero turnover across two published profiles, and a co-director model — plus the regional case-studies programme it physically hosts.
strings.t: Senk estaf, zewo woulman atravè de pwofil ki pibliye, ak yon modèl ko-direktè — plis pwogram etid ka rejyonal la li resevwa fizikman.

strings.text: the school’s published ratio — reachable only counting seniors
strings.t: rapò lekòl la pibliye — ou ka rive nan li sèlman si w konte elèv dènye ane

strings.text: staff — two co-directors, two associates, one coordinator
strings.t: estaf — de ko-direktè, de asosye, yon kòdonatè

strings.text: 4 years
strings.t: 4 ane

strings.text: the same counselor for a student’s whole Upper School career
strings.t: menm konseye a pou tout karyè Upper School yon elèv

strings.text: platform, alongside an annually refreshed School Profile
strings.t: platfòm, ansanm ak yon School Profile ki mete ajou chak ane

strings.text: Co-Director
strings.t: Ko-Direktè

strings.text: Cannon runs an unusual shared top role rather than a single director.
strings.t: Cannon fè yon wòl anwo pataje ki pa abityèl olye ke yon sèl direktè.

strings.text: The roster is identical across the 2024–25 and 2025–26 profiles.
strings.t: Lis la idantik atravè pwofil 2024–25 ak 2025–26 yo.

strings.text: Coordinator
strings.t: Kòdonatè

strings.text: Zero turnover across at least two years is itself a stability signal.
strings.t: Zewo woulman atravè omwen de ane se yon siy estabilite li menm.

strings.t: Pwogram ki pibliye a — pou paran, pa nivo

strings.t: Konsèy kòmanse nan nevyèm ane kòm yon pwogram kat ane ki deklare

strings.t: Entèpretasyon tès

strings.text: That is the published scope. Note what is absent from it: essay coaching or brainstorming workshops, a teacher-recommendation coordination process, interview preparation, and any scholarship-search service are none of them explicitly claimed — consistent with the absence of a scholarship-dollar headline.
strings.t: Sa se etandi ki pibliye a. Note sa ki absan ladan l: antrènman oswa atelye ide pou redaksyon, yon pwosesis kòdinasyon rekòmandasyon pwofesè, preparasyon entèvyou, ak nenpòt sèvis rechèch bous — yo pa reklame okenn nan yo eksplisitman, sa ki konsistan ak absans yon gwo chif dola bous.

strings.text: **Hosts** the Lake Norman Area College Admissions Case Studies Program and College Fair, co-hosted with Davidson Day — Cannon is the venue
strings.t: Li **resevwa** Lake Norman Area College Admissions Case Studies Program ak College Fair la, ko-resevwa ak Davidson Day — Cannon se kote a

strings.text: Second annual edition held **26 April 2026**, confirmed independently from a college’s own registration portal
strings.t: Dezyèm edisyon anyèl la te fèt **26 avril 2026**, konfime endepandamman apati pwòp pòtay enskripsyon yon inivèsite

strings.text: The marketed “28:1 ratio” only works as seniors per counselor (111 ÷ 4). Measured across the 423-student Upper School it is nearer 106:1, and the school never states the denominator — so 28:1 should not be read as a whole-Upper-School caseload.
strings.t: “Rapò 28:1” yo fè piblisite pou li a mache sèlman kòm elèv dènye ane pa konseye (111 ÷ 4). Mezire atravè Upper School 423 elèv la li pi pre 106:1, epi lekòl la pa janm di ki baz kalkil la — kidonk 28:1 pa dwe li kòm yon chay pou tout Upper School la.

strings.text: No counselor tenure, prior background, degrees or biographies are published — names and titles only, so director tenure is unknown. Neither rep-visit counts nor counselor campus-visit counts are published in any form. Note that Davidson Day’s published “80+ reps a year” belongs to Davidson Day, not Cannon.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn ansyènte konseye, background, diplòm oswa byografi ki pibliye — non ak tit sèlman, kidonk ansyènte direktè a enkoni. Ni kantite vizit reprezantan ni kantite vizit kanpis konseye yo pa pibliye nan okenn fòm. Note “80+ reprezantan pa ane” Davidson Day pibliye a se pou Davidson Day, se pa pou Cannon.

strings.text: The student-facing curriculum is unpublished: seminar cadence, one-on-one meeting counts, essay workshops and junior conference timing appear nowhere. Cannon publishes what it invites parents to, not what it does with students. A four-year self-exploration strand described in the 2024–25 profile was cut from the 2025–26 edition without explanation.
strings.t: Kourikoulòm ki gade elèv la pa pibliye: ritm seminè, kantite reyinyon youn a youn, atelye redaksyon ak lè konferans twazyèm ane a pa parèt okenn kote. Cannon pibliye sa li envite paran yo nan li, se pa sa li fè ak elèv yo. Yon branch eksplorasyon pèsonèl kat ane ki te dekri nan pwofil 2024–25 la te koupe nan edisyon 2025–26 la san eksplikasyon.

strings.text: Cannon publishes what most schools here do not — an actual matriculation list. 58 institutions enrolled a Class of 2023 graduate, including Stanford, Duke, Penn, UCLA and the Air Force Academy.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye sa pifò lekòl isit yo pa fè — yon vrè lis enskripsyon. 58 enstitisyon te enskri yon gradye Klas 2023, ki enkli Stanford, Duke, Penn, UCLA ak Air Force Academy.

strings.text: That list is far stronger evidence than the acceptance rollup beside it, which aggregates three graduating classes and has not been refreshed since the Class of 2024.
strings.t: Lis sa a se yon prèv pi solid lwen pase rezime aksepte ki bò kote l la, ki total twa klas ki gradye epi ki pa mete ajou depi Klas 2024 la.

strings.text: Counts are computed from the same list you can filter at right, scored against the 2026 U.S. News tables — derived analysis, not school-reported. The Ivy count is reported strictly: the list contains “Columbia College”, which almost certainly means Columbia College in South Carolina, Chicago or Missouri rather than Columbia University, since the latter would be printed as “Columbia University”. Read loosely it would be 4 of 8; both readings are stated rather than one being picked.
strings.t: Kantite yo kalkile apati menm lis ou ka filtre adwat la, evalye kont tab U.S. News 2026 yo — analiz derive, se pa lekòl la ki rapòte l. Nou rapòte kantite Ivy a estrikteman: lis la gen “Columbia College”, ki prèske sètènman vle di Columbia College nan South Carolina, Chicago oswa Missouri olye ke Columbia University, paske dènye a ta enprime kòm “Columbia University”. Li nan yon fason lach li ta 4 nan 8; nou deklare tou de lekti yo olye ke chwazi youn.

strings.text: This is Cannon’s single largest outcome-data gap. No merit-scholarship dollar figure appears on either profile or in any news post, and no current Morehead-Cain, Park, QuestBridge or ROTC outcome is published. Cannon does publish $3,000,000 in tuition assistance to 24% of its students — but that is the school’s own inbound financial aid, not college merit money, and the two must not be conflated.
strings.t: Sa a se pi gwo mank nan done rezilta Cannon. Pa gen okenn chif dola bous merit ki parèt ni sou pwofil la ni nan okenn piblikasyon nouvèl, epi pa gen okenn rezilta Morehead-Cain, Park, QuestBridge oswa ROTC aktyèl ki pibliye. Cannon pibliye vre $3,000,000 nan asistans frè eskolè bay 24% nan elèv li yo — men sa se pwòp èd finansye lekòl la resevwa, se pa lajan merit inivèsitè, epi ou pa dwe konfonn de yo.

strings.text: the headline list is explicitly “College Acceptances” across three graduating classes (2022, 2023, 2024) — roughly 330 students, each generating multiple acceptances. An institution appearing there does not mean a Cannon student attended, or that an acceptance happened in any particular year. Prefer the Class of 2023 matriculation list, which is real enrollment. Note also that the 2025–26 profile dropped the acceptance list entirely, so the newest available data is already one full cycle stale. This window begins in 2022, a year earlier than the 2023 floor the other schools here share: Cannon publishes only this single pre-aggregated block with no per-class breakdown, so the 2022 acceptances cannot be split off without discarding the list, and the school has published nothing newer to replace it.
strings.t: lis prensipal la se eksplisitman “College Acceptances” atravè twa klas ki gradye (2022, 2023, 2024) — apeprè 330 elèv, chak k ap jenere plizyè aksepte. Yon enstitisyon ki parèt la pa vle di yon elèv Cannon te ale, oswa ke yon aksepte te fèt nan yon ane patikilye. Prefere lis enskripsyon Klas 2023 la, ki se vrè enskripsyon. Note tou ke pwofil 2025–26 la retire lis aksepte a nèt, kidonk done ki pi nouvo ki disponib la deja yon sik konplè ansyen. Fenèt sa a kòmanse an 2022, yon ane anvan piba 2023 lòt lekòl yo isit la pataje: Cannon pibliye sèlman yon sèl blòk pre-agrege sa a, san okenn dekonpozisyon pa klas, kidonk aksepte 2022 yo pa ka separe san jete lis la, epi lekòl la pa pibliye anyen ki pi nouvo pou ranplase l.

strings.text: The profile’s bold “enrolled” markers for the Class of 2024 did not survive PDF text extraction, so the enrolling markers here come from the separately published Class of 2023 matriculation list instead. They are real enrollments, but for a different class than the acceptance list’s bold key describes.
strings.t: Mak “enskri” an gra pwofil la pou Klas 2024 la pa t siviv ekstraksyon tèks PDF, kidonk mak enskripsyon isit yo soti nan lis enskripsyon Klas 2023 ki pibliye apa a. Yo se vrè enskripsyon, men pou yon klas diferan pase sa kle gra lis aksepte a dekri.

strings.text: Cannon’s differentiator is a set of course-embedded research experiences that end in a public defence — including one judged by an external committee of science professionals and business leaders.
strings.t: Sa ki fè Cannon diferan se yon seri eksperyans rechèch ki entegre nan kou yo ki fini nan yon defans piblik — ki enkli youn yon komite ekstèn pwofesyonèl syantifik ak lidè biznis jije.

strings.text: The spike here is built inside the curriculum rather than bolted on: take the course, and the defensible artefact is a requirement rather than an option.
strings.t: Espesyalite a bati anndan kourikoulòm nan olye ke kole sou li: pran kou a, epi rezilta ou ka defann nan se yon kondisyon olye ke yon opsyon.

strings.text: **BIOREX** — the Biological Research Experience, embedded in Honors Biology. Students form a hypothesis, test it, analyse it statistically and present to a committee of **faculty, science professionals and local business leaders**. External judging is what separates this from a class project.
strings.t: **BIOREX** — Biological Research Experience la, entegre nan Honors Biology. Elèv yo fòme yon ipotèz, teste l, analize l estatistikman epi prezante l bay yon komite **pwofesè, pwofesyonèl syantifik ak lidè biznis lokal**. Jijman ekstèn se sa ki separe sa a de yon pwojè klas.

strings.text: **Symposium and Portfolio Defense** — an original historical argument defended in the spring of junior year (AT: U.S. History), and a multi-draft digital portfolio presented in AT: American Language and Composition.
strings.t: **Symposium ak Portfolio Defense** — yon agiman istorik orijinal ou defann nan prentan twazyèm ane a (AT: U.S. History), ak yon pòtfèy dijital ak plizyè bouyon ou prezante nan AT: American Language and Composition.

strings.text: **Independent Study** — petition-based, and unusually the student **co-develops the course content and the assessment rubric**, then produces an end-of-year artefact.
strings.t: **Independent Study** — baze sou demann, epi yon fason ki pa abityèl elèv la **ko-devlope kontni kou a ak rubrik evalyasyon an**, apre sa li pwodui yon rezilta nan fen ane a.

strings.text: **Senior Capstone** — a philanthropic service project with a culminating public presentation to faculty, staff, peers and community. It is the one near-universal senior experience, though service itself is explicitly not a graduation requirement.
strings.t: **Senior Capstone** — yon pwojè sèvis filantwopik ak yon prezantasyon piblik final bay pwofesè, anplwaye, kanmarad ak kominote a. Se sèl eksperyans dènye ane ki prèske inivèsèl, byenke sèvis li menm eksplisitman se pa yon kondisyon pou gradye.

strings.text: **Global Education Certificate** — fully specified: World History I–II plus three levels of a world language, a senior **Glocal Perspectives** course with a capstone essay and presentation, and at least two of three global experiences. Awarded at Senior Night.
strings.t: **Global Education Certificate** — konplètman espesifye: World History I–II plis twa nivo yon lang etranje, yon kou **Glocal Perspectives** nan dènye ane ak yon redaksyon kapston ak prezantasyon, ak omwen de nan twa eksperyans mondyal. Yo bay li nan Senior Night.

strings.text: Entrepreneurship and Engineering exist as course tracks with real depth — Honors Design Thinking & Entrepreneurship Lab, Creative Design and Engineering I–III, The Mill makerspace — but there is no published distinction or credential for either, so they should be read as tracks rather than certificates. No required internship or externship programme is published.
strings.t: Antreprenarya ak Enjenyri egziste kòm pis kou ak vrè pwofondè — Honors Design Thinking & Entrepreneurship Lab, Creative Design and Engineering I–III, makerspace The Mill — men pa gen okenn distenksyon oswa kalifikasyon ki pibliye pou ni youn ni lòt, kidonk yo ta dwe li kòm pis olye ke sètifika. Pa gen okenn pwogram estaj oswa externship obligatwa ki pibliye.

strings.text: **The profile publishes its own ceiling** — the maximum AP/AT load by grade, with a footnote that maths placement governs whether a student can reach it. Disclosing the cap protects students from being read against an unlimited-load norm they were never allowed to attempt.
strings.t: **Pwofil la pibliye pwòp plafon pa l** — chay maksimòm AP/AT pa nivo, ak yon nòt ki di plasman matematik gouvène si yon elèv ka rive nan li. Divilge limit la pwoteje elèv kont yo li yo kont yon nòm chay san limit yo pa t janm gen dwa eseye.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — the office “reports out-of-school suspensions and expulsions through time of graduation to any colleges and universities that request this information”: a disclose-on-request posture consistent with current NACAC norms.
strings.t: **Siyal sou entegrite** — biwo a “rapòte sispansyon deyò lekòl ak ekspilsyon jiska moman gradyasyon bay nenpòt inivèsite ak kolèj ki mande enfòmasyon sa a”: yon pozisyon divilge-sou-demann ki konsistan ak nòm NACAC aktyèl yo.

strings.text: **Institutional memberships** — NACAC, SACAC and **ACCIS**, alongside a **Cum Laude Society** chapter awarded in 2005 and membership of the **Independent Curriculum Group**, which is what makes the school-designed AT tier and the optional-exam stance coherent rather than idiosyncratic.
strings.t: **Manbraj enstitisyonèl** — NACAC, SACAC ak **ACCIS**, ansanm ak yon chapit **Cum Laude Society** yo te akòde an 2005 ak manbraj **Independent Curriculum Group** la, ki se sa ki fè nivo AT lekòl la konsevwa a ak pozisyon egzamen opsyonèl la koyeran olye ke etranj.

strings.text: **Hosting regional admissions traffic** — Cannon is the venue for the Lake Norman case-studies programme and fair, pulling visiting admissions officers onto its own campus at regional scale rather than only sending students out.
strings.t: **Resevwa trafik admisyon rejyonal** — Cannon se kote Lake Norman case-studies pwogram nan ak fwa a fèt, sa ki rale ofisye admisyon k ap vizite sou pwòp kanpis li nan yon echèl rejyonal olye ke sèlman voye elèv deyò.

strings.text: Cannon publishes a top-10% band and a middle-50% band for both tests and both GPAs — a genuinely useful shape, reported in a format that is not percentiles.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye yon bann top-10% ak yon bann mitan-50% pou tou de tès ak tou de GPA — yon fòm ki vrèman itil, rapòte nan yon fòma ki pa pousantaj.

strings.text: The most informative figure is the unweighted middle 50% of 3.57–3.94: the median Cannon student sits in the high-B-plus to A-minus range before any weighting.
strings.t: Chif ki pi enfòmatif la se mitan 50% san pwa a ki se 3.57–3.94: elèv medyàn Cannon chita nan ranje B-plis wo rive A-mwens anvan okenn pwa.

strings.text: — Class of 2025 · number of testers not published
strings.t: — Klas 2025 · kantite moun ki pase tès pa pibliye

strings.text: Cannon publishes a middle-50% band and a top-10% band only. The middle-50% endpoints conventionally ARE the 25th and 75th percentiles, so those columns are real; the top-10% figure is shown in the 90th column as the floor of that band (1470–1590). No mean, median, section subscores, or tester counts are published for either test.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye yon bann mitan-50% ak yon bann top-10% sèlman. Bout mitan-50% yo konvansyonèlman SE 25yèm ak 75yèm pousantaj yo, kidonk kolòn sa yo reyèl; chif top-10% la montre nan kolòn 90yèm nan kòm planche bann sa a (1470–1590). Pa gen mwayèn, medyàn, sou-nòt seksyon, oswa kantite moun ki pase tès ki pibliye pou ni youn ni lòt tès.

strings.text: Same reporting format: the 90th column shows the floor of the published top-10% band (33–36). Without a tester count there is no way to tell what share of 111 seniors sat either exam, which materially limits how far these bands can be read.
strings.t: Menm fòma rapò: kolòn 90yèm nan montre planche bann top-10% ki pibliye a (33–36). San yon kantite moun ki pase tès pa gen okenn fason pou di ki pòsyon nan 111 elèv dènye ane yo ki te pase nenpòt nan de egzamen yo, sa ki limite materyèlman jiskaki kote ou ka li bann sa yo.

strings.text: These are bands, not a quintile table — no full quintile or decile breakdown, median GPA, or per-band student count is published. The modest weighted ceiling follows directly from the 1.0-quality-point cap and the eleven-course AP/AT maximum, which is a transparency point in Cannon’s favour but needs context for readers used to heavier weighting schemes.
strings.t: Sa yo se bann, se pa yon tab senkyèm — pa gen dekoupaj senkyèm oswa dizyèm konplè, GPA medyàn, oswa kantite elèv pa bann ki pibliye. Plafon ak pwa modès la soti dirèkteman nan limit 1.0 pwen kalite a ak maksimòm onz kou AP/AT la, sa ki se yon pwen transparans an favè Cannon men ki bezwen kontèks pou moun ki abitye ak sistèm pwa pi lou.

strings.text: Three named Upper School specialists
strings.t: Twa espesyalis Upper School ki gen non

strings.text: **Michelle Donah**, **Tere Hurtado** and **Jennifer Ridenhour** — substantial staffing for 423 Upper School students, and among the best-documented learning support in this set.
strings.t: **Michelle Donah**, **Tere Hurtado** ak **Jennifer Ridenhour** — gwo estaf pou 423 elèv Upper School, epi pami sipò aprantisaj ki pi byen dokimante nan gwoup sa a.

strings.text: The student owns the plan
strings.t: Elèv la responsab plan an

strings.text: Students **actively participate in creating their own personalized learning plans** with specific accommodations, supported by a formally constituted team: the student, parents, teachers, the Assistant Head for Academics, the Student Dean, the Upper School Counselor and the advisor.
strings.t: Elèv yo **patisipe aktivman nan kreye pwòp plan aprantisaj pèsonalize pa yo** ak akomodasyon espesifik, sipòte pa yon ekip ki fòme fòmèlman: elèv la, paran yo, pwofesè yo, Assistant Head for Academics la, Student Dean an, Upper School Counselor la ak konseye a.

strings.text: For **juniors and seniors** the programme provides guidance on **requesting College Board and ACT testing accommodations** — the specific service that converts learning support into college-application support.
strings.t: Pou **elèv twazyèm ak dènye ane** pwogram nan bay konsèy sou **mande akomodasyon tès College Board ak ACT** — sèvis espesifik la ki konvèti sipò aprantisaj an sipò pou aplikasyon inivèsitè.

strings.text: The surrounding structure
strings.t: Estrikti ki toutbò a

strings.text: The **Academic Resource Center** for maths, writing, science and world languages; 1:1 **academic coaching** on executive function; and a faculty-facilitated, peer-led **Academic Lab**.
strings.t: **Academic Resource Center** la pou matematik, ekri, syans ak lang etranje; **antrènman akademik** 1:1 sou fonksyon egzekitif; ak yon **Academic Lab** kanmarad yo dirije ak pwofesè k ap fasilite.

strings.text: Not published: how many students are on formal learning plans, whether accommodations carry a fee, and specialist credentials.
strings.t: Pa pibliye: konbyen elèv ki gen plan aprantisaj fòmèl, si akomodasyon yo gen yon frè, ak kalifikasyon espesyalis yo.

strings.text: The list is printed honestly
strings.t: Lis la enprime onètman

strings.text: The acceptance list runs from MIT, Stanford and Bowdoin down through Rowan-Cabarrus, Cape Fear and Central Piedmont community colleges, Brevard, Barton, Catawba, Mars Hill, Wingate, Limestone, Methodist, Gardner-Webb, Guilford, Lenoir-Rhyne and Coker. A school optimising for prestige would omit these; Cannon prints them, and discloses its 2% two-year figure rather than burying it.
strings.t: Lis aksepte a kouri soti MIT, Stanford ak Bowdoin desann atravè inivèsite kominotè Rowan-Cabarrus, Cape Fear ak Central Piedmont, Brevard, Barton, Catawba, Mars Hill, Wingate, Limestone, Methodist, Gardner-Webb, Guilford, Lenoir-Rhyne ak Coker. Yon lekòl k ap optimize pou prestij ta kite sa yo deyò; Cannon enprime yo, epi li divilge chif 2% de ane li a olye ke antere l.

strings.text: A design-weighted arts pathway
strings.t: Yon wout atistik ki panche vè konsepsyon

strings.text: Pratt, Parsons, SAIC, SCAD, Ringling, FIT, FIDM, UNCSA and Emerson — deep and visual/design-weighted rather than music-conservatory-weighted, despite strong ensemble offerings.
strings.t: Pratt, Parsons, SAIC, SCAD, Ringling, FIT, FIDM, UNCSA ak Emerson — pwofon epi ki panche vè vizyèl/konsepsyon olye ke vè konsèvatwa mizik, malgre bon ofrann ansanm.

strings.text: Other non-traditional destinations
strings.t: Lòt destinasyon ki pa tradisyonèl

strings.text: International universities (St Andrews, Edinburgh, Aberdeen — a confirmed 2023 enrollment, University College Dublin, McGill, Toronto); service academies and the military (Air Force Academy, The Citadel, VMI); technical institutes (Rose-Hulman, WPI, Stevens, Colorado School of Mines, RPI); HBCUs (Howard, Spelman, NC A&T, NC Central, Winston-Salem State).
strings.t: Inivèsite entènasyonal (St Andrews, Edinburgh, Aberdeen — yon enskripsyon 2023 konfime, University College Dublin, McGill, Toronto); akademi sèvis ak lame a (Air Force Academy, The Citadel, VMI); enstiti teknik (Rose-Hulman, WPI, Stevens, Colorado School of Mines, RPI); HBCU (Howard, Spelman, NC A&T, NC Central, Winston-Salem State).

strings.text: The 2024–25 profile published NO test scores at all, stating that because of test-optional review “test scores for the Class of 2025 are not reported”. The 2025–26 profile then published a full Class of 2025 testing distribution. Same class, opposite decisions, one year apart, unexplained — the later figures are shown here.
strings.t: Pwofil 2024–25 la pa t pibliye OKENN nòt tès ditou, li te deklare akoz revizyon ak tès opsyonèl “nou pa rapòte nòt tès pou Klas 2025 la”. Apre sa pwofil 2025–26 la te pibliye yon distribisyon tès Klas 2025 konplè. Menm klas la, desizyon opoze, yon ane apa, san eksplikasyon — nou montre chif ki pi resan yo isit la.

strings.text: All four GPA bands are identical to the hundredth across the Class of 2024 and Class of 2025 tables. An exact four-band match across two different cohorts is statistically unlikely, so this may be carried-forward data rather than a genuinely stable distribution.
strings.t: Tout kat bann GPA yo idantik jiska santyèm nan atravè tab Klas 2024 ak Klas 2025 yo. Yon matche egzak nan kat bann atravè de gwoup diferan pa gen anpil chans sou plan estatistik, kidonk sa ka done yo pote annavan olye ke yon distribisyon ki vrèman estab.

strings.text: No gap-year statistic, policy or counselling service is described anywhere — and since 98% four-year plus 2% two-year accounts for the whole class, the published outcomes leave no room for a gap-year cohort at all.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn estatistik, politik oswa konsèy sou ane apre diplòm ki dekri okenn kote — epi paske 98% kat ane plis 2% de ane konte tout klas la, rezilta ki pibliye yo pa kite okenn plas pou yon gwoup ki pran yon ane apre diplòm.

strings.text: A stable, structurally honest programme — four-year counselor continuity, a published load ceiling, real research defences, and a genuine matriculation list — wrapped in thinner outcome disclosure than its larger peers.
strings.t: Yon pwogram estab epi estriktirèlman onèt — kontinwite konseye kat ane, yon plafon chay ki pibliye, vrè defans rechèch, ak yon vrè lis enskripsyon — vlope nan divilgasyon rezilta ki pi mens pase pi gwo lekòl parèy li yo.

strings.text: Most of what is missing here is publication rather than practice, which makes almost every gap a question a tour can answer.
strings.t: Pifò nan sa ki manke isit la se piblikasyon olye ke pratik, sa ki fè prèske chak mank yon kesyon yon vizit ka reponn.

strings.text: Four-year counselor continuity, stated in writing
strings.t: Kontinwite konseye kat ane, deklare alekri

strings.text: students keep the same college counselor for their whole Upper School career rather than being handed off in junior year — and the five-person roster shows zero turnover across two published profiles.
strings.t: elèv yo kenbe menm konseye inivèsite a pandan tout karyè Upper School yo olye ke yo pase yo bay yon lòt nan twazyèm ane — epi lis senk moun nan montre zewo woulman atravè de pwofil ki pibliye.

strings.text: The rigour ceiling is disclosed, not implied
strings.t: Plafon rigè a divilge, se pa sijere

strings.text: a published maximum of 0/1/4/6 AP or AT courses by grade caps a transcript at eleven, so colleges read “most rigorous” against a limit the school itself states.

strings.text: It publishes an actual matriculation list

strings.text: 58 institutions where a Class of 2023 graduate genuinely enrolled — Stanford, Duke, Penn, UCLA, USC, Vanderbilt, Middlebury, Vassar, Georgia Tech, UNC, UVA, William & Mary and the Air Force Academy. That is stronger evidence than any acceptance rollup.
strings.t: 58 enstitisyon kote yon gradye Klas 2023 te vrèman enskri — Stanford, Duke, Penn, UCLA, USC, Vanderbilt, Middlebury, Vassar, Georgia Tech, UNC, UVA, William & Mary ak Air Force Academy. Sa se yon prèv pi solid pase nenpòt rezime aksepte.

strings.text: Learning support is named and reaches the application

strings.text: three named Upper School learning specialists, student-authored personalised learning plans, and explicit guidance for juniors and seniors on requesting College Board and ACT accommodations.

strings.text: Grades are not inflated

strings.text: Honors courses carry no weight at all and only AT/AP add a point, so the weighted top decile tops out near 4.28 rather than in the high 4s.

strings.text: The 2025–26 profile dropped the acceptance list entirely, so the newest is a 2022–24 rollup. Where did the Classes of 2025 and 2026 actually enroll?
strings.t: Pwofil 2025–26 la retire lis aksepte a nèt, kidonk sa ki pi nouvo se yon rezime 2022–24. Kote Klas 2025 ak 2026 yo te vrèman enskri?

strings.text: Your 28:1 ratio only works counting seniors — what is the actual caseload per counselor across all four Upper School grades?

strings.text: Has Cannon had any National Merit Semifinalists, Finalists or Commended Students in recent years? Nothing is published in any year.

strings.text: AP exams are optional here. What share of students in AP and AT courses actually sit the exam, and what share scored 4 or 5 rather than just 3+?
strings.t: Egzamen AP yo opsyonèl isit la. Ki pòsyon elèv nan kou AP ak AT ki vrèman pase egzamen an, epi ki pòsyon ki te fè 4 oswa 5 olye ke sèlman 3+?

strings.text: What were the total merit-scholarship offers for the last graduating class? No dollar figure is published anywhere.
strings.t: Ki total òf bous merit pou dènye klas ki gradye a? Pa gen okenn chif dola ki pibliye okenn kote.

strings.text: Your 2024–25 profile declined to report Class of 2025 test scores on test-optional principle, then the 2025–26 profile published them for that same class. What changed?
strings.t: Pwofil 2024–25 ou a te refize rapòte nòt tès Klas 2025 sou prensip tès opsyonèl, apre sa pwofil 2025–26 la te pibliye yo pou menm klas sa a. Kisa ki chanje?

strings.text: The GPA bands are identical to the hundredth across two different classes — is that a genuinely stable distribution, or carried-forward data?
strings.t: Bann GPA yo idantik jiska santyèm nan atravè de klas diferan — èske se yon distribisyon ki vrèman estab, oswa done yo pote annavan?

strings.text: What does the student-facing counseling curriculum look like grade by grade — how many one-on-one meetings, and when do essays start?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Covenant Day School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 60.3% over the last five entering classes — 301 acceptances from 499 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Covenant Day School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 60.3% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 301 admisyon sou 499 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 27.3% in Fall 2025 — 9 of 33 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.

strings.text: The profile is the office’s application artifact: weighting key, rank policy, AP gating and the acceptance list in a two-page PDF, refreshed annually — three editions verified.
strings.t: Pwofil la se atifak aplikasyon biwo a: kle pwa, politik ran, baryè AP ak lis aksepte a nan yon PDF de paj, mete ajou chak ane — twa edisyon verifye.

strings.text: The 85:1 ratio is derived (85 seniors ÷ 1 dedicated director). The second guidance counselor carries non-college load, so the effective college caseload may be lighter than the headline — but the school never states one.
strings.t: Rapò 85:1 la derive (85 elèv finisan ÷ 1 direktè dedye). Dezyèm konseye oryantasyon an pote chay ki pa pou inivèsite, kidonk chay inivèsite efektif la ka pi lejè pase tit la — men lekòl la pa janm deklare youn.

strings.text: The bold-marks-matriculation convention is itself unusual disclosure: because both published lists carry it and overlap on the classes of 2023–24, acceptances and enrollments can be cross-validated across editions.
strings.t: Konvansyon gra-make-enskripsyon an se pou tèt li yon divilgasyon ki pa abityèl: paske tou de lis ki pibliye yo pote li epi yo chevoche sou klas 2023–24 yo, aksepte ak enskripsyon ka valide kwaze atravè edisyon yo.

strings.text: A multi-year cumulative list shows breadth, not rates: each name means at least one acceptance across four graduating classes of ~85, and bold means at least one enrollment.
strings.t: Yon lis kimilatif plizyè ane montre lajè, se pa to: chak non vle di omwen yon aksepte atravè kat klas ki gradye ~85, epi gra vle di omwen yon enskripsyon.

strings.text: The bolded matriculation names were recovered from the PDF’s font data (plain text extraction drops bold) — spot-checked but machine-extracted. The acceptance list itself extracted cleanly.
strings.t: Non enskripsyon an gra yo te rekipere nan done fon PDF la (ekstraksyon tèks senp la pèdi gra) — verifye pa echantiyon men ekstrè pa machin. Lis aksepte a li menm te ekstrè pwòp.

strings.text: The differentiators are depth stories: a department no other school has, a housing build on Pine Ridge, and college credit from the PCA’s own college.
strings.t: Diferansyatè yo se istwa pwofondè: yon depatman okenn lòt lekòl pa genyen, yon konstriksyon lojman sou Pine Ridge, ak kredi inivèsite ki soti nan pwòp inivèsite PCA a.

strings.text: No research-program or Olympiad credentials — the edge here is distinctiveness and legibility, not national competition results.

strings.text: No GPA distribution exists in any of the three profile editions — no highest/median/lowest, no quintiles. The weighting key (4.33 / +0.5 / +1.0) is the entire GPA disclosure.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn distribisyon GPA ki egziste nan okenn nan twa edisyon pwofil yo — pa gen pi wo/medyàn/pi ba, pa gen senkyèm. Kle pwa a (4.33 / +0.5 / +1.0) se tout divilgasyon GPA a.

strings.text: Learning specialists
strings.t: Espesyalis aprantisaj

strings.text: Five Learning Specialists and an Academic Resources Director on the high school staff table — a real support bench for a 350-student high school.
strings.t: Senk Learning Specialists ak yon Academic Resources Director sou tab estaf lekòl segondè a — yon vrè ban sipò pou yon lekòl segondè 350-elèv.

strings.text: Clinical counseling
strings.t: Konsèy klinik

strings.text: A Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (Emily Lee) on staff, distinct from the college office.
strings.t: Yon Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (Emily Lee) nan estaf la, apa de biwo inivèsite a.

strings.text: Priced help
strings.t: Èd ki gen pri

strings.text: The tuition terms disclose that tutoring and special testing beyond classroom help are available at extra cost — a stated, priced channel rather than an unspoken one.
strings.t: Kondisyon frè eskolè yo divilge ke titora ak egzamen espesyal pi lwen pase èd nan klas disponib ak frè anplis — yon chanèl ki deklare, ki gen pri olye ke youn ki pa pale.

strings.text: AP gating (none for freshmen, one for sophomores) is itself a whole-class guardrail: rigor is sequenced by readiness rather than open-enrollment.
strings.t: Baryè AP (okenn pou premye ane, youn pou dezyèm ane) se pou tèt li yon garanti tout-klas: rigè sekanse pa preparasyon olye ke enskripsyon louvri.

strings.text: The list shows the range
strings.t: Lis la montre plaj la

strings.text: The bolded matriculations run from Dartmouth and Duke through Covenant College, Cedarville, Montreat, community colleges and trade-adjacent programs — a school placing only its top quartile would not produce that spread.
strings.t: Enskripsyon an gra yo soti nan Dartmouth ak Duke jiska Covenant College, Cedarville, Montreat, kolèj kominotè ak pwogram ki pre metye — yon lekòl ki plase sèlman katriyèm anlè li a pa ta pwodwi ekar sa a.

strings.text: The NC-public backbone
strings.t: Kolòn vètebral piblik-NC la

strings.text: The deepest enrolled concentrations are Chapel Hill, NC State, UNC Charlotte, App State and East Carolina — the destinations that serve the broad middle of a North Carolina class.
strings.t: Konsantrasyon enskri ki pi pwofon yo se Chapel Hill, NC State, UNC Charlotte, App State ak East Carolina — destinasyon ki sèvi laj mitan yon klas North Carolina.

strings.text: No distributions are published anywhere: no GPA quantiles, no score percentiles, no per-class matriculation rates. This card ships with the aggregates above because they are genuinely informative — but the shape of the class is not recoverable from public sources, and that follows from the school’s own no-rank policy.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn distribisyon ki pibliye okenn kote: pa gen kantil GPA, pa gen pousantil nòt, pa gen to enskripsyon pa klas. Kat sa a livre ak total ki anwo yo paske yo vrèman enfòmatif — men fòm klas la pa ka rekipere nan sous piblik, epi sa swiv politik san-ran lekòl la li menm.

strings.text: A rigorous, legible academic product with an unusually heavy counselor caseload — and disclosure that is excellent about outcomes, silent about process.
strings.t: Yon pwodwi akademik rigoure, lizib ak yon chay konseye ki lou yon fason ki pa abityèl — epi divilgasyon ki ekselan sou rezilta, an silans sou pwosesis.

strings.text: The profile tells colleges nearly everything; the website tells parents much less about how the counseling actually works.
strings.t: Pwofil la di inivèsite yo prèske tout bagay; sit entènèt la di paran yo mwens sou kijan konsèy la reyèlman fonksyone.

strings.text: The AP story is genuinely strong
strings.t: Istwa AP a vrèman solid

strings.text: 96% of exams at 3+, 78% at 4–5, with a required-exam policy that makes the number honest, and a five-year rising line to back it.
strings.t: 96% nan egzamen a 3+, 78% a 4–5, ak yon politik egzamen obligatwa ki fè chif la onèt, ak yon liy k ap monte senk ane pou soutni li.

strings.text: The heaviest caseload in this comparison
strings.t: Chay ki pi lou nan konparezon sa a

strings.text: One dedicated college counselor for 85 seniors — cushioned by a 23-year director with NACCAP standing, but a ratio a parent should ask about directly.
strings.t: Yon sèl konseye inivèsite dedye pou 85 elèv finisan — soutni pa yon direktè 23-ane ak estati NACCAP, men yon rapò yon paran ta dwe mande sou li dirèkteman.

strings.text: Matriculation is actually visible
strings.t: Enskripsyon reyèlman vizib

strings.text: Bold marks on two overlapping multi-year lists let you verify where students enrolled, not just where they were accepted — disclosure peers rarely offer.
strings.t: Mak an gra sou de lis plizyè ane ki chevoche kite w verifye kote elèv yo enskri, se pa sèlman kote yo te aksepte yo — divilgasyon kanmarad yo raman ofri.

strings.text: The ceiling is real but episodic
strings.t: Plafon an reyèl men epizodik

strings.text: Dartmouth, Penn and Duke enrollments in the current window; Stanford/MIT/Princeton belong to earlier windows. The dependable strength is NC publics and the Christian-college network.
strings.t: Enskripsyon Dartmouth, Penn ak Duke nan fenèt aktyèl la; Stanford/MIT/Princeton apatni a fenèt pi bonè. Fòs ou ka konte sou li a se lekòl piblik NC ak rezo inivèsite kretyen an.

strings.text: Process disclosure is thin
strings.t: Divilgasyon pwosesis mèg

strings.text: No counseling timeline, no platform named, no essay or application programming published — the model rides on the director’s relationships.
strings.t: Pa gen kalandriye konsèy, pa gen platfòm ki nonmen, pa gen esè oswa pwogram aplikasyon ki pibliye — modèl la woule sou relasyon direktè a.

strings.text: How does one director manage 85 seniors at peak season — what does the junior spring / senior fall calendar actually look like?
strings.t: Kijan yon sèl direktè jere 85 elèv finisan nan sezon pik la — ki jan kalandriye prentan twazyèm ane / otòn finisan an reyèlman ye?

strings.text: Which platform do families use — Naviance, Scoir, something else — and when do students get access?
strings.t: Ki platfòm fanmi yo itilize — Naviance, Scoir, yon lòt bagay — epi ki lè elèv yo jwenn aksè?

strings.text: Which AP courses will actually run next year? The matrix moved from 18 to 15 between editions.
strings.t: Ki kou AP ki pral reyèlman fonksyone ane pwochèn? Matris la te deplase soti 18 rive 15 ant edisyon yo.

strings.text: What did last year’s class look like beyond the averages — how many tested, and where did the middle of the class land?
strings.t: Ki jan klas ane pase a te ye pi lwen pase mwayèn yo — konbyen ki te fè tès, epi kote mitan klas la te tonbe?

strings.text: How does the NC Opportunity Scholarship prerequisite interact with the aid timeline for a family also applying elsewhere?
strings.t: Kijan prekondisyon NC Opportunity Scholarship la entèraji ak kalandriye èd la pou yon fanmi k ap aplike lòt kote tou?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Davidson Day School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 59.4% over the last five entering classes — 177 acceptances from 298 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Davidson Day School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 59.4% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 177 admisyon sou 298 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 40.0% in Fall 2025 — 10 of 25 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 40.0% nan otòn 2025 — 10 sou 25 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 177 of 298 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 177 sou 298 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 10 of 25, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 10 sou 25, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: drew the most applications in Fall 2025 (25)
strings.t: te resevwa plis aplikasyon nan otòn 2025 (25)

strings.text: Davidson Day publishes its grading machinery in full — the scale, the weighting, and an unusually explicit list of what is excluded from the GPA — but no AP exam results and no National Merit record at all.
strings.t: Davidson Day pibliye mekanis nòt li a nèt — echèl la, pwa a, ak yon lis ki eksplisit yon fason ki pa abityèl sou sa ki eskli nan GPA a — men pa gen okenn rezilta egzamen AP ak pa gen okenn dosye National Merit ditou.

strings.text: The School Profile does the work test scores would otherwise do: full quality-point table, +0.5 Honors / +1.0 AP, a stated no-rank policy, and a three-point GPA distribution that discloses a 2.49 floor.
strings.t: School Profile la fè travay nòt tès yo ta fè otreman: tab pwen kalite konplè, +0.5 Honors / +1.0 AP, yon politik san ran ki deklare, ak yon distribisyon GPA twa pwen ki divilge yon planche 2.49.

strings.t: Kou AP yo ofri an 2025–26 (kantite derive — lekòl la pa pibliye okenn total)

strings.t: egzamen AP yo pase, % ki fè 3+, ak politik egzamen

strings.t: “Davidson Day pa bay elèv li yo ran”

strings.text: Calculus III (Post AP) — the only named post-AP course, and explicitly weighted +1.0 like an AP.
strings.t: Calculus III (Pòs AP) — sèl kou pòs-AP ki gen non, epi eksplisitman ak pwa +1.0 tankou yon AP.

strings.text: Tops out at AP Computer Science A; there is no post-AP CS course. A new Intro to AI is listed but flagged as not offered in 2025–26.
strings.t: Li rive nan tèt nan AP Computer Science A; pa gen okenn kou CS pòs-AP. Yon nouvo Intro to AI liste men yo make l kòm pa ofri an 2025–26.

strings.text: AP Spanish Language and AP French Language run; AP Spanish Literature is listed but not offered this year. Honors sequences reach Spanish V and French V.
strings.t: AP Spanish Language ak AP French Language kouri; AP Spanish Literature liste men yo pa ofri l ane sa a. Sekans Honors rive nan Spanish V ak French V.

strings.text: Independent Studies and any course taken online are excluded from the GPA. No dual-enrollment partnership is published — notable given Davidson College sits one mile away. The real off-campus depth is AFAR international field research.
strings.t: Etid Endepandan ak nenpòt kou yo pran anliy eskli nan GPA a. Pa gen okenn patenarya enskripsyon doub ki pibliye — sa ki remakab paske Davidson College chita yon mil lwen. Vrè pwofondè deyò kanpis la se rechèch teren entènasyonal AFAR.

strings.text: Weighted, with a published table
strings.t: Ak pwa, ak yon tab ki pibliye

strings.text: A 93–100, A− 3.67, down to D− 0.67, all printed. Honors carry +0.5, AP +1.0, and Calculus III +1.0 — the post-AP course is explicitly given AP weight.
strings.t: A 93–100, A− 3.67, desann rive D− 0.67, tout enprime. Honors pote +0.5, AP +1.0, epi Calculus III +1.0 — yo bay kou pòs-AP la pwa AP eksplisitman.

strings.text: No rank → three summary points
strings.t: Pa gen ran → twa pwen rezime

strings.text: The Profile gives the Class of 2026 highest (4.60), median (3.96) and lowest (2.49) GPA, transfers excluded. There is no quintile or decile table, so the shape of the distribution stays hidden.
strings.t: Pwofil la bay Klas 2026 la pi wo (4.60), medyàn (3.96) ak pi ba (2.49) GPA, elèv transfè eskli. Pa gen tab senkyèm oswa dizyèm, kidonk fòm distribisyon an rete kache.

strings.text: Unusually explicit exclusions
strings.t: Eksklizyon ki eksplisit yon fason ki pa abityèl

strings.text: Transfer courses, Upper School courses taken in Middle School, Independent Studies and any online course are all excluded; the GPA reflects only work done at Davidson Day.
strings.t: Kou transfè, kou Upper School yo pran nan Middle School, Etid Endepandan ak nenpòt kou anliy tout eskli; GPA a reflete sèlman travay ki fèt nan Davidson Day.

strings.text: The 21-AP figure is a derived count of distinct College Board courses in the Profile’s table, excluding four marked “not offered in 25-26” and excluding Calculus III. The school prints no AP total, and PrivateSchoolReview reports a non-reconciling “23 AP/advanced courses”.
strings.t: Chif 21 AP la se yon kantite derive nan kou College Board diferan nan tab Pwofil la, ki eskli kat ki make “pa ofri an 25-26” epi ki eskli Calculus III. Lekòl la pa enprime okenn total AP, epi PrivateSchoolReview rapòte yon “23 kou AP/avanse” ki pa rekonsilye.

strings.text: No AP exam results of any kind are published — not the number of exams sat, the number of students, the share scoring 3+, nor whether students in an AP course are required to sit the exam. Offerings tell you what a student may take; they say nothing about outcomes.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn rezilta egzamen AP ditou ki pibliye — ni kantite egzamen yo pase, ni kantite elèv, ni pòsyon ki fè 3+, ni si elèv nan yon kou AP oblije pase egzamen an. Ofrann di w sa yon elèv ka pran; yo pa di anyen sou rezilta.

strings.text: No National Merit or College Board recognition record could be located in the school’s materials, its news feed, or National Merit Scholarship Corporation listings. Unpublished is not the same as zero — at a class size of ~47 a nil or low-single-digit count would be unremarkable.
strings.t: Nou pa t kapab jwenn okenn dosye National Merit oswa rekonesans College Board ni nan materyèl lekòl la, ni nan fil nouvèl li, ni nan lis National Merit Scholarship Corporation. Pa pibliye se pa menm bagay ak zewo — nan yon gwosè klas ~47 yon kantite nil oswa yon sèl chif ta nòmal.

strings.text: “Most rigorous course load” is never defined: no stated AP maximum, no published access gate, and no description of how the school answers the Common App’s curriculum-rigor question.
strings.t: Yo pa janm defini “chay kou ki pi rijid la”: pa gen maksimòm AP ki deklare, pa gen pòtay aksè ki pibliye, ak pa gen deskripsyon sou kijan lekòl la reponn kesyon Common App la sou rigè kourikoulòm.

strings.text: Two counselors for 198 Upper Schoolers — roughly 1:99, and about 1:24 across the 47 seniors — with the office’s stated start point in 9th grade rather than junior year.
strings.t: De konseye pou 198 elèv Upper School — apeprè 1:99, epi anviwon 1:24 atravè 47 elèv dènye ane yo — ak pwen kòmansman biwo a ki deklare nan 9yèm ane olye ke twazyèm ane.

strings.text: The small caseload is the credible part. What is missing is any written commitment about what the office actually guarantees: no published review-before-submission promise, no ED/EA stance, no recommendation protocol.
strings.t: Ti chay la se pati ki kredib la. Sa ki manke se nenpòt angajman alekri sou sa biwo a vrèman garanti: pa gen pwomès revizyon anvan soumisyon ki pibliye, pa gen pozisyon ED/EA, pa gen pwotokòl rekòmandasyon.

strings.text: Both ratios are derived (198 ÷ 2 and 47 ÷ 2). The school never states a counselor-to-student ratio, and publishes no caseload assignment method or the point at which a student is assigned a counselor.
strings.t: Tou de rapò yo derive (198 ÷ 2 ak 47 ÷ 2). Lekòl la pa janm deklare yon rapò konseye-a-elèv, epi li pa pibliye okenn metòd asiyasyon chay ak pwen kote yo asiyen yon elèv yon konseye.

strings.text: Rep visits appear as a marketing benchmark of “more than 80” per year, while a documented recent count is ~71 (nearly 80% out-of-state). Both figures are shown; the lower one could not be re-verified live.
strings.t: Vizit reprezantan parèt kòm yon referans maketing “plis pase 80” pa ane, pandan yon kantite resan ki dokimante se ~71 (prèske 80% deyò eta a). Nou montre tou de chif yo; nou pa t kapab re-verifye pi ba a an dirèk.

strings.text: No grade-by-grade curriculum map is published. The live page carries no 9/10/11/12 breakdown — only “begins in 9th grade” plus the fall/spring event list, whose names map to grades only loosely.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kat kourikoulòm nivo pa nivo ki pibliye. Paj ki an dirèk la pa pote okenn dekoupaj 9/10/11/12 — sèlman “kòmanse nan 9yèm ane” plis lis evènman otòn/prentan an, ki gen non ki makonnen ak nivo yo yon fason ki lach.

strings.text: The office publishes no commitment that every application is read before submission, no Early Decision / Early Action doctrine, and no counselor campus-visit count. A two-person office can plausibly review everything — but it never says so in writing.
strings.t: Biwo a pa pibliye okenn angajman ke yo li chak aplikasyon anvan soumisyon, okenn doktrin Early Decision / Early Action, ak okenn kantite vizit kanpis konseye. Yon biwo de moun ka plausibleman revize tout bagay — men li pa janm di sa alekri.
