strings.text: The $7.4M is the school’s own wording — “offered”, not accepted, so it includes awards from colleges no student attended. The number of students receiving merit, the median award, and the accepted total are all unpublished, as are Morehead-Cain, Robertson, QuestBridge and ROTC outcomes.
strings.t: $7.4M la se pwòp mo lekòl la — “ofri”, se pa aksepte, kidonk li enkli prim nan men inivèsite kote okenn elèv pa t ale. Kantite elèv ki resevwa merit, prim medyàn nan, ak total yo aksepte a tout pa pibliye, menm jan ak rezilta Morehead-Cain, Robertson, QuestBridge ak ROTC.

strings.text: this is a five-year cumulative acceptance list, not a matriculation list. A college earns a place by admitting one student at any point across five classes, so the list measures breadth, not placement. Nothing on it is bolded or otherwise marked to show enrollment — the school reports that the Class of 2025 “selected 35 different colleges” but never names them. This window begins in 2021, two years before the 2023 floor the other schools here share: the 2025–26 profile still prints this single 2021–2025 block with no per-class breakdown, so the pre-2023 classes cannot be split off without discarding the list, and no narrower or newer named list is published.
strings.t: sa a se yon lis aksepte kimilatif senk ane, se pa yon lis enskripsyon. Yon inivèsite jwenn yon plas lè li admèt yon elèv nan nenpòt moman atravè senk klas, kidonk lis la mezire etandi, se pa plasman. Pa gen anyen sou li ki an gra oswa make yon lòt fason pou montre enskripsyon — lekòl la rapòte Klas 2025 la “te chwazi 35 inivèsite diferan” men li pa janm nonmen yo. Fenèt sa a kòmanse an 2021, dezan anvan piba 2023 lòt lekòl yo isit la pataje: pwofil 2025–26 la toujou enprime sèl blòk 2021–2025 sa a, san okenn dekonpozisyon pa klas, kidonk klas anvan 2023 yo pa ka separe san jete lis la, epi pa gen okenn lis ak non ki pi etwat oswa pi nouvo ki pibliye.

strings.text: Which colleges students actually enrolled at is not published, and neither is any repeat-pipeline or per-college yield data. You cannot infer a pipeline to any single college from this list.
strings.t: Nan ki inivèsite elèv yo te vrèman enskri pa pibliye, epi pa gen okenn done sou rezo ki repete oswa rannman pa inivèsite non plis. Ou pa ka dedwi yon rezo nan okenn sèl inivèsite apati lis sa a.

strings.text: For a 198-student Upper School, the spike-building machinery is disproportionate: real permitted archaeology abroad, and a Global Studies Diploma that sends a second transcript and profile to colleges.
strings.t: Pou yon Upper School 198 elèv, machin pou bati espesyalite a dispwopòsyone: vrè akeyoloji ak pèmi aletranje, ak yon Global Studies Diploma ki voye yon dezyèm relve nòt ak pwofil bay inivèsite yo.

strings.text: What the school cannot offer is institutional name recognition — so the leverage it does control is the Profile itself, rep-visit volume, and counselor access.
strings.t: Sa lekòl la pa ka ofri se rekonesans non enstitisyonèl — kidonk leviye li kontwole a se Pwofil la li menm, volim vizit reprezantan, ak aksè a konseye.

strings.text: **AFAR international field research** — authentic archaeological excavation in Belize (since 2009), Spain (2014), Greece (2017) and Portugal (2018). The Belize dig runs with the BVAR project under permit from the Belize Institute of Archaeology at Cahal Pech; the program’s history appears in peer-reviewed literature (*Heritage*, 2020). Students publish and present at international conferences.
strings.t: **Rechèch teren entènasyonal AFAR** — vrè fouy akeyolojik nan Belize (depi 2009), Espay (2014), Lagrès (2017) ak Pòtigal (2018). Fouy Belize la fèt ak pwojè BVAR la anba pèmi Belize Institute of Archaeology nan Cahal Pech; istwa pwogram nan parèt nan literati ak revizyon kanmarad (*Heritage*, 2020). Elèv yo pibliye epi prezante nan konferans entènasyonal.

strings.text: **Global Studies Diploma** — Honors Anthropology core, four approved AP courses, a language requirement, a minimum two weeks of international field research, and a capstone paper. Critically, it *produces a separate transcript and profile sent to colleges* — an extra document in the file, not a line on the transcript.
strings.t: **Global Studies Diploma** — nwayo Honors Anthropology, kat kou AP apwouve, yon kondisyon lang, yon minimòm de semèn rechèch teren entènasyonal, ak yon papye kapston. Sa ki enpòtan, li *pwodui yon relve nòt ak pwofil apa yo voye bay inivèsite yo* — yon dokiman anplis nan dosye a, se pa yon liy sou relve nòt la.

strings.text: **STEMM and Business & Civic Engagement Diplomas** — each requires at least 100 hours of approved internship or practicum, quarterly Ethics Labs, an 11th-grade Research Methods Honors course, a 12th-grade Capstone Research Honors mentorship, and a public presentation at the Scholars Research Conference.
strings.t: **STEMM ak Business & Civic Engagement Diplomas** — chak egzije omwen 100 èdtan estaj oswa praktikòm apwouve, Ethics Labs chak trimès, yon kou Research Methods Honors nan 11yèm ane, yon mentora Capstone Research Honors nan 12yèm ane, ak yon prezantasyon piblik nan Scholars Research Conference la.

strings.text: **Recruiting and arts tracks** — an annual Athletic Recruitment Workshop and National Signing Day events (one recent day saw seven NLI signings); AP Studio Art plus portfolio outcomes at SCAD, Pratt, Manhattan School of Music, UNCSA and AMDA.
strings.t: **Pis rekritman ak atizay** — yon Athletic Recruitment Workshop anyèl ak evènman National Signing Day (yon jou resan te wè sèt siyati NLI); AP Studio Art plis rezilta pòtfèy nan SCAD, Pratt, Manhattan School of Music, UNCSA ak AMDA.

strings.text: Required internship/capstone applies only to Diploma Distinction candidates — there is no school-wide required internship or senior project. Participation counts for AFAR ("hundreds", "150+", "200+") are all program-wide across many schools; how many Davidson Day students specifically have taken part is not published.
strings.t: Estaj/kapston obligatwa aplike sèlman pou kandida Diploma Distinction — pa gen okenn estaj oswa pwojè dènye ane obligatwa pou tout lekòl la. Kantite patisipasyon pou AFAR (“dè santèn”, “150+”, “200+”) tout se pou tout pwogram nan atravè anpil lekòl; konbyen elèv Davidson Day espesifikman ki te patisipe pa pibliye.

strings.text: **The School Profile as an instrument** — the strongest lever here, and well executed. Four pages, current, publicly linked: full grading scale and weighting, GPA exclusions, the Class of 2026 GPA range, the complete course catalog with unoffered courses clearly flagged, graduation requirements, the Honor Code, and the five-year acceptance list. For a reader who has never been to Davidson, NC, it frames a student without leaning on test scores or rank — precisely the job it has to do.
strings.t: **School Profile la kòm yon zouti** — leviye ki pi solid isit la, epi byen egzekite. Kat paj, aktyèl, ak lyen piblik: echèl nòt ak pwa konplè, eksklizyon GPA, ranje GPA Klas 2026 la, katalòg kou konplè ak kou yo pa ofri ki byen make, kondisyon gradyasyon, Kòd Onè a, ak lis aksepte senk ane a. Pou yon moun k ap li ki pa t janm ale nan Davidson, NC, li chapante yon elèv san li pa apiye sou nòt tès oswa ran — presizeman travay li gen pou l fè a.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — the Honor Code is published verbatim, and the school holds the standard ethical-practice memberships: NACAC, SACAC and ACCIS, alongside NAIS, SAIS, NCAIS, NCISAA and College Board.
strings.t: **Siyal sou entegrite** — Kòd Onè a pibliye mo pou mo, epi lekòl la genyen manbraj etik estanda yo: NACAC, SACAC ak ACCIS, ansanm ak NAIS, SAIS, NCAIS, NCISAA ak College Board.

strings.text: **Regional co-hosting** — each spring Davidson Day co-hosts the Lake Norman Area College Admissions Case Studies Program and College Fair with Cannon School, putting families inside a mock admissions committee reading real (fictionalised) files.
strings.t: **Ko-resevwa rejyonal** — chak prentan Davidson Day ko-resevwa Lake Norman Area College Admissions Case Studies Program ak College Fair la ak Cannon School, sa ki mete fanmi yo anndan yon komite admisyon similye k ap li vrè dosye (fiktif).

strings.text: **Proximity, not partnership** — Davidson College is one mile away and appears on the acceptance list, but no dual-enrollment, course-access or preferred-admission arrangement is published. The proximity is a fact, not a documented pipeline.
strings.t: **Pwoksimite, se pa patenarya** — Davidson College chita yon mil lwen epi li parèt sou lis aksepte a, men pa gen okenn aranjman enskripsyon doub, aksè a kou oswa admisyon preferansyèl ki pibliye. Pwoksimite a se yon reyalite, se pa yon rezo ki dokimante.

strings.text: The disciplinary-reporting half of integrity signalling is undisclosed: whether suspensions or honor-code violations are reported on the secondary school report, and how a student may explain an incident, is not published.
strings.t: Mwatye divilgasyon disiplinè nan siyal entegrite a pa divilge: si sispansyon oswa vyolasyon kòd onè rapòte sou rapò lekòl segondè a, ak kijan yon elèv ka esplike yon ensidan, pa pibliye.

strings.text: Davidson Day withholds all SAT and ACT data by choice — “due to the popularity of test-optional policies, we will not be providing the testing profiles for the Class of 2026”.
strings.t: Davidson Day kenbe tout done SAT ak ACT pa chwa — “akoz popilarite politik tès opsyonèl yo, nou p ap bay pwofil tès pou Klas 2026 la”.

strings.text: What remains is a three-point GPA disclosure, a genuinely staffed Learning Enrichment Center, and an acceptance list broad enough to show the middle of the class is served.
strings.t: Sa ki rete se yon divilgasyon GPA twa pwen, yon Learning Enrichment Center ki vrèman gen estaf, ak yon lis aksepte ki ase laj pou montre yo sèvi mitan klas la.

strings.text: — the no-rank mechanism · Class of 2026, transfers excluded
strings.t: — mekanis san ran an · Klas 2026, elèv transfè eskli

strings.text: Highest
strings.t: Pi wo

strings.text: on a scale where APs add a full point
strings.t: sou yon echèl kote AP ajoute yon pwen konplè

strings.text: Median
strings.t: Medyàn

strings.text: the midpoint — no mean is published
strings.t: pwen mitan an — pa gen mwayèn ki pibliye

strings.text: Lowest
strings.t: Pi ba

strings.text: the school discloses its floor
strings.t: lekòl la divilge planche li

strings.text: Three summary points is the entire disclosure — there is no quintile or decile table, so an admissions reader learns the range and the midpoint but nothing about the shape: how tightly the class clusters, how many sit above 4.0, or where the 25th percentile falls. Publishing a 2.49 low alongside a 4.60 high is nonetheless a transparency choice many peer schools avoid.
strings.t: Twa pwen rezime se tout divilgasyon an — pa gen tab senkyèm oswa dizyèm, kidonk yon moun k ap li nan admisyon aprann ranje a ak pwen mitan an men anyen sou fòm nan: konbyen klas la rasanble sere, konbyen ki chita pi wo pase 4.0, oswa kote 25yèm pousantaj la tonbe. Pibliye yon ba 2.49 ansanm ak yon wo 4.60 se yon chwa transparans anpil lekòl parèy evite.

strings.text: The Learning Enrichment Center
strings.t: Learning Enrichment Center la

strings.text: A genuinely staffed support structure rather than an accommodations desk: one-on-one tutoring during or outside the school day, academic coaching and executive-function support, social-skills groups, speech-language therapy and occupational therapy.
strings.t: Yon estrikti sipò ki vrèman gen estaf olye ke yon biwo akomodasyon: titora youn a youn pandan oswa deyò jounen lekòl la, antrènman akademik ak sipò pou fonksyon egzekitif, gwoup konpetans sosyal, terapi lapawòl-lang ak terapi okipasyonèl.

strings.text: Continuity
strings.t: Kontinwite

strings.text: Coverage runs from age two through grade twelve, so support does not stop at the Upper School door. Tutors work in partnership with families and classroom teachers to clarify learning weaknesses and strengthen executive functioning.
strings.t: Kouvèti a kouri soti laj dezan rive nan douzyèm ane, kidonk sipò a pa kanpe nan pòt Upper School la. Titè yo travay an patenarya ak fanmi ak pwofesè klas pou klarifye feblès nan aprantisaj epi ranfòse fonksyon egzekitif.

strings.text: How the LEC documents approved accommodations so they carry over to College Board / ACT testing and to college disability services is described nowhere. The support is well documented; its hand-off into the application process is not.
strings.t: Kijan LEC la dokimante akomodasyon apwouve pou yo pote sou tès College Board / ACT ak sèvis andikap nan inivèsite pa dekri okenn kote. Sipò a byen dokimante; pasaj li nan pwosesis aplikasyon an pa dokimante.

strings.text: No LEC staff are named — no roster, titles, credentials or headcount — and whether services carry a fee beyond tuition is not stated.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn estaf LEC ki nonmen — pa gen lis, tit, kalifikasyon oswa kantite moun — epi yo pa di si sèvis yo gen yon frè pi lwen pase frè eskolè a.

strings.text: The list is the evidence
strings.t: Lis la se prèv la

strings.text: The 2021–25 list spans Brown, Dartmouth, Cornell and Chicago down through broad-access institutions — Belmont Abbey, Brevard, Catawba, Mars Hill, Methodist, Wingate, Gardner-Webb, Lenoir-Rhyne, UNC Pembroke, Winston-Salem State. A school placing only its top quartile would not produce that range.
strings.t: Lis 2021–25 la kouvri Brown, Dartmouth, Cornell ak Chicago desann atravè enstitisyon ak aksè laj — Belmont Abbey, Brevard, Catawba, Mars Hill, Methodist, Wingate, Gardner-Webb, Lenoir-Rhyne, UNC Pembroke, Winston-Salem State. Yon lekòl k ap plase sèlman ka anwo li a pa t ap pwodui ranje sa a.

strings.text: No rank, by design
strings.t: Pa gen ran, espre

strings.text: In a 47-person class, an ordinal position is far more damaging than informative. The no-rank policy is a structural choice that protects the middle, and the spring Case Studies Program teaches families to read admissions as institutional need rather than applicant ranking.
strings.t: Nan yon klas 47 moun, yon pozisyon nan lòd pi domajab lwen pase enfòmatif. Politik san ran an se yon chwa estriktirèl ki pwoteje mitan an, epi Case Studies Program prentan an aprann fanmi yo li admisyon kòm bezwen enstitisyonèl olye ke ran aplikan.

strings.text: Service academies (Air Force, West Point); conservatories and arts institutes (Manhattan School of Music, UNCSA, Pratt, SCAD, AMDA); seven international universities across five countries (UCL, Edinburgh, Manchester, Toronto, Copenhagen, John Cabot, Richmond American London); and specialised technical schools (Embry-Riddle, Colorado School of Mines, RPI, RIT).
strings.t: Akademi sèvis (Air Force, West Point); konsèvatwa ak enstiti atistik (Manhattan School of Music, UNCSA, Pratt, SCAD, AMDA); sèt inivèsite entènasyonal atravè senk peyi (UCL, Edinburgh, Manchester, Toronto, Copenhagen, John Cabot, Richmond American London); ak lekòl teknik espesyalize (Embry-Riddle, Colorado School of Mines, RPI, RIT).

strings.text: All SAT and ACT data is withheld — percentiles, means, and even the number of testers. The count of testers is as revealing as the scores, since it shows whether the class is testing at all; neither is available. This is a disclosure decision tied to test-optional admissions, not a signal about how students score.
strings.t: Tout done SAT ak ACT kenbe — pousantaj, mwayèn, ak menm kantite moun ki pase tès. Kantite moun ki pase tès la revelatè menm jan ak nòt yo, paske li montre si klas la ap pase tès ditou; ni youn ni lòt pa disponib. Sa a se yon desizyon divilgasyon makonnen ak admisyon ak tès opsyonèl, se pa yon siy sou kijan elèv yo fè.

strings.text: No gap-year policy or counselling is published, and no quintile table, decile table or mean GPA.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn politik oswa konsèy sou ane apre diplòm ki pibliye, ak pa gen tab senkyèm, tab dizyèm oswa GPA mwayèn.

strings.text: A small, program-rich school whose strengths are process, access and spike-building — and whose weakness is disclosure.
strings.t: Yon ti lekòl ki rich an pwogram ak fòs ki nan pwosesis, aksè ak konstriksyon espesyalite — epi ki gen feblès nan divilgasyon.

strings.text: Every verdict point below is about what the school does. A family that evaluates schools on published outcome metrics will find less here than anywhere else in this set, which puts the burden of verification on the tour.
strings.t: Chak pwen jijman ki anba a konsène sa lekòl la fè. Yon fanmi k ap evalye lekòl sou mezi rezilta ki pibliye ap jwenn mwens isit la pase okenn lòt kote nan gwoup sa a, sa ki mete chay verifikasyon an sou vizit la.

strings.text: The spike machinery is real and credited
strings.t: Machin espesyalite a reyèl epi li kredite

strings.text: AFAR is not a service trip: excavation under permit at Cahal Pech with the BVAR project, four countries with documented start years, students publishing and presenting at conferences, and a program history in peer-reviewed literature.
strings.t: AFAR se pa yon vwayaj sèvis: fouy anba pèmi nan Cahal Pech ak pwojè BVAR la, kat peyi ak ane kòmansman ki dokimante, elèv k ap pibliye epi prezante nan konferans, ak yon istwa pwogram nan literati ak revizyon kanmarad.

strings.text: The Global Studies Diploma sends a second transcript
strings.t: Global Studies Diploma a voye yon dezyèm relve nòt

strings.text: Structurally different from an honours cord — the Profile states an additional transcript and profile go to colleges, backed by language study, two weeks of international field research and a capstone paper.
strings.t: Estriktirèlman diferan de yon kòdon onè — Pwofil la deklare yon relve nòt ak pwofil adisyonèl ale bay inivèsite yo, sipòte pa etid lang, de semèn rechèch teren entènasyonal ak yon papye kapston.

strings.text: The caseload is genuinely small, and starts in 9th grade
strings.t: Chay la vrèman piti, epi li kòmanse nan 9yèm ane

strings.text: Two counselors for 198 Upper Schoolers (~1:99, ~1:24 at senior level) makes the “individualized” language credible rather than promotional.
strings.t: De konseye pou 198 elèv Upper School (~1:99, ~1:24 nan nivo dènye ane) fè lang “endividyalize” a kredib olye ke pwomosyonèl.

strings.text: The Profile does the work test scores would
strings.t: Pwofil la fè travay nòt tès yo ta fè

strings.text: Full grading scale, explicit weighting and exclusions, GPA range and median, the complete catalog with unoffered courses flagged, and a five-year acceptance list — with a disclosed 2.49 GPA floor.
strings.t: Echèl nòt konplè, pwa ak eksklizyon eksplisit, ranje ak medyàn GPA, katalòg konplè ak kou yo pa ofri ki make, ak yon lis aksepte senk ane — ak yon planche GPA 2.49 ki divilge.

strings.text: Rep-visit volume is high per student
strings.t: Volim vizit reprezantan wo pa elèv

strings.text: 80+ reps a year at a 198-student Upper School, visits running all fall, plus a spring case-studies program and fair co-hosted with Cannon School that drew nearly 70 colleges.
strings.t: 80+ reprezantan pa ane nan yon Upper School 198 elèv, ak vizit k ap fèt pandan tout otòn nan, plis yon pwogram etid ka ak fwa nan prentan ko-resevwa ak Cannon School ki te rale prèske 70 inivèsite.

strings.text: You don’t publish AP exam results — what share of AP exams scored 3 or higher last year, what share were 4s and 5s, and are students in an AP course required to sit the exam?
strings.t: Ou pa pibliye rezilta egzamen AP — ki pòsyon nan egzamen AP yo ki te fè 3 oswa pi wo ane pase, ki pòsyon ki te 4 ak 5, epi èske elèv nan yon kou AP oblije pase egzamen an?

strings.text: The Profile says you won’t provide testing profiles. What were the actual middle-50% SAT and ACT ranges for the last class, and how many students tested?
strings.t: Pwofil la di ou p ap bay pwofil tès. Ki vrè ranje mitan-50% SAT ak ACT pou dènye klas la, epi konbyen elèv ki te pase tès?

strings.text: Has Davidson Day had any National Merit Semifinalists, Finalists or Commended Students in the last five years? (Be explicit you mean the NC school — the name collides with Davidson Academy in Nevada.)
strings.t: Èske Davidson Day te gen okenn Semifinalis, Finalis oswa Commended Students National Merit nan senk dènye ane yo? (Di klèman w ap pale de lekòl NC la — non an kolizyon ak Davidson Academy nan Nevada.)

strings.text: You publish a highest, median and lowest GPA but no quintiles. How many of the seniors are above a 4.0, and where does the 25th percentile fall?
strings.t: Ou pibliye yon GPA pi wo, medyàn ak pi ba men pa gen senkyèm. Konbyen nan elèv dènye ane yo ki pi wo pase yon 4.0, epi kote 25yèm pousantaj la tonbe?

strings.text: Which 35 colleges did the Class of 2025 actually enroll at, and which colleges take a Davidson Day student most years?
strings.t: Nan ki 35 inivèsite Klas 2025 la te vrèman enskri, epi ki inivèsite ki pran yon elèv Davidson Day pifò ane?

strings.text: Does someone read every application before it’s submitted? What’s your stance on binding Early Decision, and how do you handle teacher recommendations?
strings.t: Èske gen yon moun ki li chak aplikasyon anvan yo soumèt li? Ki pozisyon w sou Early Decision ki angaje, epi kijan w jere rekòmandasyon pwofesè?

strings.text: Davidson College is one mile away — is there any dual-enrollment, course-access or partnership arrangement with them, or with UNC Charlotte?
strings.t: Davidson College chita yon mil lwen — èske gen okenn aranjman enskripsyon doub, aksè a kou oswa patenarya ak yo, oswa ak UNC Charlotte?

strings.text: If my child has accommodations through the Learning Enrichment Center, who gets those approved for College Board and ACT testing, and documented for college disability services?
strings.t: Si pitit mwen gen akomodasyon atravè Learning Enrichment Center la, kiyès ki fè apwouve yo pou tès College Board ak ACT, epi ki dokimante yo pou sèvis andikap nan inivèsite?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Carmel Christian School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 59.2% over the last five entering classes — 346 acceptances from 584 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Carmel Christian School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 59.2% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 346 admisyon sou 584 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 25.0% in Fall 2025 — 4 of 16 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 25.0% nan otòn 2025 — 4 sou 16 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 346 of 584 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 346 sou 584 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 4 of 16, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 4 sou 16, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: drew the most applications in Fall 2025 (31)
strings.t: te resevwa plis aplikasyon nan otòn 2025 (31)

strings.text: 73% of seniors scored a 3 or higher on at least one AP exam, and 80% sat at least one — enough for the College Board’s Platinum AP School Honor Roll, its top tier.
strings.t: 73% nan elèv fen etid yo te fè yon 3 oswa plis nan omwen yon egzamen AP, epi 80% te chita omwen youn — ase pou Platinum AP School Honor Roll College Board la, nivo ki pi wo li.

strings.text: A broad-participation AP program: 14 AP courses across 21 sections taught by 12 teachers, with 19% of seniors sitting five or more exams.
strings.t: Yon pwogram AP ak patisipasyon laj: 14 kou AP atravè 21 seksyon anseye pa 12 pwofesè, ak 19% nan elèv fen etid yo ki chita senk egzamen oswa plis.

strings.t: kou / seksyon AP, anseye pa 12 pwofesè

strings.text: What the AP recognition rests on
strings.t: Sou kisa rekonesans AP la chita

strings.text: Breadth over a narrow elite
strings.t: Lajè olye yon ti gwoup elit

strings.text: Platinum recognises schools where a large share of the senior class both takes and scores on AP exams — **80% sat an exam and 73% scored 3+**, so the recognition rests on the whole class, not a handful of specialists.
strings.t: Platinum rekonèt lekòl kote yon gwo pati nan klas fen etid la ni pran ni fè nòt nan egzamen AP — **80% te chita yon egzamen epi 73% te fè 3+**, kidonk rekonesans la chita sou tout klas la, se pa sou yon ti ponyen espesyalis.

strings.text: Depth in the tail
strings.t: Pwofondè nan pati dèyè a

strings.text: **19% of seniors sat five or more AP exams** — a meaningful group carrying a heavy AP load, not just one or two courses.
strings.t: **19% nan elèv fen etid yo te chita senk egzamen AP oswa plis** — yon gwoup enpòtan k ap pote yon chaj AP lou, se pa jis youn oswa de kou.

strings.text: Staffing
strings.t: Anplwaye

strings.text: **21 sections across 14 AP courses, taught by 12 teachers** — the program is spread across a real faculty rather than concentrated in one or two rooms.
strings.t: **21 seksyon atravè 14 kou AP, anseye pa 12 pwofesè** — pwogram nan gaye atravè yon vrè fakilte olye li konsantre nan youn oswa de sal.

strings.text: How the grade is framed
strings.t: Kijan nòt la prezante

strings.text: Weighted, and does not rank
strings.t: Ponn, epi li pa klase

strings.text: The 2024–25 profile reports a weighted-GPA range (**3.67–4.50**) against an unweighted range (**3.29–3.81**) and states the school does not rank students — the range stands in for a rank.

strings.text: The edge here is a fully published, sequenced counseling program plus a broad-participation AP record — legibility and cadence rather than national-competition credentials.
strings.t: Avantaj la se yon pwogram konsèy ki byen pibliye, ki byen ranje, plis yon dosye AP ak laj patisipasyon — lizibilite ak kadans olye kalifikasyon konpetisyon nasyonal.

strings.text: What the school hands a family is a documented four-year plan and a top-tier College Board recognition; what it does not publish is a research-program or Olympiad track.
strings.t: Sa lekòl la remèt yon fanmi se yon plan kat ane ki dokimante ak yon rekonesans College Board nan pi wo nivo; sa li pa pibliye se yon pwogram rechèch oswa yon pist Olympiad.

strings.text: **A sequenced plan** — the published four-year timeline (Strong Start → Involvement & Service → Testing & Research → Essays & Applications) means a student is building toward the application from 9th grade, not assembling it in senior fall.
strings.t: **Yon plan ki byen ranje** — kalandriye kat ane pibliye a (Strong Start → Involvement & Service → Testing & Research → Essays & Applications) vle di yon elèv ap bati vè aplikasyon an depi 9yèm ane, se pa monte l nan otòn dènye ane a.

strings.text: **A signature program that reps see** — the College Admissions Panel brings public, private and Christian-college reps, a financial-aid officer, a Marine recruiter and a campus minister into one room for families.

strings.text: **A legible transcript** — a stated weighting range and no-rank policy let a reader reconstruct rigor in context, and the AP Honor Roll gives the program a third-party mark.
strings.t: **Yon relve nòt ki lizib** — yon plaj pwa deklare ak yon règleman san klasman kite yon lektè rekonstwi rigè nan kontèks, epi AP Honor Roll la bay pwogram nan yon mak yon twazyèm pati.

strings.text: A well-documented, sequenced counseling program and a broad-participation AP record — with the current-year quantitative profile the one real hole a visit should close.

strings.text: The process disclosure is unusually complete for a school this size; the outcomes and test data are thinner, and the latest profile could not be located.
strings.t: Divilgasyon pwosesis la konplè yon fason ki pa abityèl pou yon lekòl gwosè sa a; rezilta yo ak done tès yo pi mens, epi pwofil ki pi resan an pa t kapab jwenn.

strings.text: The weighting changes with the Class of 2026

strings.text: The profile states that from the Class of 2026 honors courses carry **+0.5** and AP courses **+1.0**, down from the **+1** and **+2** quality points behind the GPA ranges above — so a weighted GPA quoted today is not calculated the same way as one quoted for a current freshman.
strings.t: Pwofil la deklare ke apati Class of 2026 la kou Honors yo pote **+0.5** epi kou AP yo **+1.0**, anba **+1** ak **+2** pwen kalite ki dèyè plaj GPA anwo yo — kidonk yon GPA ponn yo site jodi a pa kalkile menm jan ak yon GPA yo site pou yon elèv premye ane kounye a.

strings.text: How many seniors does the college counselor carry at peak season, and how large is the senior class?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Hickory Grove Christian School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 74.9% over the last five entering classes — 256 acceptances from 342 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Hickory Grove Christian School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 74.9% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 256 admisyon sou 342 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 20.0% in Fall 2025 — 2 of 10 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 20.0% nan otòn 2025 — 2 sou 10 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: The school advertises **17 AP courses plus AP Capstone** (AP Seminar + AP Research). The Fall 2025 profile names 14 by title; the 2023 profile named 17 (adding Human Geography, Computer Science A and Spanish Language & Culture), so which of the 18 distinct titles run in a given year varies.
strings.t: Lekòl la anonse **17 kou AP plis AP Capstone** (AP Seminar + AP Research). Pwofil Fall 2025 la nonmen 14 pa tit; pwofil 2023 la te nonmen 17 (ak Human Geography, Computer Science A ak Spanish Language & Culture anplis), kidonk kilès nan 18 tit distenk yo ki fèt nan yon ane bay varye.

strings.text: Real depth in the scores
strings.t: Vrè pwofondè nan nòt yo

strings.text: **29 students earned a 5 on one or more AP exams in May 2025** (59 a 4, 53 a 3) — these are students-scoring-X counts, which overlap, not a per-exam distribution the school does not publish.
strings.t: **29 elèv te fè yon 5 nan youn oswa plizyè egzamen AP nan me 2025** (59 yon 4, 53 yon 3) — sa yo se kont elèv-ki-fè-X, ki chevoche, se pa yon distribisyon pa egzamen ke lekòl la pa pibliye.

strings.text: Dual enrollment beyond AP
strings.t: Doub enskripsyon pi lwen pase AP

strings.text: Courses taught on campus are credited through **Judson College** (Fall 2025 profile; prior years credited via the College at Southeastern), and students also take **NC Career & College Promise** courses at local community colleges.
strings.t: Kou yo anseye sou kanpis la kredite atravè **Judson College** (pwofil Fall 2025; ane anvan yo te kredite atravè College at Southeastern la), epi elèv yo pran kou **NC Career & College Promise** tou nan kolèj kominotè lokal yo.

strings.text: The school **does not rank students** (verbatim, both profiles). GPA averages regular and weighted courses together on a 4.0 base.
strings.t: Lekòl la **pa bay elèv yo ran** (mo pou mo, nan tou de pwofil yo). GPA a fè mwayèn kou regilye ak kou ak pwa yo ansanm sou yon baz 4.0.

strings.text: The weighting was halved mid-2024
strings.t: Yo te koupe pwa a an mwatye nan mitan 2024

strings.text: Under the current (Spring 2024 and beyond) scale, **Honors courses earn +½ a quality point and AP courses +1** — down from +1 and +2 on the 2016–17 scale. A Class of 2025 transcript spans both scales.
strings.t: Sou echèl aktyèl la (Spring 2024 ak apre), **kou Honors yo genyen +½ yon pwen kalite epi kou AP yo +1** — anba +1 ak +2 sou echèl 2016–17 la. Yon relve nòt Class of 2025 kouvri tou de echèl yo.

strings.text: No per-exam AP 1–5 distribution is published — only the overlapping "students who earned a 5 / 4 / 3 on at least one exam" counts. The "17 AP courses" marketing figure and the profile's shorter named list (14) are reconciled here as catalog-vs-offered-this-year, not a contradiction.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn distribisyon AP 1–5 pa egzamen ki pibliye — se sèlman kont ki chevoche yo "students who earned a 5 / 4 / 3 on at least one exam". Chif maketing "17 AP courses" la ak lis ki gen non pi kout pwofil la (14) rekonsilye isit la kòm katalòg-kont-sa-yo-ofri-ane-sa-a, se pa yon kontradiksyon.

strings.text: A two-person counseling office — a Director of Counseling and an Administrator for Student Services — running a biblical-worldview program of 1:1 meetings, guidance lunches and parent-night sessions.
strings.t: Yon biwo konsèy ak de moun — yon Director of Counseling ak yon Administrator for Student Services — k ap dirije yon pwogram ak yon vizyon biblik ki gen reyinyon 1:1, manje midi konsèy ak sesyon aswè pou paran.

strings.text: The seniors-per-counselor ratio is not published; against the Class of 2025 senior count it computes to roughly 34:1 across the two staff, or about 138:1 measured over all 275 high-school students.
strings.t: Rapò elèv dènye ane pa konseye a pa pibliye; kont kantite elèv dènye ane Class of 2025 la, li bay apeprè 34:1 atravè de anplwaye yo, oswa anviwon 138:1 lè yo mezire l sou tout 275 elèv lekòl segondè yo.

Both are derived, not stated.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn gwosè klas dènye ane ni rapò elèv dènye ane pa konseye ki pibliye. Chif ≈34:1 la kalkile apati kont gwoup Class of 2025 yo (43 + 15 + 7 + 2 = 67 gradye) kont de anplwaye konsèy yo; chif ≈138:1 pou tout lekòl la sèvi ak tout 275 elèv lekòl segondè yo. Tou de dedwi, yo pa deklare.

strings.text: 132 distinct institutions appear across the school's two published acceptance lists (Classes of 2023 and 2025) — from Bowdoin, Pomona and Georgia Tech through a deep bench of NC publics, Christian colleges and HBCUs.
strings.t: 132 enstitisyon distenk parèt atravè de lis aksepte lekòl la pibliye yo (Klas 2023 ak 2025) — depi Bowdoin, Pomona ak Georgia Tech rive nan yon gwo baz kolèj piblik NC, kolèj kretyen ak HBCU.

strings.text: The lists carry no matriculation markings, so they read as acceptances. Here the combined, deduplicated list is scored against the current U.S. News tiers.
strings.t: Lis yo pa pote okenn mak enskripsyon, kidonk yo li kòm aksepte. Isit la lis konbine an, san doub, evalye kont nivo U.S. News aktyèl yo.

strings.text: Counts are derived by this research from the same 132-institution list you can filter at right, scored against the 2026 U.S. News tables — not figures the school reports. The list is the union of the Class of 2023 (81) and Class of 2025 (86) profiles; verbatim spellings are preserved, including the profiles' own apparent typos ("Clafin", "Deleware", "Coker University"), and community colleges (Central Piedmont, Cape Fear, Rowan-Cabarrus, York Technical) are kept because the school lists them.
strings.t: Rechèch sa a dedwi kont yo apati menm lis 132 enstitisyon ou ka filtre sou bò dwat la, evalye kont tablo U.S. News 2026 yo — se pa chif lekòl la rapòte. Lis la se inyon pwofil Class of 2023 (81) ak Class of 2025 (86) yo; nou konsève òtograf yo mo pou mo, ki gen ladan fot frap aparan pwofil yo menm ("Clafin", "Deleware", "Coker University"), epi nou kenbe kolèj kominotè yo (Central Piedmont, Cape Fear, Rowan-Cabarrus, York Technical) paske lekòl la liste yo.

strings.text: The profiles publish acceptance lists and recognition counts, but no scholarship-offer totals or named-award ledger.
strings.t: Pwofil yo pibliye lis aksepte ak kont rekonesans, men pa gen okenn total òf bous ni rejis prim ki gen non.

strings.text: these are acceptance lists, not matriculation lists, and mark no enrollments — so they show breadth of acceptances rather than where students actually enrolled. The Class of 2025 profile marks first-ever acceptances with an asterisk, showing the list is still widening.
strings.t: sa yo se lis aksepte, se pa lis enskripsyon, epi yo pa make okenn enskripsyon — kidonk yo montre lajè aksepte yo olye kote elèv yo vrèman enskri. Pwofil Class of 2025 la make premye aksepte yo ak yon zetwal, sa ki montre lis la ap toujou elaji.

strings.text: Bucket membership near the Top-75 line should be re-confirmed against the live U.S. News edition at ingest. HBCU membership was checked per institution; ambiguous names (e.g. "Xavier University of Louisiana") are resolved to the HBCU, not the Ohio Xavier.
strings.t: Manm gwoup ki toupre liy Top-75 la ta dwe rekonfime kont edisyon U.S. News an dirèk la nan moman ingest la. Nou tcheke manm HBCU yo enstitisyon pa enstitisyon; non ki anbigi (pa egzanp "Xavier University of Louisiana") rezoud vè HBCU a, se pa Xavier Ohio a.

strings.text: The edge here is a broad-participation AP program with AP Capstone and a growing National-recognition record, set inside an explicitly biblical-worldview college-prep school.
strings.t: Avantaj la isit la se yon pwogram AP ak laj patisipasyon ki gen AP Capstone ak yon dosye rekonesans National k ap grandi, mete anndan yon lekòl preparasyon inivèsite ki eksplisitman gen yon vizyon biblik.

strings.text: What the school hands a family is a real AP catalog and a decade of College Board recognitions; what it does not publish is a research-program or national-competition track.
strings.t: Sa lekòl la remèt yon fanmi se yon vrè katalòg AP ak yon dizèn ane rekonesans College Board; sa li pa pibliye se yon pwogram rechèch oswa yon pis konpetisyon nasyonal.

strings.text: **A 17-course AP program with AP Capstone** — the AP Seminar → AP Research sequence produced 4 AP Capstone Diplomas in 2024–25, and 82 students sat 176 exams in May 2025.
strings.t: **Yon pwogram AP 17 kou ak AP Capstone** — sekans AP Seminar → AP Research la pwodui 4 AP Capstone Diploma an 2024–25, epi 82 elèv te chita 176 egzamen nan me 2025.

strings.text: **A widening recognition record** — 1 National Merit Finalist and 7 Commended over 2019–2025, up from 1/5 in the prior window, plus 14 College Board National African American / Hispanic recognitions.
strings.t: **Yon dosye rekonesans k ap elaji** — 1 National Merit Finalis ak 7 Commended sou 2019–2025, ki monte soti nan 1/5 nan fenèt anvan an, plis 14 rekonesans College Board National African American / Hispanic.

strings.text: **Dual-enrollment credit** — courses credited through Judson College (prior years, the College at Southeastern) and NC Career & College Promise at community colleges.
strings.t: **Kredi doub enskripsyon** — kou ki kredite atravè Judson College (ane anvan yo, College at Southeastern la) ak NC Career & College Promise nan kolèj kominotè yo.

strings.text: **A legible, no-rank transcript** — the school does not rank, and publishes both grading scales and the honors/AP weighting so a reader can reconstruct rigor in context.
strings.t: **Yon relve nòt lizib, san ran** — lekòl la pa bay ran, epi li pibliye tou de echèl nòt yo ak pwa honors/AP la pou yon moun k ap li ka rekonstwi rijè a nan kontèks li.

strings.text: **A signature summer on-ramp** — the counseling office runs a College Admissions Boot Camp for rising juniors and seniors, with campus visits.
strings.t: **Yon pòt antre ete siyati** — biwo konsèy la dirije yon College Admissions Boot Camp pou elèv rising twazyèm ak dènye ane, ak vizit kanpis.

strings.text: **A deep HBCU and NC-public pipeline** — 20 HBCUs and the full NC public system appear across the two acceptance lists, matching the school's applicant base.
strings.t: **Yon rezo HBCU ak kolèj piblik NC pwofon** — 20 HBCU ak tout sistèm piblik NC la parèt atravè de lis aksepte yo, sa ki matche ak baz aplikan lekòl la.

strings.text: No research program, Olympiad results, or national-competition credentials are published — the differentiators are AP breadth and legibility, not competition results.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn pwogram rechèch, rezilta Olympiad, ni kalifikasyon konpetisyon nasyonal ki pibliye — sa ki fè diferans lan se lajè AP ak lizibilite, se pa rezilta konpetisyon.

strings.text: The school publishes class means and medians — not percentile distributions — and it says so: small tester counts (SAT n=20) are disclosed on the profile itself.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye mwayèn ak medyàn klas la — se pa distribisyon pousantil — epi li di sa: ti kantite moun ki teste yo (SAT n=20) divilge sou pwofil la menm.

strings.text: Test scores are tagged to the ENTERING class (2026 / 2024), a year apart from the Class-of-2025 outcomes; every table below is means/medians, so none carries a percentile header.
strings.t: Nòt tès yo make sou klas K AP ANTRE a (2026 / 2024), yon ane apa ak rezilta Class-of-2025 yo; chak tablo anba a se mwayèn/medyàn, kidonk okenn nan yo pa pote yon antèt pousantil.

strings.t: Paj Student Services la nonmen yon chanèl Educational Support Services (ESS) ansanm ak sipò pou tès estandadize ak byennèt, men li pa pibliye okenn detay pwogram pou diferans nan aprantisaj, deskripsyon sal resous, ni chif akomodasyon.

strings.text: No structured learning-differences program, accommodations count, or resource-room detail is published; ESS is named without figures.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn pwogram estriktire pou diferans nan aprantisaj, kantite akomodasyon, ni detay sal resous ki pibliye; ESS nonmen san chif.

strings.text: The two acceptance lists run from Bowdoin, Pomona and Georgia Tech through the full NC public system (Chapel Hill, NC State, Charlotte, Wilmington, Greensboro, Asheville, Pembroke), Christian colleges, HBCUs and community colleges (Central Piedmont, Cape Fear, Rowan-Cabarrus) — the spread of a broad, not uniformly elite, class.
strings.t: De lis aksepte yo ale depi Bowdoin, Pomona ak Georgia Tech rive nan tout sistèm piblik NC la (Chapel Hill, NC State, Charlotte, Wilmington, Greensboro, Asheville, Pembroke), kolèj kretyen, HBCU ak kolèj kominotè (Central Piedmont, Cape Fear, Rowan-Cabarrus) — etandi yon klas laj, ki pa inifòmman elit.

strings.text: Non-4-year paths are real
strings.t: Chemen ki pa 4 ane yo reyèl

strings.text: For the Class of 2025, 22% planned a 2-year college and 11% chose not to pursue higher education — and the acceptance list includes the community colleges and trade paths that reflects.
strings.t: Pou Class of 2025 la, 22% te planifye yon kolèj 2 ane epi 11% te chwazi pou yo pa kontinye edikasyon siperyè — epi lis aksepte a gen ladan kolèj kominotè ak chemen metye ki reflete sa.

strings.text: No score percentiles, no GPA quintiles and no per-quintile outcomes are published — only class means/medians (with disclosed tester counts) and AP awardee tiers. The shape of the class is not recoverable from public sources.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn pousantil nòt, okenn kentil GPA ni okenn rezilta pa kentil ki pibliye — se sèlman mwayèn/medyàn klas la (ak kantite moun ki teste ki divilge) ak nivo moun ki resevwa AP. Fòm klas la pa ka rekipere apati sous piblik.

strings.text: A biblical-worldview college-prep school with a genuine AP-and-Capstone program and a widening recognition record — with the small tester counts and the unpublished caseload the two things a visit should probe.
strings.t: Yon lekòl preparasyon inivèsite ak yon vizyon biblik ki gen yon vrè pwogram AP-ak-Capstone ak yon dosye rekonesans k ap elaji — ak ti kantite moun ki teste yo ak chay travay ki pa pibliye a kòm de bagay yon vizit ta dwe eksplore.

strings.text: The AP catalog and the two-year acceptance record are the real strengths; the quantitative profile is thin by design (means, not distributions) and the counseling caseload is never stated.
strings.t: Katalòg AP la ak dosye aksepte de ane a se vrè fòs yo; pwofil kantitatif la mens espre (mwayèn, se pa distribisyon) epi yo pa janm deklare chay travay konsèy la.

strings.text: The AP story is real and broad
strings.t: Istwa AP la reyèl epi laj

strings.text: 17 AP courses with AP Capstone, 176 exams sat in May 2025, 29 students earning a 5 on at least one, and 4 AP Capstone Diplomas — a program with genuine depth for a school this size.
strings.t: 17 kou AP ak AP Capstone, 176 egzamen yo chita nan me 2025, 29 elèv ki fè yon 5 nan omwen youn, ak 4 AP Capstone Diploma — yon pwogram ak vrè pwofondè pou yon lekòl nan gwosè sa a.

strings.text: Recognition is growing
strings.t: Rekonesans lan ap grandi

strings.text: National Merit (1 Finalist / 7 Commended) and 14 College Board National recognitions over 2019–2025, both up from the prior window.
strings.t: National Merit (1 Finalis / 7 Commended) ak 14 rekonesans College Board National sou 2019–2025, tou de an monte parapò ak fenèt anvan an.

strings.text: A two-person counseling office
strings.t: Yon biwo konsèy ak de moun

strings.text: A Director of Counseling and an Administrator for Student Services run the program, but the senior caseload is never published — the ≈34:1 figure here is computed, so ask it directly.
strings.t: Yon Director of Counseling ak yon Administrator for Student Services dirije pwogram nan, men yo pa janm pibliye chay travay elèv dènye ane a — chif ≈34:1 la isit la kalkile, kidonk mande l dirèkteman.

strings.text: Outcomes show breadth over two years
strings.t: Rezilta yo montre lajè sou de ane

strings.text: 132 institutions across the 2023 and 2025 lists — Bowdoin and Pomona at the top, 20 HBCUs, the full NC public system — but the lists mark no matriculations, so they show acceptances, not enrollment.
strings.t: 132 enstitisyon atravè lis 2023 ak 2025 yo — Bowdoin ak Pomona anlè, 20 HBCU, tout sistèm piblik NC la — men lis yo pa make okenn enskripsyon, kidonk yo montre aksepte, se pa enskripsyon.

strings.text: The quantitative profile is thin by design
strings.t: Pwofil kantitatif la mens espre

strings.text: The school publishes class means/medians on small tester counts (SAT n=20), not percentile distributions or a GPA table, and does not rank — so the shape of the class is not public.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye mwayèn/medyàn klas la sou ti kantite moun ki teste (SAT n=20), se pa distribisyon pousantil ni yon tab GPA, epi li pa bay ran — kidonk fòm klas la pa piblik.

strings.text: How many seniors does each of the two counselors carry, and is there a college-only counselor at peak season?
strings.t: Konbyen elèv dènye ane chak nan de konseye yo pote, epi èske gen yon konseye pou inivèsite sèlman nan gwo sezon an?

strings.text: Which of the 17 AP courses actually run in 2025–26 — the profile names 14, the school advertises 17?
strings.t: Kilès nan 17 kou AP yo ki vrèman fèt nan 2025–26 — pwofil la nonmen 14, lekòl la anonse 17?

strings.text: The acceptance lists mark no enrollments — where did the Classes of 2024 and 2025 actually matriculate, and in what concentrations?
strings.t: Lis aksepte yo pa make okenn enskripsyon — kote Klas 2024 ak 2025 yo te vrèman enskri, epi nan ki konsantrasyon?

strings.text: What does Educational Support Services (ESS) provide, and how are College Board / ACT accommodations documented?
strings.t: Kisa Educational Support Services (ESS) bay, epi kijan yo dokimante akomodasyon College Board / ACT yo?

strings.text: Only 20 students took the SAT and 85 the ACT — what share of the class tests, and how is test-optional handled?
strings.t: Se sèlman 20 elèv ki te pran SAT la ak 85 ACT la — ki pati nan klas la ki fè tès, epi kijan yo jere tès opsyonèl la?

strings.text: How does the College Admissions Boot Camp fit the application calendar, and is it open to all rising juniors and seniors?
strings.t: Kijan College Admissions Boot Camp la kadre ak kalandriye aplikasyon an, epi èske li louvri pou tout elèv rising twazyèm ak dènye ane?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Gaston Day School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 57.9% over the last five entering classes — 140 acceptances from 242 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Gaston Day School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 57.9% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 140 admisyon sou 242 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 27.3% in Fall 2025 — 3 of 11 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 27.3% nan otòn 2025 — 3 sou 11 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: Every AP student must sit the exam, and the share scoring 3+ has climbed five years running — 72% in 2021 to 95% in 2025.
strings.t: Chak elèv AP dwe pase egzamen an, epi pòsyon ki fè 3+ la monte senk ane youn dèyè lòt — 72% an 2021 rive 95% an 2025.

strings.text: With no class rank, the profile hands admissions readers three substitutes at once: a published GPA-quintile table, a grade-distribution-by-department table, and stated AP-load maxima that define what "most rigorous" means here.
strings.t: San okenn ran nan klas, pwofil la bay moun k ap li nan admisyon twa ranplasan alafwa: yon tab GPA pa senkyèm ki pibliye, yon tab distribisyon nòt pa depatman, ak maksimòm chay AP ki deklare ki defini sa “pi rijid la” vle di isit la.

The dollar total rose while the headcount fell (25 students/$2.75M in 2023 → 20/$3.87M in 2024), so the per-student average roughly doubled across those two classes.

Total an dola a monte pandan kantite moun nan bese (25 elèv/$2.75M an 2023 → 20/$3.87M an 2024), kidonk mwayèn pa elèv la prèske double atravè de klas sa yo.

strings.t: Kote kourikoulòm nan ale pi fon

strings.text: The fullest AP pairing on offer — both **Calculus AB** and **Calculus BC**, atop Honors PreCalculus, Honors Calculus and Honors Statistics.
strings.t: Pè AP ki pi konplè yo ofri a — tou de **Calculus AB** ak **Calculus BC**, anwo Honors PreCalculus, Honors Calculus ak Honors Statistics.

strings.text: **AP Biology, AP Chemistry and AP Physics II**, with Honors Environmental Science and Honors Physics beneath them. Physics II as the AP (rather than Physics 1) implies a two-year sequence.
strings.t: **AP Biology, AP Chemistry ak AP Physics II**, ak Honors Environmental Science ak Honors Physics anba yo. Physics II kòm AP la (olye ke Physics 1) vle di gen yon sekans de ane.

strings.text: Computer science & engineering
strings.t: Syans enfòmatik ak enjenyri

strings.text: **AP Computer Science**, plus Honors Engineering and Honors Robotics as electives — feeding the VEX Robotics team that reached TSA VEX Nationals in 2023.
strings.t: **AP Computer Science**, plis Honors Engineering ak Honors Robotics kòm elektif — k ap nouri ekip VEX Robotics ki te rive nan TSA VEX Nationals an 2023.

strings.text: DE opens in the fall of grade 11; students may replace **up to two elective credits** with DE credit in each of grades 11 and 12. **Intro to Business (H)(DE)** is taught by Gaston Day faculty. DE grades are **not** calculated into the GPA.
strings.t: DE louvri nan otòn grad 11 la; elèv yo ka ranplase **jiska de kredi elektif** ak kredi DE nan chak nan grad 11 ak 12. **Intro to Business (H)(DE)** se pwofesè Gaston Day k ap anseye l. Nòt DE yo **pa** antre nan kalkil GPA a.

strings.t: Pi lwen pase sal klas la

strings.text: A **Capstone Project of at least 40 hours** is required of every senior — internship, research or service — beginning in the second semester of junior year and reported on throughout.
strings.t: Yo egzije yon **Capstone Project omwen 40 èdtan** pou chak elèv dènye ane — estaj, rechèch oswa sèvis — ki kòmanse nan dezyèm semès onzyèm ane a epi ki rapòte pandan tout tan an.

strings.text: Weighted, on a stated scale
strings.t: Ak pwa, sou yon echèl ki deklare

strings.text: A 4.0 scale with a published band table (100–97 = 4.330 down to 62–60 = 0.670); **Honors +0.50, AP +1.0**. Only GDS coursework counts — outside courses appear on the transcript but are excluded from the GPA.
strings.t: Yon echèl 4.0 ak yon tab bann ki pibliye (100–97 = 4.330 desann rive 62–60 = 0.670); **Honors +0.50, AP +1.0**. Sèlman kou GDS yo konte — kou deyò yo parèt sou relve nòt la men yo eskli yo nan GPA a.

strings.text: The profile publishes all five GPA quintiles for the Class of 2026 at the end of junior year, so a reader can place any applicant within the class without a single #1.
strings.t: Pwofil la pibliye tout senk senkyèm GPA yo pou Klas 2026 la nan fen onzyèm ane a, kidonk yon moun k ap li ka mete nenpòt aplikan nan plas li nan klas la san yon sèl #1.

strings.text: Published AP maxima — **one AP in grade 10, three in each of grades 11 and 12** — tell colleges exactly what the most demanding schedule looks like here, so a normal six-course load is not read as thin.
strings.t: Maksimòm AP ki pibliye yo — **yon sèl AP nan grad 10, twa nan chak nan grad 11 ak 12** — di inivèsite yo egzakteman kijan orè ki pi egzijan an sanble isit la, kidonk yo pa li yon chay nòmal sis kou kòm yon bagay mens.

strings.text: Grade distribution is published by department
strings.t: Distribisyon nòt yo pibliye pa depatman

strings.text: A 2024-25 table gives the A+/A/A-…D spread for English, Arts, History, Math, Science and Languages — an unusual disclosure that lets a reader calibrate a GDS grade against its own department.
strings.t: Yon tab 2024-25 bay repartisyon A+/A/A-…D pou English, Arts, History, Math, Science ak Languages — yon divilgasyon ki pa abityèl ki pèmèt yon moun k ap li kalibre yon nòt GDS kont pwòp depatman l.

strings.text: AP course count: the profile’s own course table marks **10** AP courses, while Private School Review lists **9** — its list omits Chemistry, which the profile marks (H)(AP). The school’s own table is used.
strings.t: Kantite kou AP: pwòp tab kou pwofil la make **10** kou AP, pandan Private School Review liste **9** — lis li a kite Chemistry deyò, ke pwofil la make (H)(AP). Se pwòp tab lekòl la nou sèvi ak li.

strings.text: The profile publishes no per-subject AP score table, no count of AP exams sat, and no National Merit ledger — so the 3+ rate is a single school-wide figure per year rather than a distribution.
strings.t: Pwofil la pa pibliye okenn tab nòt AP pa matyè, okenn kantite egzamen AP yo pase, ni okenn lis National Merit — kidonk to 3+ la se yon sèl chif nan tout lekòl la pa ane olye ke yon distribisyon.

strings.text: Two counselors for a graduating class of 35 — roughly 18 seniors each — with the four-year sequence starting in eighth grade rather than eleventh.
strings.t: De konseye pou yon klas fen etid 35 elèv — apeprè 18 elèv dènye ane chak — ak sekans kat ane a ki kòmanse nan uityèm ane olye ke nan onzyèm.

strings.text: Transcript practice is published rather than implied: initial transcripts carry grades through the end of junior year plus senior-year courses; Early Decision transcripts with interim first-semester grades go out in late November **by request only**; midyear transcripts go out in early January for everything else.

strings.text: The school publishes no counselor tenure, credentials or prior admissions-side experience, no count of college representatives hosted per year, and no named essay-workshop or bootcamp programme.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye okenn ansyènte konseye, kalifikasyon ni eksperyans anvan sou bò admisyon, okenn kantite reprezantan inivèsite yo resevwa pa ane, ni okenn atelye redaksyon oswa pwogram bootcamp ki gen non.

strings.text: 95% of the Class of 2025 went straight to a four-year college, and the 2019–2025 acceptance list runs to 231 institutions — Yale and Dartmouth through Stanford, Duke and Johns Hopkins.
strings.t: 95% nan Klas 2025 la te ale dirèk nan yon inivèsite kat ane, epi lis akseptasyon 2019–2025 la rive nan 231 enstitisyon — Yale ak Dartmouth jiska Stanford, Duke ak Johns Hopkins.

strings.text: A list this long from classes of ~35 means most of it is breadth rather than concentration: it is the set of places Gaston Day students have been admitted over seven years, not where any one class landed.
strings.t: Yon lis konsa long ki soti nan klas ~35 elèv vle di pifò nan li se lajè olye ke konsantrasyon: se ansanm kote elèv Gaston Day yo te admèt sou sèt ane, se pa kote yon sèl klas ateri.

strings.text: This is an acceptance list, not a matriculation list. The profile bolds the institutions Class of 2025 members actually enrolled at, but that bold styling does not survive PDF text extraction — so no college here is marked as enrolling, and the list should be read as "admitted somewhere in this set over seven years" rather than "the class went here".
strings.t: Sa a se yon lis aksepte, se pa yon lis enskripsyon. Pwofil la mete an gra enstitisyon kote manm Klas 2025 la te enskri reyèlman, men style gra sa a pa siviv ekstraksyon tèks PDF la — kidonk pa gen okenn inivèsite isit la ki make kòm enskripsyon, epi ou ta dwe li lis la kòm “admèt yon kote nan ansanm sa a sou sèt ane” olye ke “klas la te ale la”.

strings.text: The school publishes no matriculation counts, no per-college enrollment numbers and no year-by-year acceptance breakdown — the list is a single undifferentiated 2019–2025 set.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye okenn kantite enskripsyon, okenn nimewo enskripsyon pa inivèsite ni okenn repartisyon akseptasyon ane pa ane — lis la se yon sèl ansanm 2019–2025 san diferansyasyon.

strings.text: Enrolled-vs-accepted cannot be recovered from the published PDF by text extraction, since the distinction is carried in bold styling alone. Reading the original PDF visually would recover it.
strings.t: Nou pa ka rekipere enskri kont aksepte nan PDF ki pibliye a atravè ekstraksyon tèks, paske style gra a pou kont li pote distenksyon an. Li PDF orijinal la ak je ta rekipere l.

strings.text: The spike here is unusually concrete for a small school: a gold-medal iGEM synthetic-biology team, a VEX Robotics squad that reached TSA Nationals in its first year, and a required 40-hour Capstone every senior must defend.
strings.t: Pwen fò a isit la konkrè yon fason ki pa abityèl pou yon ti lekòl: yon ekip byoloji sentetik iGEM ki gen meday lò, yon eskwad VEX Robotics ki rive nan TSA Nationals nan premye ane l, ak yon Capstone 40 èdtan obligatwa chak elèv dènye ane dwe defann.

strings.text: What the school cannot offer is name recognition at scale — Gaston Day is a 510-student school in Gastonia, not a nationally-known feeder, so the leverage argument rests on distinctiveness rather than volume.
strings.t: Sa lekòl la pa ka ofri se rekonesans non li sou yon gwo echèl — Gaston Day se yon lekòl 510 elèv nan Gastonia, se pa yon lekòl ki konnen nasyonalman kòm founisè elèv, kidonk agiman levye a chita sou distenksyon olye ke sou volim.

strings.text: what a student can actually point at
strings.t: sa yon elèv ka reyèlman montre

strings.text: **iGEM synthetic biology** — teams in 2012, 2016, 2018 and 2020, with a **gold medal** and projects including a kudzu phytotoxin and an *E. coli* K-12 isobutanol biofuel. iGEM is a university-level competition with a high-school track; fielding one from a school this size is rare.
strings.t: **Byoloji sentetik iGEM** — ekip an 2012, 2016, 2018 ak 2020, ak yon **meday lò** ak pwojè ki enkli yon fitotoksin kudzu ak yon byokabiran izobitanòl *E. coli* K-12. iGEM se yon konpetisyon nan nivo inivèsite ki gen yon pis pou lekòl segondè; mete youn sou teren apati yon lekòl konsa piti se yon bagay ki ra

strings.text: **VEX Robotics** — after years in a joint-school FIRST Robotics team that placed **4th at state**, Gaston Day launched its own team and **qualified for TSA VEX Nationals in 2023, its first year competing**.
strings.t: **VEX Robotics** — apre plizyè ane nan yon ekip FIRST Robotics ant lekòl ki te fè **4yèm nan eta a**, Gaston Day te lanse pwòp ekip pa l epi li te **kalifye pou TSA VEX Nationals an 2023, premye ane li nan konpetisyon**.

strings.text: **Capstone Project** — every senior completes an internship, research or service project of **at least 40 hours**, documented and reported on across a full year. It is a requirement, so every applicant has one.
strings.t: **Capstone Project** — chak elèv dènye ane konplete yon estaj, yon rechèch oswa yon pwojè sèvis **omwen 40 èdtan**, dokimante epi rapòte pandan tout yon ane. Se yon egzijans, kidonk chak aplikan genyen youn.

strings.text: **Sunship Earth peer mentoring** — juniors and seniors lead the fourth-grade class through a multi-day mountain programme, then mentor the same child for the rest of the year. A sustained leadership commitment rather than a one-off.
strings.t: **Mentoraj ant kanmarad Sunship Earth** — elèv onzyèm ak douzyèm ane mennen klas katriyèm ane a atravè yon pwogram plizyè jou nan mòn, epi apre sa yo mentore menm timoun nan pou rès ane a. Yon angajman lidèchip ki soutni olye ke yon bagay yon sèl fwa.

strings.text: **Blutopia** — the student-run literary and art magazine, with **numerous Scholastic Art and Writing Awards** and repeated recognition in the NC Scholastic Media Association Literary Magazine Contest.
strings.t: **Blutopia** — magazin literè ak atistik elèv yo dirije a, ak **anpil Scholastic Art and Writing Awards** ak rekonesans repete nan NC Scholastic Media Association Literary Magazine Contest la.

strings.text: **President’s Service Award** for 100+ service hours, atop a 25-hour annual requirement (40 for NHS).
strings.t: **President’s Service Award** pou 100+ èdtan sèvis, anwo yon egzijans anyèl 25 èdtan (40 pou NHS).

strings.text: what the name itself does
strings.t: sa non an limenm fè

strings.text: **Accreditation and memberships that a reader recognises** — Cognia/SACS CASI, NCAIS, SAIS, NAIS, plus NACAC and ACCIS on the counseling side.
strings.t: **Akreditasyon ak manm yon moun k ap li rekonèt** — Cognia/SACS CASI, NCAIS, SAIS, NAIS, plis NACAC ak ACCIS sou bò konsèy la.

strings.text: **A profile built for admissions readers** — quintiles, a department-level grade distribution, defined AP maxima and published transcript timing all make a GDS record easy to interpret, which is leverage of a quieter kind.
strings.t: **Yon pwofil bati pou moun k ap li nan admisyon** — senkyèm, yon distribisyon nòt nan nivo depatman, maksimòm AP ki defini ak lè relve nòt yo pibliye tout fè yon dosye GDS fasil pou entèprete, epi se yon levye nan yon fason pi trankil.

strings.text: **An international cohort and a Global Classroom Initiative** — partnerships with overseas schools for grades 10–12 and a documented homestay programme, giving the applicant pool a genuinely international character.
strings.t: **Yon gwoup entènasyonal ak yon Global Classroom Initiative** — patenarya ak lekòl aletranje pou grad 10–12 ak yon pwogram lojman lakay ki dokimante, sa ki bay ansanm aplikan an yon karaktè vrèman entènasyonal.

strings.text: **A five-county draw** — Gaston, Lincoln, Cleveland, Mecklenburg and York counties, so the school is regionally rather than locally known.
strings.t: **Yon zòn senk konte** — konte Gaston, Lincoln, Cleveland, Mecklenburg ak York, kidonk lekòl la konnen rejyonalman olye ke lokalman.

strings.text: The school publishes no evidence of admissions-office relationships, no counts of college representative visits, and no alumni-network claims — so institutional leverage is inferred from accreditation and profile quality rather than demonstrated.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye okenn prèv relasyon ak biwo admisyon, okenn kantite vizit reprezantan inivèsite, ni okenn reklamasyon sou rezo ansyen elèv — kidonk nou dedwi levye enstitisyonèl la apati akreditasyon ak kalite pwofil la olye ke nou demontre l.

strings.text: The iGEM gold medal is third-party-confirmed: the iGEM team wikis return 403 to automated fetches, so the medal level was not re-verified at source in this pass. Team participation in 2012, 2016, 2018 and 2020 is confirmed by the archived team pages.
strings.t: Yon twazyèm pati konfime meday lò iGEM la: wiki ekip iGEM yo bay 403 bay fetch otomatik, kidonk nou pa t re-verifye nivo meday la nan sous la nan pas sa a. Paj ekip ki achive yo konfime patisipasyon ekip la an 2012, 2016, 2018 ak 2020.

strings.text: A class of 35 with a published five-year test series and all five GPA quintiles — enough to see the whole class, not just its top.
strings.t: Yon klas 35 elèv ak yon seri tès senk ane ki pibliye ak tout senk senkyèm GPA yo — ase pou wè tout klas la, se pa sèlman tèt li.

strings.text: The bottom fifth sits at 2.5–3.05 and the top at 4.3–4.74, so the spread is real and the school publishes it rather than leading with a single average.
strings.t: Senkyèm anba a chita nan 2.5–3.05 epi tèt la nan 4.3–4.74, kidonk repartisyon an reyèl epi lekòl la pibliye l olye ke li kòmanse ak yon sèl mwayèn.

strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye sèlman mitan 50% la, kidonk kolòn 10yèm, 50yèm ak 90yèm yo parèt kòm “—” olye ke nou entèpole yo. Nou bay senk ane paske klas la piti ase pou nenpòt sèl ane balanse fò — 2023 (1060–1290) ak 2021 (1120–1390) ankadre yon entèval 100 pwen nan pwen anwo a.

strings.text: All grade-11 students are required to take the ACT, so this range covers the whole class rather than a self-selected group of testers — an important difference from a school where only the college-bound test.
strings.t: Tout elèv grad 11 dwe pase ACT la, kidonk entèval sa a kouvri tout klas la olye ke yon gwoup moun ki chwazi tèt yo pou pase tès la — yon diferans enpòtan ak yon lekòl kote sèlman moun k ap ale nan inivèsite ki pase tès.

strings.text: Published as ranges rather than quintile means, and the ranges are reproduced exactly as printed. Because Honors adds +0.50 and AP +1.0, a top-quintile GPA above 4.0 reflects course weighting as much as raw grades. Note the school states grades 10–12 must hold a cumulative 2.0 in core courses, so the bottom of the fifth quintile sits well clear of the academic-standing floor.
strings.t: Yo pibliye yo kòm entèval olye ke mwayèn pa senkyèm, epi nou repwodui entèval yo egzakteman jan yo enprime yo. Paske Honors ajoute +0.50 epi AP +1.0, yon GPA nan senkyèm anwo a ki pi wo pase 4.0 reflete pwa kou yo menm jan ak nòt brit yo. Note ke lekòl la deklare grad 10–12 dwe kenbe yon 2.0 kimilatif nan kou debaz yo, kidonk anba senkyèm senkyèm nan chita byen lwen anwo planche estati akademik la.

strings.text: If a student learns differently
strings.t: Si yon elèv aprann yon lòt fason

strings.text: Learning Academy
strings.t: Learning Academy

strings.text: A **Coordinate Program** for students with diagnosed learning disabilities, running alongside the standard curriculum.
strings.t: Yon **Coordinate Program** pou elèv ki gen andikap aprantisaj yo dyagnostike, k ap kouri ansanm ak kourikoulòm estanda a.

strings.text: Intervention
strings.t: Entèvansyon

strings.text: **Early Reading and Math Intervention** in the Lower School, so support is not only a secondary-school offering.
strings.t: **Early Reading and Math Intervention** nan Lower School la, kidonk sipò a pa sèlman yon ofrann nan lekòl segondè.

strings.text: Therapies on site
strings.t: Terapi sou plas

strings.text: **Speech and Language Therapy** and **Occupational Therapy** are provided at school.
strings.t: Yo bay **Speech and Language Therapy** ak **Occupational Therapy** nan lekòl la.

strings.text: Coaching
strings.t: Konsèy pèsonalize

strings.text: **Academic Coaching** and tutoring, plus a paid on-site summer tutoring programme open to non-students at $30/half-hour.
strings.t: **Academic Coaching** ak titora, plis yon pwogram titora ete peye sou plas ki louvri pou moun ki pa elèv a $30/demi-èdtan.

strings.text: World language exception
strings.t: Eksepsyon pou lang etranje

strings.text: International students for whom English is a second language are **not required** to take an additional world language — a documented accommodation within the graduation requirements.
strings.t: Elèv entènasyonal ki gen angle kòm dezyèm lang **pa oblije** pran yon lang etranje anplis — yon akomodasyon ki dokimante anndan egzijans gradyasyon yo.

strings.text: The school does not publish how many students use the Coordinate Program, what it costs, whether there is an admissions requirement, or how testing accommodations are documented with the College Board and ACT.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye konbyen elèv ki sèvi ak Coordinate Program la, konbyen li koute, si gen yon egzijans admisyon, ni kijan yo dokimante akomodasyon pou tès ak College Board ak ACT.

strings.text: If a student is in the middle
strings.t: Si yon elèv nan mitan an

strings.text: Everyone gets an advisor
strings.t: Tout moun jwenn yon konseye pèsonèl

strings.text: Every Upper School student is assigned a faculty advisor matched to their interests and needs, who **stays with them through graduation** — continuity that does not depend on being a top student.
strings.t: Yo asiyen chak elèv Upper School yon pwofesè konseye ki matche ak enterè ak bezwen yo, ki **rete ak yo jiska gradyasyon** — yon kontinwite ki pa depann de si w se yon elèv nan tèt la.

strings.text: Everyone gets the counselor
strings.t: Tout moun jwenn konseye a

strings.text: With ~18 seniors per counselor, the office reaches the whole class rather than triaging to the strongest applicants.
strings.t: Ak ~18 elèv dènye ane pa konseye, biwo a rive jwenn tout klas la olye ke li triye pou pi bon aplikan yo.

strings.text: A six-course load, not a race
strings.t: Yon chay sis kou, se pa yon kous

strings.text: AP access is deliberately capped (1 in grade 10, 3 in grades 11 and 12), so the transcript ceiling is defined and a moderate load is normal rather than remedial.
strings.t: Aksè AP limite espre (1 nan grad 10, 3 nan grad 11 ak 12), kidonk plafon relve nòt la defini epi yon chay modere nòmal olye ke remedyal.

strings.text: Non-AP rigour exists
strings.t: Rigè san AP egziste

strings.text: A broad Honors tier sits below the AP courses across every department, plus dual enrollment from grade 11 for students who want college credit without an AP exam.
strings.t: Yon nivo Honors laj chita anba kou AP yo nan chak depatman, plis doub enskripsyon apati grad 11 pou elèv ki vle kredi inivèsitè san yon egzamen AP.

strings.text: A required spike for everyone
strings.t: Yon pwen fò obligatwa pou tout moun

strings.text: The 40-hour Capstone and the 25-hour annual service requirement mean every graduate has something concrete to write about, not only the students who sought it out.
strings.t: Capstone 40 èdtan an ak egzijans sèvis anyèl 25 èdtan an vle di chak gradye gen yon bagay konkrè pou ekri sou li, se pa sèlman elèv ki te chèche l yo.

strings.text: No tester counts are published for any year, so it is not possible to tell what share of a ~35-student class sat the SAT — a mid-50% range over a small n moves sharply with a few students.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kantite moun ki pase tès ki pibliye pou okenn ane, kidonk nou pa ka di ki pòsyon nan yon klas ~35 elèv ki te pase SAT la — yon entèval mitan-50% sou yon ti n deplase fò ak kèk elèv.

strings.text: The quintile table gives ranges only, with no mean SAT or ACT per quintile, so a reader cannot tie GPA band to test performance the way some peer profiles allow.
strings.t: Tab senkyèm nan bay entèval sèlman, san okenn mwayèn SAT oswa ACT pa senkyèm, kidonk yon moun k ap li pa ka lye bann GPA a ak pèfòmans nan tès jan kèk pwofil parèy pèmèt.

strings.text: A small school that publishes like a much larger one — five-year test and AP series, full GPA quintiles, a department-level grade distribution and a seven-year acceptance list.
strings.t: Yon ti lekòl ki pibliye tankou yon lekòl pi gwo anpil — seri tès ak AP senk ane, senkyèm GPA konplè, yon distribisyon nòt nan nivo depatman ak yon lis akseptasyon sèt ane.

strings.text: The reservations are about scale and disclosure, not quality: a 35-senior class makes every rate volatile, and the athletics and club rosters are thinner in public than the academic record.
strings.t: Rezèv yo konsène echèl ak divilgasyon, se pa kalite: yon klas 35 elèv dènye ane fè chak to volatil, epi lis atletism ak klib yo pi mens an piblik pase dosye akademik la.

strings.text: The AP trend is real and rising
strings.t: Tandans AP la reyèl epi l ap monte

strings.text: The 3+ rate went 72% → 76% → 86% → 89% → **95%** across 2021–2025, and because **every AP student must sit the exam**, that rate is not flattered by opting out.
strings.t: To 3+ la te ale 72% → 76% → 86% → 89% → **95%** atravè 2021–2025, epi paske **chak elèv AP dwe pase egzamen an**, to sa a pa flate paske moun pa patisipe.

strings.text: Rank is replaced, not merely omitted
strings.t: Yo ranplase ran an, yo pa senpleman kite l deyò

strings.text: Most no-rank schools stop there. Gaston Day publishes a **five-band GPA quintile table**, a **grade distribution by department**, and **defined AP maxima** — three separate substitutes.
strings.t: Pifò lekòl san ran kanpe la. Gaston Day pibliye yon **tab GPA senk bann pa senkyèm**, yon **distribisyon nòt pa depatman**, ak **maksimòm AP ki defini** — twa ranplasan apa.

strings.text: Counseling starts in eighth grade
strings.t: Konsèy kòmanse nan uityèm ane

strings.text: Course planning begins four years before applications, and the ~18:1 senior caseload is among the lowest on this roster.
strings.t: Planifikasyon kou kòmanse kat ane anvan aplikasyon yo, epi chay ~18:1 pou elèv dènye ane a pami pi ba sou lis sa a.

strings.text: The spike is institutional
strings.t: Pwen fò a enstitisyonèl

strings.text: A **gold-medal iGEM** team, **TSA VEX Nationals in year one**, and a **required 40-hour Capstone** mean distinctiveness is built into the programme rather than left to the individual student.
strings.t: Yon ekip **iGEM ak meday lò**, **TSA VEX Nationals nan premye ane a**, ak yon **Capstone 40 èdtan obligatwa** vle di distenksyon bati anndan pwogram nan olye ke yo kite l pou chak elèv poukont li.

strings.text: The acceptance breadth is genuine
strings.t: Lajè akseptasyon an vre

strings.text: **231 institutions** including Yale, Stanford, Dartmouth, Duke, Johns Hopkins and Georgetown, plus 23 top-75 liberal arts colleges — wide range for classes of ~35.
strings.t: **231 enstitisyon** ki enkli Yale, Stanford, Dartmouth, Duke, Johns Hopkins ak Georgetown, plis 23 kolèj liberal arts nan top-75 — yon gran varyete pou klas ~35 elèv.

strings.text: The money is disclosed
strings.t: Lajan an divilge

strings.text: Four years of merit-scholarship totals are published — **$3.76M for 21 students in 2025** — where many schools publish none.
strings.t: Kat ane total bous merit yo pibliye — **$3.76M pou 21 elèv an 2025** — kote anpil lekòl pa pibliye okenn.

strings.text: With 35 seniors and two counselors, does Kristy Smith carry her own caseload, or is the ~18:1 figure really 35:1 against the Director?
strings.t: Ak 35 elèv dènye ane ak de konseye, èske Kristy Smith gen pwòp chay pa l, oswa èske chif ~18:1 la se vrèman 35:1 kont Direktè a?

strings.text: The acceptance list covers seven years — where did the last two graduating classes actually enroll, and in what concentrations?
strings.t: Lis akseptasyon an kouvri sèt ane — kote de dènye klas ki gradye yo te enskri reyèlman, epi nan ki konsantrasyon?

strings.text: What share of a class sits the SAT versus the ACT, given the ACT is required in grade 11 and no tester counts are published?
strings.t: Ki pòsyon nan yon klas ki pase SAT la kont ACT la, etandone ACT la obligatwa nan grad 11 epi pa gen okenn kantite moun ki pase tès ki pibliye?

strings.text: The AP cap is one course in grade 10 and three in grades 11–12 — how is that applied to a student who wants more, and does it ever get waived?
strings.t: Plafon AP la se yon kou nan grad 10 ak twa nan grad 11–12 — kijan yo aplike sa pou yon elèv ki vle plis, epi èske yo janm bay yon dispans?

strings.text: What does the Learning Academy Coordinate Program cost, who qualifies, and how are College Board accommodations documented?
strings.t: Konbyen Learning Academy Coordinate Program la koute, kiyès ki kalifye, epi kijan yo dokimante akomodasyon College Board yo?

strings.text: The International Program runs through one exclusive agency (ABC Education Group) — what English-language support exists on campus for those students?
strings.t: International Program la pase nan yon sèl ajans eksklizif (ABC Education Group) — ki sipò nan lang angle ki egziste sou kanpis la pou elèv sa yo?

strings.text: Enrollment reads 510 on the school profile but 466 and 448 on third-party and federal sources — which counts preschool, and what is the Upper School number?
strings.t: Enskripsyon an li 510 sou pwofil lekòl la men 466 ak 448 sou sous twazyèm pati ak federal — kilès ki konte preschool, epi ki nimewo Upper School la?
